sourceRange.text: 口溫不花領兵河南，屢建大功，子曰滅里吉台、甕吉剌台。朮赤者，太祖長子也。國初，以親王分封西北，其地極遠，去京師數萬里，驛騎急行二百餘日，方達京師。以故其地郡邑風俗皆莫得而詳焉。朮赤薨，子拔都嗣。拔都薨，弟撒里答嗣。撒里答薨，弟忙哥帖木兒嗣。忙哥帖木兒薨，弟脫脫忙哥嗣。脫脫忙哥薨，弟脫脫嗣。脫脫薨，弟伯忽嗣。伯忽薨，弟月即別嗣。至元二年，月即別遣使來求分地歲賜，以賑給軍站，京師元無所領府治。三年，中書請置總管府，給正三品印。至大元年，月即別薨，子札尼別嗣。其位下舊賜平陽、晉州、永州分地，歲賦中統鈔二千四百錠，自至元五年己卯歲始給之。禿剌，太祖次子察合台四世孫也。

manualTranslations.zh: 國初，以親王分封西北，其地極遠，去京師數萬里，驛騎急行二百餘日，方達京師。
manualTranslations.literal: At the founding of the realm, he was enfeoffed in the northwest as an imperial prince; his domain was exceedingly remote — tens of thousands of li from the capital, and even by urgent relay two hundred or more days were required to reach the capital.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the founding of the realm he was enfeoffed in the northwest as an imperial prince; his domain lay impossibly far from the capital — tens of thousands of li distant, and even by urgent relay more than two hundred days were needed to reach it.

manualTranslations.zh: 以故其地郡邑風俗皆莫得而詳焉。
manualTranslations.literal: Hence the prefectures, counties, and customs of that land could not be known in detail.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Hence the prefectures, counties, and customs of that land could not be known in any detail.

manualTranslations.zh: 朮赤薨，子拔都嗣。
manualTranslations.literal: Jochi died, and his son Batu succeeded.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Jochi died, his son Batu succeeded.

manualTranslations.zh: 拔都薨，弟撒里答嗣。
manualTranslations.literal: Batu died, and his younger brother Sarija succeeded.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Batu died, his younger brother Sarija succeeded.

manualTranslations.zh: 撒里答薨，弟忙哥帖木兒嗣。
manualTranslations.literal: Sarija died, and his younger brother Mongke Temür succeeded.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Sarija died, his younger brother Mongke Temür succeeded.

manualTranslations.zh: 忙哥帖木兒薨，弟脫脫忙哥嗣。
manualTranslations.literal: Mongke Temür died, and his younger brother Toqto Möngke succeeded.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Mongke Temür died, his younger brother Toqto Möngke succeeded.

manualTranslations.zh: 脫脫忙哥薨，弟脫脫嗣。
manualTranslations.literal: Toqto Möngke died, and his younger brother Toqto succeeded.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Toqto Möngke died, his younger brother Toqto succeeded.

manualTranslations.zh: 脫脫薨，弟伯忽嗣。
manualTranslations.literal: Toqto died, and his younger brother Berke succeeded.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Toqto died, his younger brother Berke succeeded.

manualTranslations.zh: 伯忽薨，弟月即別嗣。
manualTranslations.literal: Berke died, and his younger brother Yuejiebie succeeded.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Berke died, his younger brother Yuejiebie succeeded.

manualTranslations.zh: 至元二年，月即別遣使來求分地歲賜，以賑給軍站，京師元無所領府治。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Zhiyuan, Yuejiebie sent envoys to request the annual grant from his allotted domain to relieve military stations; the capital originally had no prefectural administration over him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhiyuan, Yuejiebie sent envoys to request the annual grant from his allotted domain to relieve military stations; the capital had originally exercised no prefectural jurisdiction over him.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年，中書請置總管府，給正三品印。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year the Secretariat requested establishing a general supervisory office and granting a seal of the third positive rank.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year the Secretariat requested establishing a general supervisory office and granting a seal of the third positive rank.

manualTranslations.zh: 至大元年，月即別薨，子札尼別嗣。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Zhida, Yuejiebie died, and his son Janibek succeeded.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Zhida, Yuejiebie died and was succeeded by his son Janibek.

manualTranslations.zh: 其位下舊賜平陽、晉州、永州分地，歲賦中統鈔二千四百錠，自至元五年己卯歲始給之。
manualTranslations.literal: The allotted domains formerly granted his house in Pingyang, Jin prefecture, and Yong prefecture yielded an annual levy of 2,400 ding of Zhongtong paper money, first disbursed from the jimao year of the fifth year of Zhiyuan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The domains formerly granted his house in Pingyang, Jin prefecture, and Yong prefecture yielded an annual levy of 2,400 ding of Zhongtong paper money, first paid from the jimao year of the fifth year of Zhiyuan.

sourceRange.text: 成宗崩，安西王阿難答與明理帖木兒窺望神器。牙忽都曰：「世祖皇帝之嫡孫在，神器所當屬。安西藩王也，入繼非制。」武宗即位，以其父子勞效忠勤，益厚遇之，進封楚王，賜金印，置王傅，以駙馬都尉都剌哈之女弟弘吉烈氏為楚王妃，又以叛王察八兒親屬賜之。脫列帖木兒襲封鎮遠王。

context.beforeSource: 大德五年，海都、篤哇合軍入寇，脫列帖木兒將兵千人擁護，先後力戰，功多，在軍十年。
context.afterSource: 至大三年，察八兒來歸，宗親皆會。
context.beforeLocal: 大德五年，海都、篤哇合軍入寇，脫列帖木兒將兵千人擁護，先後力戰，功多，在軍十年。
context.afterLocal: 至大三年，察八兒來歸，宗親皆會。

manualTranslations.zh: 成宗崩，安西王阿難答與明理帖木兒窺望神器。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Chengzong died, Prince of Anxi Ananda and Mingli Temür cast covetous eyes on the imperial succession.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Chengzong died, Prince of Anxi Ananda and Mingli Temür cast covetous eyes on the throne.

manualTranslations.zh: 牙忽都曰：「世祖皇帝之嫡孫在，神器所當屬。
manualTranslations.literal: Yahudou said: "The legitimate grandson of Emperor Shizu is present; the sacred vessel ought to belong to him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yahudou said, "The legitimate grandson of the Shizu Emperor is here; the throne ought to belong to him.

manualTranslations.zh: 安西藩王也，入繼非制。
manualTranslations.literal: He is a border prince of Anxi — for him to enter and succeed is against precedent.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He is Prince of Anxi — for a border prince to enter and succeed is against precedent.

manualTranslations.zh: 」武宗即位，以其父子勞效忠勤，益厚遇之，進封楚王，賜金印，置王傅，以駙馬都尉都剌哈之女弟弘吉剌氏為楚王妃，又以叛王察八兒親屬賜之。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Wuzong took the throne, in recognition of the father and son's labor, merit, loyalty, and diligence, he treated them still more generously, advanced Yahudou to Prince of Chu, granted a gold seal, established a prince's tutor, made the younger sister of Chief Commandant of Horse Dulaqa of the Kongirat clan Princess of Chu, and also granted him relatives of the rebel prince Chabar."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wuzong ascended the throne, honoring the father and son's labor, merit, loyalty, and diligence, he treated them still more generously, advanced Yahudou to Prince of Chu, granted a gold seal, appointed a prince's tutor, made the younger sister of Chief Commandant of Horse Dulaqa of the Kongirat clan Princess of Chu, and also granted him relatives of the rebel prince Chabar."

manualTranslations.zh: 脫列帖木兒襲封鎮遠王。
manualTranslations.literal: Tele Temür succeeded as Prince Who Pacifies the Distant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tele Temür succeeded as Prince Who Pacifies the Distant.

sourceRange.text: 有脫憐者，亦按陳之裔孫也，世祖授本藩千戶，仍賜驛券、圓符各四，令以兵守朔土之怯魯連。二十四年，從族父按答兒禿征叛王乃顏有功，亦賜號拔都兒。脫憐卒，子迸不剌嗣。迸不剌卒，子買住罕嗣。買住罕尚拜答沙公主。卒，弟孛羅帖木兒嗣，以金章封毓德王。孛羅帖木兒薨，買住罕孫阿失襲千戶。有名丑漢者，按陳次子必哥之裔孫，尚台忽魯都公主。

localRange.text: 有名醜漢者，按陳次子必哥之裔孫，尚臺忽魯都公主。

context.beforeSource: 哈兒哈孫之孫曰都羅兒，至元四年，授光祿大夫，以銀章封懿國公。
context.afterSource: 仁宗朝，封安遠王，以兵守莽來。

manualTranslations.zh: 有脫憐者，亦按陳之裔孫也，世祖授本藩千戶，仍賜驛券、圓符各四，令以兵守朔土之怯魯連。
manualTranslations.literal: There was one named Tuolian, also a descendant of Anchannayan; Shizu appointed him chiliarch of his own fief, further granted four relay vouchers and four round tallies each, and ordered him to garrison Qielulian in the northern frontier with troops.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: There was Tuolian, another descendant of Anchannayan. Kublai made him commander of a thousand households in his hereditary fief, granted four relay vouchers and four round tallies, and ordered him to garrison Qielulian on the northern frontier.

manualTranslations.zh: 二十四年，從族父按答兒禿征叛王乃顏有功，亦賜號拔都兒。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, following his clansman Anchadartu in campaigning against the rebel prince Nayan, he had merit and was likewise granted the title Batuur.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year he followed his kinsman Anchadartu against the rebel prince Nayan and distinguished himself, earning the heroic title Batuur.

manualTranslations.zh: 脫憐卒，子迸不剌嗣。
manualTranslations.literal: Tuolian died; his son Bengbula succeeded.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Tuolian died, his son Bengbula succeeded him.

manualTranslations.zh: 迸不剌卒，子買住罕嗣。
manualTranslations.literal: Bengbula died; his son Maizhuhan succeeded.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Bengbula died, his son Maizhuhan inherited the post.

manualTranslations.zh: 買住罕尚拜答沙公主。
manualTranslations.literal: Maizhuhan married Princess Baidasha.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Maizhuhan married Princess Baidasha.

manualTranslations.zh: 卒，弟孛羅帖木兒嗣，以金章封毓德王。
manualTranslations.literal: He died; his younger brother Boluotiemuer succeeded and, with a gold seal, was enfeoffed as King of Yude.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At his death his younger brother Boluotiemuer succeeded and was enfeoffed as King of Yude with a gold seal.

manualTranslations.zh: 孛羅帖木兒薨，買住罕孫阿失襲千戶。
manualTranslations.literal: Boluotiemuer died; Maizhuhans grandson Ash inherited the chiliarchate.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Boluotiemuer died, Maizhuhans grandson Ash inherited the chiliarchate.

manualTranslations.zh: 有名丑漢者，按陳次子必哥之裔孫，尚台忽魯都公主。
manualTranslations.literal: There was one called Chouhan, a descendant of Anchannayans second son Bike, who married Princess Taihuludu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: A descendant of Anchannayans second son Bike, known as Chouhan, married Princess Taihuludu.

sourceRange.text: 弘吉剌之分邑，得任其陪臣為達魯花赤者，有濟寧路及濟、兖、單三州，鉅野、鄆城、金鄉、虞城、碭山、豐縣、肥城、任城、魚臺、沛縣、單父、嘉祥、磁陽、寧陽、曲阜、泗水一十六縣。此丙申歲之所賜也。至元六年，陞古濟州為濟寧府，十八年始陞為路，而濟、兖、單三州隸焉。又汀州路長汀、寧化、清流、武平、上杭、連城六縣，此至元十三年之所賜也。又有永平路灤州、盧龍、遷安、撫寧、昌黎、石城、樂亭六縣，此至大元年之所賜也。若平江稻田一千五百頃，則至大二年所賜也。其應昌、全寧等路則自達魯花赤總管以下諸官屬，皆得專任其陪臣，而王人不與焉。此外，復有王傅府，自王傅六人而下，其羣屬有錢糧、人匠、鷹房、軍民、軍站、營田、稻田、烟粉千戶、總管、提舉等官，以署計者四十餘，以員計者七百餘，此可得而稽考者也。

localRange.text: 此外，復有王傅府，自王傅六人而下，其群屬有錢糧、人匠、鷹房、軍民、軍站、營田、稻田、煙粉千戶、總管、提舉等官，以署計者四十餘，以員計者七百餘，此可得而稽考者也。

context.beforeSource: 大德元年，名其城為全寧路。
context.afterSource: 其五戶絲、金鈔之數：則丙申歲所賜濟寧路之三萬戶，至元十八年所賜汀州路之四萬戶，絲以斤計者，歲二千二百有奇；

manualTranslations.zh: 弘吉剌之分邑，得任其陪臣為達魯花赤者，有濟寧路及濟、兖、單三州，鉅野、鄆城、金鄉、虞城、碭山、豐縣、肥城、任城、魚臺、沛縣、單父、嘉祥、磁陽、寧陽、曲阜、泗水一十六縣。
manualTranslations.literal: Among Hongjila sub-fiefs where attendant ministers might be appointed darughachi, there were Jining Circuit together with the three prefectures Ji, Yan, and Shan, and sixteen counties: Juye, Yuncheng, Jinxiang, Yucheng, Dangshan, Fengxian, Feicheng, Rencheng, Yutai, Peixian, Shanfu, Jiaxiang, Ciyang, Ningyang, Qufu, and Sishui.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Among the Hongjila sub-fiefs whose attendant ministers could serve as darughachi were Jining Circuit and the three prefectures of Ji, Yan, and Shan, together with sixteen counties: Juye, Yuncheng, Jinxiang, Yucheng, Dangshan, Feng, Feicheng, Rencheng, Yutai, Pei, Shanfu, Jiaxiang, Ciyang, Ningyang, Qufu, and Sishui.

manualTranslations.zh: 此丙申歲之所賜也。
manualTranslations.literal: This was granted in the bingshen year.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: This grant dated to the bingshen year.

manualTranslations.zh: 至元六年，陞古濟州為濟寧府，十八年始陞為路，而濟、兖、單三州隸焉。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth year of Zhiyuan ancient Jizhou was promoted to Jining Prefecture; only in the eighteenth year was it first promoted to a circuit, and the three prefectures Ji, Yan, and Shan were placed under it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In 1269 ancient Jizhou was elevated to Jining Prefecture; in 1281 it became a circuit, with Ji, Yan, and Shan prefectures subordinate to it.

manualTranslations.zh: 又汀州路長汀、寧化、清流、武平、上杭、連城六縣，此至元十三年之所賜也。
manualTranslations.literal: Again Tingzhou Circuit had the six counties Changting, Ninghua, Qingliu, Wuping, Shanghang, and Liancheng; this was granted in the thirteenth year of Zhiyuan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tingzhou Circuit with its six counties—Changting, Ninghua, Qingliu, Wuping, Shanghang, and Liancheng—was granted in 1276.

manualTranslations.zh: 又有永平路灤州、盧龍、遷安、撫寧、昌黎、石城、樂亭六縣，此至大元年之所賜也。
manualTranslations.literal: Again Yongping Circuit had Luanzhou and the six counties Lulong, Qianan, Funing, Changli, Shicheng, and Leting; this was granted in the first year of Zhide.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yongping Circuit, Luanzhou, and the six counties of Lulong, Qianan, Funing, Changli, Shicheng, and Leting were granted in 1308.

manualTranslations.zh: 若平江稻田一千五百頃，則至大二年所賜也。
manualTranslations.literal: As for fifteen hundred qing of rice paddies in Pingjiang, that was granted in the second year of Zhide.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Fifteen hundred qing of rice paddies in Pingjiang were granted in 1309.

manualTranslations.zh: 其應昌、全寧等路則自達魯花赤總管以下諸官屬，皆得專任其陪臣，而王人不與焉。
manualTranslations.literal: As for Yingchang, Quanning, and other circuits, from the darughachi and supervisor downward all offices could be filled exclusively by their attendant ministers, while princes of the blood did not participate.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At Yingchang, Quanning, and similar circuits, every office from darughachi and supervisor downward could be held solely by attendant ministers, without involvement of imperial princes.

manualTranslations.zh: 此外，復有王傅府，自王傅六人而下，其羣屬有錢糧、人匠、鷹房、軍民、軍站、營田、稻田、烟粉千戶、總管、提舉等官，以署計者四十餘，以員計者七百餘，此可得而稽考者也。
manualTranslations.literal: Beyond this there was again the Prince Tutorate; from six Prince Tutors downward their subordinates had offices for revenue grain, artisans, hawk chambers, military and civilian registry, relay posts, garrison fields, rice paddies, tobacco and powder chiliarchs, supervisors, intendants, and the like—more than forty agencies by establishment, more than seven hundred officers by headcount; these can be verified by examination.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Beyond this stood the Prince Tutorate. Below its six tutors were subordinate offices for revenue, artisans, hawking, military and civilian affairs, relay stations, garrison farms, rice paddies, and tobacco—more than forty agencies and more than seven hundred officers, all verifiable in the records.

sourceRange.text: __TOC__特薛禪，姓孛思忽兒，弘吉剌氏，世居朔漠。本名特，因從太祖起兵有功，賜名薛禪，故兼稱曰特薛禪。女曰孛兒台，太祖光獻翼聖皇后。子曰按陳，從太祖征伐，凡三十二戰，平西夏，斷潼關道，取回紇尋斯干城，皆與有功。歲丁亥，賜號國舅按陳那顏。壬辰，賜銀印，封河西王，以統其國族。丁酉，賜錢二十萬緡，有旨：「弘吉剌氏生女世以為后，生男世尚公主，每歲四時孟月，聽讀所賜旨，世世不絕。」又賜所俘獲軍民五千二百，仍授萬戶以領之。按陳薨，葬官人山。元貞元年二月，追封濟寧王，諡忠武；妻哈真，追封濟寧王妃。子斡陳，歲戊戌授萬戶，尚睿宗女也速不花公主。斡陳薨，葬不海韓。弟納陳，歲丁巳襲萬戶，奉旨伐宋，攻釣魚山。又從世祖南涉淮甸，下大清口，獲船百餘艘。又率兵平山東濟、兖、單等州。及阿里不哥叛，中統二年與諸王北伐，以其子哈海、脫歡、斡羅陳等十人自從，至于莽來，由失木魯與阿里不哥之黨八兒哈八兒思等戰，追北至孛羅克禿，復戰，自旦及夕，斬首萬級，僵尸被野。薨，葬末懷禿。斡羅陳襲萬戶，尚完澤公主。完澤公主薨，繼尚囊加真公主。至元十四年薨，葬拓剌里。無子。弟曰帖木兒，至元十八年襲萬戶。二十四年，乃顏叛，從帝親征，以功封濟寧郡王，賜白傘蓋以寵之。二十五年，諸王哈丹禿魯干叛，與諸王及統兵官玉速帖木兒等率兵討之，由龜剌河與哈丹等遇，轉戰至惱木連河，殲其眾。帝賜名按（察）〔答〕兒禿那顏，以旌其功。薨，葬末懷禿。子二人：長曰琱阿不剌，次曰桑哥不剌，皆幼。至元二十七年，以其弟蠻子台襲萬戶。亦尚囊加真公主。成宗即位，封皇姑魯國大長公主，以金印封蠻子台為濟寧王。奉旨率本部兵討叛王海都、篤哇，既與之遇，方約戰，行伍未定，單騎突入陣中，往復數四，敵兵大擾，一戰遂大捷。時武宗在藩邸，統大軍以鎮朔方，有旨令蠻子台總領蒙古軍民官，轉武〔宗〕守莽來，以遏北方。囊加真公主薨，繼尚裕宗女喃哥不剌公主。蠻子台薨，年五十有二。大德十一年三月，按答兒〔禿〕長子琱阿不剌襲萬戶，尚祥哥剌吉公主。六月，封大長公主，賜琱阿不剌金印，加封魯王。至大二年，賜平江稻田一千五百頃。皇慶間，加封皇姊大長公主。天曆間，加號皇姑徽文懿福（真）〔貞〕壽大長公主。至大三年，琱阿不剌薨，葬末懷禿。阿里嘉室利，琱阿不剌嫡子也。至大三年，甫八歲，襲萬戶。四年七月，襲封魯王，尚朵兒只班公主。元統元年，阿里嘉失利薨。至順間，封朵兒只班號肅雍賢寧公主。桑哥不剌者，魯王琱阿不剌之弟、阿里嘉室利之叔也。自幼奉世皇旨，養于斡可珍公主所，是為不只兒駙馬，後襲統其本部民四百戶。成宗時，奉旨尚普納公主；至順間，封鄆安大長公主，授桑哥不剌金印，封鄆安王，職千戶。元統元年，授萬戶。二年三月，加封鄆安公主號皇姑大長公主；加封桑哥不剌魯王。以疾薨，年六十一。此皆以駙馬襲封王爵者也。

context.afterSource: 唆兒火都者，亦按陳之子，以從征功，在太祖朝遙授左丞相，為千戶，仍賜以塗金銀章，及金銀字海青圓符五、驛馬券六。
context.afterLocal: 唆兒火都者，亦按陳之子，以從征功，在太祖朝遙授左丞相，為千戶，仍賜以塗金銀章，及金銀字海青圓符五、驛馬券六。

manualTranslations.zh: 特薛禪，姓孛思忽兒，弘吉剌氏，世居朔漠。
manualTranslations.literal: Texuechan, surname Besihuer, of the Hongjila clan, for generations dwelt in the northern desert.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Texuechan, of the Besihuer branch of the Hongjila clan, had lived for generations in the northern steppe.

manualTranslations.zh: 本名特，因從太祖起兵有功，賜名薛禪，故兼稱曰特薛禪。
manualTranslations.literal: His original name was Te; because he had merit following Taizu in raising troops, he was granted the name Xuechan, hence he was also called Texuechan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Originally named Te, he earned the name Xuechan for meritorious service when Genghis Khan raised his army, and was thereafter known as Texuechan.

manualTranslations.zh: 女曰孛兒台，太祖光獻翼聖皇后。
manualTranslations.literal: His daughter was Boertai, Taizus Radiant Offering Assisting Sagely Empress.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His daughter Boertai became Genghis Khans Radiant Offering Assisting Sagely Empress.

manualTranslations.zh: 子曰按陳，從太祖征伐，凡三十二戰，平西夏，斷潼關道，取回紇尋斯干城，皆與有功。
manualTranslations.literal: His son was Anchannayan, who followed Taizu on campaigns—in all thirty-two battles, pacifying Western Xia, cutting the Tong Pass road, and taking the Uyghur city of Xingsigan—all with merit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Anchannayan followed Genghis Khan on thirty-two campaigns, helping pacify Western Xia, sever the Tong Pass route, and capture the Uyghur city of Xingsigan.

manualTranslations.zh: 歲丁亥，賜號國舅按陳那顏。
manualTranslations.literal: In the dinghai year he was granted the title Imperial Uncle Anchannayan Noyan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the dinghai year he received the title Imperial Uncle Anchannayan Noyan.

manualTranslations.zh: 壬辰，賜銀印，封河西王，以統其國族。
manualTranslations.literal: In renchen he was granted a silver seal and enfeoffed King of Hexi to command his clansmen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In renchen he received a silver seal and was enfeoffed King of Hexi to govern his people.

manualTranslations.zh: 丁酉，賜錢二十萬緡，有旨：「弘吉剌氏生女世以為后，生男世尚公主，每歲四時孟月，聽讀所賜旨，世世不絕。」
manualTranslations.literal: In dingyou he was granted two hundred thousand strings of cash, with an edict: "Hongjila daughters shall generation after generation become empresses; Hongjila sons shall generation after generation marry imperial princesses; in the first month of each of the four seasons every year they shall hear the granted edict read—generation after generation without end."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In dingyou he received two hundred thousand strings of cash along with an edict: "Hongjila daughters shall become empresses for generations; Hongjila sons shall marry imperial princesses for generations; in the first month of each season they shall hear this edict read—forever without end."

manualTranslations.zh: 又賜所俘獲軍民五千二百，仍授萬戶以領之。
manualTranslations.literal: Again he was granted five thousand two hundred captured soldiers and civilians and appointed myriarch to command them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was further granted five thousand two hundred captured soldiers and civilians and appointed myriarch over them.

manualTranslations.zh: 按陳薨，葬官人山。
manualTranslations.literal: Anchannayan died and was buried at Mount Guanren.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Anchannayan died and was buried at Mount Guanren.

manualTranslations.zh: 元貞元年二月，追封濟寧王，諡忠武；
manualTranslations.literal: In the second month of the first year of Yuanzhen he was posthumously enfeoffed King of Jining with posthumous epithet Loyal Martial;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second month of 1295 he was posthumously enfeoffed as King of Jining with the epithet Loyal Martial;

manualTranslations.zh: 妻哈真，追封濟寧王妃。
manualTranslations.literal: his wife Hazhen was posthumously enfeoffed Princess of Jining.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: his wife Hazhen was posthumously made Princess of Jining.

manualTranslations.zh: 子斡陳，歲戊戌授萬戶，尚睿宗女也速不花公主。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Wochen, in the wuxu year appointed myriarch, married Ruizongs daughter Princess Yesubuhua.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Wochen was appointed myriarch in wuxu and married Toluis daughter Princess Yesubuhua.

manualTranslations.zh: 斡陳薨，葬不海韓。
manualTranslations.literal: Wochen died and was buried at Buhaihan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wochen died and was buried at Buhaihan.

manualTranslations.zh: 弟納陳，歲丁巳襲萬戶，奉旨伐宋，攻釣魚山。
manualTranslations.literal: His younger brother Nachan, in the dingsi year inheriting the myriarchate, received orders to attack Song and assault Diaoyu Mountain.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His younger brother Nachan inherited the myriarchate in dingsi, received orders to campaign against Song, and attacked Diaoyu Mountain.

manualTranslations.zh: 又從世祖南涉淮甸，下大清口，獲船百餘艘。
manualTranslations.literal: Again he followed Shizu south across the Huai region, took Daqingkou, and captured more than a hundred vessels.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He also followed Kublai south across the Huai region, seized Daqingkou, and captured more than a hundred ships.

manualTranslations.zh: 又率兵平山東濟、兖、單等州。
manualTranslations.literal: Again he led troops to pacify the Shandong prefectures Ji, Yan, Shan, and others.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He further led troops to pacify the Shandong prefectures of Ji, Yan, Shan, and others.

manualTranslations.zh: 及阿里不哥叛，中統二年與諸王北伐，以其子哈海、脫歡、斡羅陳等十人自從，至于莽來，由失木魯與阿里不哥之黨八兒哈八兒思等戰，追北至孛羅克禿，復戰，自旦及夕，斬首萬級，僵尸被野。
manualTranslations.literal: When Ariq Böke rebelled, in the second year of Zhongtong he joined the northern campaign with the princes, taking ten of his sons including Hahai, Tuohuan, and Woluochen; reaching Manglai, from Shimur he fought Ariq Bökes partisan Baerhabaersi and others, pursued north to Boluoketu, fought again from dawn to evening, beheaded ten thousand ranks, and corpses covered the fields.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Ariq Böke rebelled, in 1261 he joined the princes on the northern campaign with ten sons including Hahai, Tuohuan, and Woluochen. At Manglai he fought Ariq Bökes partisan Baerhabaersi from Shimur, pursued north to Boluoketu, and fought again from dawn to dusk, taking ten thousand heads until corpses covered the plain.

manualTranslations.zh: 薨，葬末懷禿。
manualTranslations.literal: He died and was buried at Mohuaitu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died and was buried at Mohuaitu.

manualTranslations.zh: 斡羅陳襲萬戶，尚完澤公主。
manualTranslations.literal: Woluochen inherited the myriarchate and married Princess Wanzhe.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Woluochen inherited the myriarchate and married Princess Wanzhe.

manualTranslations.zh: 完澤公主薨，繼尚囊加真公主。
manualTranslations.literal: When Princess Wanzhe died he next married Princess Nangjiazhen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Princess Wanzhe died he married Princess Nangjiazhen.

manualTranslations.zh: 至元十四年薨，葬拓剌里。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Zhiyuan he died and was buried at Tuolali.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died in 1277 and was buried at Tuolali.

manualTranslations.zh: 無子。
manualTranslations.literal: He had no son.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He left no son.

manualTranslations.zh: 弟曰帖木兒，至元十八年襲萬戶。
manualTranslations.literal: His younger brother was Tiemuer; in the eighteenth year of Zhiyuan he inherited the myriarchate.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His younger brother Tiemuer inherited the myriarchate in 1281.

manualTranslations.zh: 二十四年，乃顏叛，從帝親征，以功封濟寧郡王，賜白傘蓋以寵之。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, when Nayan rebelled, he followed the emperor on the personal campaign; for merit he was enfeoffed Prince of Jining Commandery and granted a white parasol canopy as favor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year, when Nayan rebelled, he joined the emperors personal campaign, was enfeoffed as Prince of Jining Commandery for his merit, and granted a white parasol canopy.

manualTranslations.zh: 二十五年，諸王哈丹禿魯干叛，與諸王及統兵官玉速帖木兒等率兵討之，由龜剌河與哈丹等遇，轉戰至惱木連河，殲其眾。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year Prince Hadantuolugan rebelled; with princes and the commanding officer Yusutiemuer and others he led troops to suppress them; from Guila River he met Hadan and the rest, fought through to Naomulian River, and annihilated their forces.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year, when Prince Hadantuolugan rebelled, he joined princes and the commander Yusutiemuer, met Hadan at the Guila River, fought through to the Naomulian River, and destroyed their army.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝賜名按
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor granted the name Anchad
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor granted the name Anchad

manualTranslations.literal: (Cha)
manualTranslations.idiomatic: [variant reading: Cha]

manualTranslations.zh: 〔答〕兒禿那顏，以旌其功。
manualTranslations.literal: artu Noyan to honor his merit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: artu Noyan to honor his achievement.

manualTranslations.zh: 薨，葬末懷禿。
manualTranslations.literal: He died and was buried at Mohuaitu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died and was buried at Mohuaitu.

manualTranslations.zh: 子二人：長曰琱阿不剌，次曰桑哥不剌，皆幼。
manualTranslations.literal: He had two sons: the elder Diaobubula and the younger Sangebubula—both young.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He had two sons: the elder Diaobubula and the younger Sangebubula, both still young.

manualTranslations.zh: 至元二十七年，以其弟蠻子台襲萬戶。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year of Zhiyuan his younger brother Manzitai inherited the myriarchate.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In 1290 his younger brother Manzitai inherited the myriarchate.

manualTranslations.zh: 亦尚囊加真公主。
manualTranslations.literal: He also married Princess Nangjiazhen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He also married Princess Nangjiazhen.

manualTranslations.zh: 成宗即位，封皇姑魯國大長公主，以金印封蠻子台為濟寧王。
manualTranslations.literal: When Chengzong acceded, the imperial paternal aunt was enfeoffed Grand Princess of Lu; with a gold seal Manzitai was enfeoffed King of Jining.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Temür acceded, the imperial paternal aunt was made Grand Princess of Lu, and Manzitai was enfeoffed King of Jining with a gold seal.

manualTranslations.zh: 奉旨率本部兵討叛王海都、篤哇，既與之遇，方約戰，行伍未定，單騎突入陣中，往復數四，敵兵大擾，一戰遂大捷。
manualTranslations.literal: By imperial order he led his tribes troops to suppress the rebel princes Qaidu and Duwa; having met them, just as battle was to be joined and ranks not yet set, he charged alone into the enemy array back and forth several times; the enemy troops were greatly thrown into disorder and one battle brought a great victory.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Ordered to lead his tribesmen against the rebel princes Qaidu and Duwa, he met the enemy just as battle was forming. Before the ranks were set he charged alone into their lines several times, threw them into disorder, and won a great victory.

manualTranslations.zh: 時武宗在藩邸，統大軍以鎮朔方，有旨令蠻子台總領蒙古軍民官，轉武宗守莽來，以遏北方。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time Wuzong was at the princely residence commanding a great army to guard the northern frontier; an edict ordered Manzitai to take overall charge of Mongol military and civilian offices and transfer to Wuzongs garrison at Manglai to check the north.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At that time Wuzong, holding a princely command on the northern frontier, was ordered to place Manzitai in overall charge of Mongol military and civilian offices and transfer him to garrison Manglai against the north.

manualTranslations.zh: 囊加真公主薨，繼尚裕宗女喃哥不剌公主。
manualTranslations.literal: When Princess Nangjiazhen died he next married Yuzongs daughter Princess Nangebubula.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Princess Nangjiazhen died he married Yuzongs daughter Princess Nangebubula.

manualTranslations.zh: 蠻子台薨，年五十有二。
manualTranslations.literal: Manzitai died at age fifty-two.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Manzitai died at the age of fifty-two.

manualTranslations.zh: 大德十一年三月，按答兒禿長子琱阿不剌襲萬戶，尚祥哥剌吉公主。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third month of the eleventh year of Dade, Anchadartus eldest son Diaobubula inherited the myriarchate and married Princess Xianggeleji.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third month of 1307, Anchadartus eldest son Diaobubula inherited the myriarchate and married Princess Xianggeleji.

manualTranslations.zh: 六月，封大長公主，賜琱阿不剌金印，加封魯王。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth month she was enfeoffed Grand Princess; Diaobubula was granted a gold seal and further enfeoffed King of Lu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth month she was made Grand Princess; Diaobubula received a gold seal and was further enfeoffed as King of Lu.

manualTranslations.zh: 至大二年，賜平江稻田一千五百頃。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Zhide he was granted fifteen hundred qing of rice paddies in Pingjiang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In 1309 he was granted fifteen hundred qing of rice paddies in Pingjiang.

manualTranslations.zh: 皇慶間，加封皇姊大長公主。
manualTranslations.literal: During Huangqing she was further enfeoffed Grand Princess, elder sister of the emperor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Huangqing she was further enfeoffed as the emperors elder sister, Grand Princess.

manualTranslations.zh: 天曆間，加號皇姑徽文懿福
manualTranslations.literal: During Tianli her title was further raised to Imperial Paternal Aunt, Splendid Culture, Graceful Blessing
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Tianli she received the further title Imperial Paternal Aunt, Splendid Culture, Graceful Blessing

manualTranslations.literal: (Zhen)
manualTranslations.idiomatic: [variant reading: Zhen]

manualTranslations.zh: 〔貞〕壽大長公主。
manualTranslations.literal: Chaste Longevity Grand Princess.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chaste Longevity Grand Princess.

manualTranslations.zh: 至大三年，琱阿不剌薨，葬末懷禿。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year of Zhide Diaobubula died and was buried at Mohuaitu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In 1310 Diaobubula died and was buried at Mohuaitu.

manualTranslations.zh: 阿里嘉室利，琱阿不剌嫡子也。
manualTranslations.literal: Alijiashili was Diaobubulas legitimate son.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Alijiashili was Diaobubulas legitimate son.

manualTranslations.zh: 至大三年，甫八歲，襲萬戶。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year of Zhide, only eight years old, he inherited the myriarchate.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In 1310, at only eight years of age, he inherited the myriarchate.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年七月，襲封魯王，尚朵兒只班公主。
manualTranslations.literal: In the seventh month of the fourth year he inherited enfeoffment as King of Lu and married Princess Duoerzhiban.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the following year he inherited the title King of Lu and married Princess Duoerzhiban.

manualTranslations.zh: 元統元年，阿里嘉失利薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Yuantong Alijiashili died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In 1333 Alijiashili died.

manualTranslations.zh: 至順間，封朵兒只班號肅雍賢寧公主。
manualTranslations.literal: During Zhishun Duoerzhiban was enfeoffed Princess Suoyong Xianning.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Zhishun Duoerzhiban was enfeoffed as Princess Suoyong Xianning.

manualTranslations.zh: 桑哥不剌者，魯王琱阿不剌之弟、阿里嘉室利之叔也。
manualTranslations.literal: Sangebubula was King of Lu Diaobubulas younger brother and Alijiashilis uncle.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Sangebubula was the younger brother of King of Lu Diaobubula and uncle of Alijiashili.

manualTranslations.zh: 自幼奉世皇旨，養于斡可珍公主所，是為不只兒駙馬，後襲統其本部民四百戶。
manualTranslations.literal: From youth by Shizu emperors order he was raised in Princess Wokezhens household and became the consort Bozhuer; later he inherited command of four hundred households of his tribes people.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From childhood, by Kublais order, he was raised in Princess Wokezhens household and became the consort Bozhuer; later he inherited four hundred households of his tribes people.

manualTranslations.zh: 成宗時，奉旨尚普納公主；
manualTranslations.literal: In Chengzongs time by imperial order he married Princess Puna;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Under Temür he was ordered to marry Princess Puna;

manualTranslations.zh: 至順間，封鄆安大長公主，授桑哥不剌金印，封鄆安王，職千戶。
manualTranslations.literal: during Zhishun she was enfeoffed Grand Princess of Yun'an; Sangebubula was granted a gold seal and enfeoffed King of Yun'an with the office of chiliarch.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: during Zhishun she was made Grand Princess of Yun'an; Sangebubula received a gold seal and was enfeoffed as King of Yun'an with a chiliarchate.

manualTranslations.zh: 元統元年，授萬戶。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Yuantong he was appointed myriarch.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In 1333 he was appointed myriarch.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年三月，加封鄆安公主號皇姑大長公主；
manualTranslations.literal: In the third month of the second year the Princess of Yun'an was further enfeoffed Imperial Paternal Aunt Grand Princess;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third month of the following year the Princess of Yun'an was further titled Imperial Paternal Aunt, Grand Princess;

manualTranslations.zh: 加封桑哥不剌魯王。
manualTranslations.literal: Sangebubula was further enfeoffed King of Lu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: and Sangebubula was further enfeoffed as King of Lu.

manualTranslations.zh: 以疾薨，年六十一。
manualTranslations.literal: He died of illness at age sixty-one.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died of illness at the age of sixty-one.

manualTranslations.zh: 此皆以駙馬襲封王爵者也。
manualTranslations.literal: These all inherited princely rank through service as imperial consorts.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: These all inherited princely titles through imperial marriage.

items.acceptedSourceText: 特薛禪，姓孛思忽兒，弘吉剌氏，世居朔漠。本名特，因從太祖起兵有功，賜名薛禪，故兼稱曰特薛禪。女曰孛兒台，太祖光獻翼聖皇后。子曰按陳，從太祖征伐，凡三十二戰，平西夏，斷潼關道，取回紇尋斯干城，皆與有功。歲丁亥，賜號國舅按陳那顏。壬辰，賜銀印，封河西王，以統其國族。丁酉，賜錢二十萬緡，有旨：「弘吉剌氏生女世以為后，生男世尚公主，每歲四時孟月，聽讀所賜旨，世世不絕。」又賜所俘獲軍民五千二百，仍授萬戶以領之。按陳薨，葬官人山。元貞元年二月，追封濟寧王，諡忠武；妻哈真，追封濟寧王妃。子斡陳，歲戊戌授萬戶，尚睿宗女也速不花公主。斡陳薨，葬不海韓。弟納陳，歲丁巳襲萬戶，奉旨伐宋，攻釣魚山。又從世祖南涉淮甸，下大清口，獲船百餘艘。又率兵平山東濟、兖、單等州。及阿里不哥叛，中統二年與諸王北伐，以其子哈海、脫歡、斡羅陳等十人自從，至于莽來，由失木魯與阿里不哥之黨八兒哈八兒思等戰，追北至孛羅克禿，復戰，自旦及夕，斬首萬級，僵尸被野。薨，葬末懷禿。斡羅陳襲萬戶，尚完澤公主。完澤公主薨，繼尚囊加真公主。至元十四年薨，葬拓剌里。無子。弟曰帖木兒，至元十八年襲萬戶。二十四年，乃顏叛，從帝親征，以功封濟寧郡王，賜白傘蓋以寵之。二十五年，諸王哈丹禿魯干叛，與諸王及統兵官玉速帖木兒等率兵討之，由龜剌河與哈丹等遇，轉戰至惱木連河，殲其眾。帝賜名按（察）〔答〕兒禿那顏，以旌其功。薨，葬末懷禿。子二人：長曰琱阿不剌，次曰桑哥不剌，皆幼。至元二十七年，以其弟蠻子台襲萬戶。亦尚囊加真公主。成宗即位，封皇姑魯國大長公主，以金印封蠻子台為濟寧王。奉旨率本部兵討叛王海都、篤哇，既與之遇，方約戰，行伍未定，單騎突入陣中，往復數四，敵兵大擾，一戰遂大捷。時武宗在藩邸，統大軍以鎮朔方，有旨令蠻子台總領蒙古軍民官，轉武宗守莽來，以遏北方。囊加真公主薨，繼尚裕宗女喃哥不剌公主。蠻子台薨，年五十有二。大德十一年三月，按答兒禿長子琱阿不剌襲萬戶，尚祥哥剌吉公主。六月，封大長公主，賜琱阿不剌金印，加封魯王。至大二年，賜平江稻田一千五百頃。皇慶間，加封皇姊大長公主。天曆間，加號皇姑徽文懿福（真）〔貞〕壽大長公主。至大三年，琱阿不剌薨，葬末懷禿。阿里嘉室利，琱阿不剌嫡子也。至大三年，甫八歲，襲萬戶。四年七月，襲封魯王，尚朵兒只班公主。元統元年，阿里嘉失利薨。至順間，封朵兒只班號肅雍賢寧公主。桑哥不剌者，魯王琱阿不剌之弟、阿里嘉室利之叔也。自幼奉世皇旨，養于斡可珍公主所，是為不只兒駙馬，後襲統其本部民四百戶。成宗時，奉旨尚普納公主；至順間，封鄆安大長公主，授桑哥不剌金印，封鄆安王，職千戶。元統元年，授萬戶。二年三月，加封鄆安公主號皇姑大長公主；加封桑哥不剌魯王。以疾薨，年六十一。此皆以駙馬襲封王爵者也。

sourceRange.text: 子阿失，事成宗。篤哇叛于海都，帝遣晉王甘麻剌并武宗帥師討之。大德五年，戰哈剌答山，阿失射篤哇中其膝，擒殺甚多，篤哇號哭而遁，武宗賜之衣。成宗加賜珠衣，封為昌王，置王府官屬。仁宗朝，復賜以寧昌縣稅入。阿失尚成宗女亦里哈牙公主，復尚憲宗曾孫女買的公主。阿失薨，子八剌失里襲封昌王。忽憐從弟不花，尚世祖女兀魯真公主；其弟鎖郎哈，娶皇子忙哥剌女奴兀倫公主，生女，是為武宗仁獻章聖皇后，實生明宗。阿剌兀思剔吉忽里，汪古部人，係出沙陀雁門之後。

localRange.text: ○阿剌兀思剔吉忽裏阿剌兀思剔吉忽裏，汪古部人，系出沙陀雁門之後。

manualTranslations.zh: 子阿失，事成宗。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Ash served Chengzong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Ash served Temür.

manualTranslations.zh: 篤哇叛于海都，帝遣晉王甘麻剌并武宗帥師討之。
manualTranslations.literal: When Duwa rebelled alongside Qaidu, the emperor dispatched Prince of Jin Gamala together with Wuzong to command troops against them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Duwa rebelled with Qaidu, the emperor sent Prince of Jin Gamala and Wuzong at the head of an army to suppress them.

manualTranslations.zh: 大德五年，戰哈剌答山，阿失射篤哇中其膝，擒殺甚多，篤哇號哭而遁，武宗賜之衣。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth year of Dade they fought at Mount Halada; Ash shot Duwa in the knee, captured and killed many; Duwa wailed and fled; Wuzong granted him clothing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In 1301 at Mount Halada, Ash shot Duwa in the knee, killed or captured many of his men, and drove Duwa off in tears; Wuzong rewarded him with garments.

manualTranslations.zh: 成宗加賜珠衣，封為昌王，置王府官屬。
manualTranslations.literal: Chengzong further granted pearl garments, enfeoffed him as King of Chang, and established princely household offices.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Temür added pearl robes, enfeoffed him as King of Chang, and established a princely household staff.

manualTranslations.zh: 仁宗朝，復賜以寧昌縣稅入。
manualTranslations.literal: In Renzongs reign he was again granted the tax revenue of Ningchang County.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Under Renzong he was again granted the tax revenue of Ningchang County.

manualTranslations.zh: 阿失尚成宗女亦里哈牙公主，復尚憲宗曾孫女買的公主。
manualTranslations.literal: Ash married Chengzongs daughter Princess Yilihaya and later Möngkes great-granddaughter Princess Maide.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Ash married Temürs daughter Princess Yilihaya and later Möngkes great-granddaughter Princess Maide.

manualTranslations.zh: 阿失薨，子八剌失里襲封昌王。
manualTranslations.literal: Ash died; his son Balashili inherited enfeoffment as King of Chang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Ash died, his son Balashili inherited the title King of Chang.

manualTranslations.zh: 忽憐從弟不花，尚世祖女兀魯真公主；
manualTranslations.literal: Hulians younger cousin Buhua married Shizus daughter Princess Wuluzhen;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Hulians cousin Buhua married Kublais daughter Princess Wuluzhen;

manualTranslations.zh: 其弟鎖郎哈，娶皇子忙哥剌女奴兀倫公主，生女，是為武宗仁獻章聖皇后，實生明宗。
manualTranslations.literal: his younger brother Suolangha married Prince Mangge'as daughter Princess Nuwulun; the daughter born was Wuzongs Benevolent Offering Sagely Empress, who in fact bore Mingzong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: his younger brother Suolangha married Prince Mangge'as daughter Princess Nuwulun; their daughter became Wuzongs Benevolent Offering Sagely Empress and bore Mingzong.

manualTranslations.zh: 阿剌兀思剔吉忽里，汪古部人，係出沙陀雁門之後。
manualTranslations.literal: Alawusitijihuli, a man of the Onggut tribe, traced his lineage to the Shatuo of Yanmen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Alawusitijihuli, of the Onggut tribe, traced his descent to the Shatuo of Yanmen.

sourceRange.text: 阿剌兀思剔吉忽里先期而至。既平乃蠻，從下中原，復為嚮導，南出界垣。太祖留阿剌兀思剔吉忽里歸鎮本部，為其部眾昔之異議者所殺，長子不顏昔班併死之。其妻阿里黑攜幼子孛要合與姪鎮國逃難，夜遁至界垣，告守者，縋城以登，因避地雲中。太祖既定雲中，購求得之，賜與甚厚，乃追封阿剌兀思剔吉忽里為高唐王，阿里黑為高唐王妃，以其子孛要合尚幼，先封其姪鎮國為北平王。鎮國薨，子聶古台襲爵，尚睿宗女獨木干公主，略地江淮，薨于軍，賜興州民千餘戶，給其葬。孛要合幼從攻西域，還封北平王，尚阿剌海別吉公主。公主明睿有智略，車駕征伐四出，嘗使留守，軍國大政，諮禀而後行，師出無內顧之憂，公主之力居多。孛要合未有子，公主為進姬妾，以廣嗣續，生三子：曰君不花，曰愛不花，曰拙里不花。公主視之，皆如己出。孛要合薨，追封高唐王，諡武毅。後加贈宣忠協力翊衞果毅功臣、太傅、儀同三司、上柱國、駙馬都尉，追封趙王。公主阿剌海別吉追封皇祖姑齊國大長公主，加封趙國。子君不花，尚定宗長女葉里迷失公主。

localRange.text: 阿剌兀思剔吉忽裏先期而至。既平乃蠻，從下中原，復為向導，南出界垣。太祖留阿剌兀思剔吉忽裏歸鎮本部，為其部眾昔之異議者所殺，長子不顏昔班並死之。其妻阿裏黑攜幼子孛要合與侄鎮國逃難，夜遁至界垣，告守者，縋城以登，因避地雲中。太祖既定雲中，購求得之，賜與甚厚，乃追封阿剌兀思剔吉忽裏為高唐王，阿裏黑為高唐王妃，以其子孛要合尚幼，先封其侄鎮國為北平王。鎮國薨，子聶古臺襲爵，尚睿宗女獨木幹公主，略地江淮，薨於軍，賜興州民千餘戶，給其葬。子君不花，尚定宗長女葉裏迷失公主。

manualTranslations.zh: 阿剌兀思剔吉忽里先期而至。
manualTranslations.literal: Alawusitijihuli arrived ahead of schedule.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Alawusitijihuli arrived ahead of the main army.

manualTranslations.zh: 既平乃蠻，從下中原，復為嚮導，南出界垣。
manualTranslations.literal: After the Naiman were pacified, he followed in reducing the Central Plains, again serving as guide, and went south beyond the border ramparts.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After the Naiman were defeated he joined the conquest of the Central Plains, again serving as guide, and led the army south beyond the border walls.

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖留阿剌兀思剔吉忽里歸鎮本部，為其部眾昔之異議者所殺，長子不顏昔班併死之。
manualTranslations.literal: Taizu left Alawusitijihuli to return and garrison his own tribe; he was killed by tribesmen who had formerly dissented, and his eldest son Buyanxiban died with him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Genghis Khan left Alawusitijihuli to govern his tribe, but he was killed by former dissenters among his people; his eldest son Buyanxiban died with him.

manualTranslations.zh: 其妻阿里黑攜幼子孛要合與姪鎮國逃難，夜遁至界垣，告守者，縋城以登，因避地雲中。
manualTranslations.literal: His wife Alihei took the young son Xueyaohe and nephew Zhenguo in flight; by night they escaped to the border ramparts, told the guards, were hauled up the wall by rope, and thus took refuge in Yunzhong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His wife Alihei fled with the infant Xueyaohe and nephew Zhenguo. By night they reached the border wall, persuaded the guards to haul them up by rope, and took refuge in Yunzhong.

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖既定雲中，購求得之，賜與甚厚，乃追封阿剌兀思剔吉忽里為高唐王，阿里黑為高唐王妃，以其子孛要合尚幼，先封其姪鎮國為北平王。
manualTranslations.literal: After Taizu had secured Yunzhong, he sought them by reward and obtained them, granting gifts very generously; he then posthumously enfeoffed Alawusitijihuli as King of Gaotang and Alihei as Princess of Gaotang; because his son Xueyaohe was still young, he first enfeoffed his nephew Zhenguo as King of Beiping.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Genghis Khan secured Yunzhong he found them through a reward offer and treated them generously. He posthumously enfeoffed Alawusitijihuli as King of Gaotang and Alihei as Princess of Gaotang. Because Xueyaohe was still young, he first enfeoffed the nephew Zhenguo as King of Beiping.

manualTranslations.zh: 鎮國薨，子聶古台襲爵，尚睿宗女獨木干公主，略地江淮，薨于軍，賜興州民千餘戶，給其葬。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhenguo died; his son Nieguotai inherited the rank, married Ruizongs daughter Princess Dumugan, overran the Jiang-Huai region, died in the army, and was granted more than a thousand households of Xingzhou for his burial.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Zhenguo died his son Nieguotai inherited the title and married Toluis daughter Princess Dumugan. He campaigned across the Jiang-Huai region and died on campaign; more than a thousand households of Xingzhou were granted for his funeral.

manualTranslations.zh: 孛要合幼從攻西域，還封北平王，尚阿剌海別吉公主。
manualTranslations.literal: Xueyaohe in youth followed in attacking the Western Regions; on return he was enfeoffed King of Beiping and married Princess Alahaibieji.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xueyaohe campaigned in the Western Regions as a youth and, on his return, was enfeoffed as King of Beiping and married Princess Alahaibieji.

manualTranslations.zh: 公主明睿有智略，車駕征伐四出，嘗使留守，軍國大政，諮禀而後行，師出無內顧之憂，公主之力居多。
manualTranslations.literal: The princess was bright and wise in counsel; when the imperial carriage campaigned in all directions she was often left to hold the capital; on great affairs of army and state he consulted and reported before acting; on campaign he had no worry of affairs at home—the princesss power was greatest in this.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The princess was intelligent and resourceful. When the emperor campaigned abroad she often remained as regent; on major military and state affairs he consulted her before acting, and marched without fear for affairs at home—largely through her strength.

manualTranslations.zh: 孛要合未有子，公主為進姬妾，以廣嗣續，生三子：曰君不花，曰愛不花，曰拙里不花。
manualTranslations.literal: Xueyaohe had no son; the princess presented concubines to broaden succession, bearing three sons: Junbuhua, Aibuhua, and Zhuolibuhua.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because Xueyaohe had no sons, the princess presented concubines to secure the succession, and three sons were born: Junbuhua, Aibuhua, and Zhuolibuhua.

manualTranslations.zh: 公主視之，皆如己出。
manualTranslations.literal: The princess regarded them all as her own offspring.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The princess treated them all as her own children.

manualTranslations.zh: 孛要合薨，追封高唐王，諡武毅。
manualTranslations.literal: Xueyaohe died; posthumously enfeoffed King of Gaotang with posthumous epithet Martial and Resolute.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Xueyaohe died he was posthumously enfeoffed as King of Gaotang with the epithet Martial and Resolute.

manualTranslations.zh: 後加贈宣忠協力翊衞果毅功臣、太傅、儀同三司、上柱國、駙馬都尉，追封趙王。
manualTranslations.literal: Later he was further granted the merit titles Proclaiming Loyalty in Joint Endeavor in Assisting Guardianship, Firm and Resolute, Grand Tutor, Equal in Rank to the Three Excellencies, Chief Pillar of State, and Consort Commandant, and posthumously enfeoffed King of Zhao.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later he received the titles Proclaiming Loyalty in Joint Endeavor in Assisting Guardianship, Firm and Resolute, Grand Tutor, Equal in Rank to the Three Excellencies, Chief Pillar of State, and Consort Commandant, and was posthumously enfeoffed as King of Zhao.

manualTranslations.zh: 公主阿剌海別吉追封皇祖姑齊國大長公主，加封趙國。

sourceRange.text: 塔塔兒台，孔溫窟哇第三子帶孫郡王之後。父曰忙哥，從憲宗征伐，累立戰功。歲己未，攻合州，會憲宗崩，命塔塔兒台護靈駕赴北。會阿里不哥叛，拘留數日，逃歸，追騎執以北還，將殺之，親王阿速台、玉龍塔思曰：「塔塔兒台乃太師國王之裔，不可殺也。」遂獲免。至元元年，從阿速台來歸，世祖嘉之，授懷遠大將軍，佩金虎符，世襲東平達魯花赤。命宿衞士四十人，給驛送之官所。莅官一紀，鎮靜不擾，鄆人賴之以安。卒年四十二，子四人。

sourceRange.text: 太宗即位，從略河南。北還清水答蘭答八之地，賜馬三百、珠衣、金帶、鞍勒。皇子闊出、忽都禿伐宋，命察罕為斥候。又從親王口溫不花南伐，歲乙未，克棗陽，及光化軍。未幾，召口溫不花赴行在，以全軍付察罕。丁酉，復與口溫不花進克光州。戊戌，授馬步軍都元帥，率諸翼軍攻拔天長縣，及滁、壽、泗等州。定宗即位，賜黑貂裘一、鑌刀十，命拓江淮地。憲宗即位，召見，累賜金五十兩、珠衣一、金綺二匹，以都元帥兼領尚書省事，賜汴梁、歸德、河南、懷、孟、曹、濮、太原三千餘戶為食邑，及諸處草地，合一萬四千五百餘頃，戶二萬餘。未幾，復召，賜金四百五十兩、金綺、弓矢等物。乙卯卒。贈推忠開濟翊運功臣、開府儀同三司、上柱國，追封河南王，諡武宣。子十人，長木花里。木花里事憲宗，直宿衞，從攻釣魚山，以功授四斡耳朵怯憐口千戶，賜金幣及黃金馬鞍勒。世祖即位，賜金五十兩、珠二串。至元四年，攻宋，自江陵略地回，至安陽灘，宋兵扼其歸路，木花里奮擊敗之。都元帥阿朮墜馬，宋軍追及之，木花里挾之上馬鏖戰，退宋兵，由是得免。特賜銀二百五十兩，佩金虎符。為蒙古軍萬戶。復攻襄樊有功，卒于軍。贈推誠宣力功臣、榮祿大夫、平章政事、柱國，追封梁國公，諡武毅。從孫亦力撒合。亦力撒合，祖曲也怯律。太祖時，得召見，屬皇子察哈台，為札魯火赤。

localRange.text: 亦力撒合，祖曲也怯祖。太祖時，得召見，屬皇子察哈臺，為紥魯火赤。

sourceRange.text: 大德元年，叛王藥木忽兒、兀魯速不花來歸。博羅歡聞之，遣使馳奏曰：「諸王之叛，皆由其父，此輩幼弱，無所與知。今茲來歸，宜棄其前惡，以勸未至。」帝深以為然，賜金鞍勒，命以平章政事行省湖廣。會并福建行省入江浙，拜光祿大夫、上柱國、江浙等處行中書省平章政事。居歲餘，卒，年六十三。

manualTranslations.zh: 博羅歡聞之，遣使馳奏曰：「諸王之叛，皆由其父，此輩幼弱，無所與知。今茲來歸，宜棄其前惡，以勸未至。」
manualTranslations.literal: Boluohuan heard of it and sent a fast messenger to memorialize: "The princes' rebellion was all due to their fathers; these are young and weak and had no part in knowing it. Now that they have come to submit, their former wrongs should be set aside to encourage those who have not yet come."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Boluohuan heard this, he sent a fast courier to memorialize: "The princes rebelled only because of their fathers; these are young and had no part in it. Now that they have returned, their past offenses should be set aside to encourage those still holding out."

sourceRange.text: 按竺邇遣將直擣江油，奪扈、牛以歸。中統元年，世祖即位，親王有異謀者，其將阿藍答兒、渾都海圖據關隴。時按竺邇以老，委軍於其子。帝遣宗王哈丹、哈必赤、阿曷馬西討。按竺邇曰：「今內難方殷，浸亂關隴，豈臣子安臥之時耶？吾雖老，尚能破賊。」遂引兵出刪丹之耀碑谷，從阿曷馬，與之合戰。會大風，晝晦，戰至晡，大敗之，斬馘無算。按竺邇與總帥汪良臣獲阿藍答兒、渾都海等。捷聞，帝錫璽書襃美，賜弓矢錦衣。四年，卒，年六十九。延祐元年，贈推忠佐運功臣、太保、儀同三司、上柱國，封秦國公，諡武宣。

sourceRange.text: 子帖木迭兒襲為迭只斡耳朵千戶，累遷宣徽院使，遙授左丞相。哈散納，怯烈亦氏。太祖時，從征王罕有功，命同飲班朱尼河之水，且曰：「與我共飲此水者，世為我用。」後管領阿兒渾軍，從太祖征西域，下薛迷則（于）〔干〕、不花剌等城。至太宗時，仍命領阿兒渾軍，併回回人匠三千戶駐于蕁麻林。尋授平陽、太原兩路達魯花赤，兼管諸色人匠，後以疾卒。子捏古伯襲，從憲宗攻釣魚山，有功，以疾卒。子撒的迷失襲。撒的迷失卒，子木八剌襲，充貴赤千戶，遷西域親軍副都指揮使，大德元年卒。弟禿滿答襲，禿滿答卒，子哈剌章襲。

localRange.text: 子帖木叠兒襲為叠只斡耳朵千戶，累遷宣徽院使，遙授左丞相。○哈散納

context.beforeSource: 成宗時，拜宣徽使，加大司徒，卒。

manualTranslations.literal: Son Temür-Ochir inherited as Dieji Ordo chiliarch, repeatedly rose to Palace Administration commissioner, and was remotely granted left chancellor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Temür-Ochir succeeded to the Dieji Ordo chiliarchy, rose to head the Palace Administration, and was given the honorary title of left chancellor.

manualTranslations.literal: Hasanna, of the Qarluq clan.

manualTranslations.literal: In Taizu's time he followed the campaign against Wang Khan with merit; he was ordered to drink together the waters of the Baljuna River, and it was said: "Whoever drinks this water with me shall serve me for generations."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Under Genghis Khan he followed the campaign against Wang Khan with distinction and was ordered to drink the waters of the Baljuna River with the Khan, who said, "Whoever drinks this water with me shall serve me for generations."

manualTranslations.literal: At Ögedei's time he was still ordered to command the Arqun army, and three thousand Muslim artisan households were combined and stationed at Xunmalin.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Under Ögedei he was still ordered to command the Arqun army, with three thousand Muslim artisan households combined and stationed at Xunmalin.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed darughachi of the Pingyang and Taiyuan circuits, concurrently overseeing artisans of every category, and later died of illness.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Negübei succeeded, followed Möngke in attacking Diaoyu Mountain with distinction, and died of illness.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Sadrashim succeeded.

manualTranslations.literal: When Sadrashim died, son Mubarak succeeded, served as qaračin chiliarch, was transferred to vice commander of the Western Regions personal army, and died in the first year of Dade.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Sadrashim died, his son Mubarak succeeded, served as qaračin chiliarch, was transferred to vice commander of the Western Regions personal army, and died in Dade 1 (1297).

manualTranslations.idiomatic: His younger brother Tümandai succeeded; when Tümandai died, his son Qara-Jang succeeded.

sourceRange.text: 子紐林的斤，尚幼，詣闕請兵北征，以復父讎。帝壯其志，賜金幣巨萬，妻以公主曰不魯罕，太宗之孫女也。公主薨，又尚其妹曰八卜叉。有旨師出河西，俟北征諸軍齊發，遂留永昌。會吐蕃脫思麻作亂，詔以榮祿大夫平章政事，領本部探馬等軍萬人鎮吐蕃宣慰司。威德明信，賊用斂迹，其民賴以安。武宗召還，嗣為亦都護，賜之金印，復署其部押西護司之官。仁宗始稽故實，封為高昌王，別以金印賜之，設王傅之官。其王印行諸內郡，亦都護印行諸畏兀兒之境。八卜叉公主薨，復尚公主曰兀剌真，安西王之女也。領兵火州，復立畏兀兒城池。延祐五年薨。子二人，長曰帖木兒補化，次曰籛吉，皆八卜叉公主所生也。

manualTranslations.zh: 子紐林的斤，尚幼，詣闕請兵北征，以復父讎。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Niulindijin, still young, came to court to request troops for a northern campaign to avenge his father.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Niulindijin, though still young, came to court to request troops for a northern campaign to avenge his father.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝壯其志，賜金幣巨萬，妻以公主曰不魯罕，太宗之孫女也。
manualTranslations.literal: The Emperor admired his resolve, bestowed gold and currency in vast sums, and gave him in marriage the Princess Buluhan, a granddaughter of Ögedei.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Emperor admired his resolve, granted gold and currency in vast sums, and married him to Princess Buluhan, a granddaughter of Ögedei.

manualTranslations.zh: 公主薨，又尚其妹曰八卜叉。
manualTranslations.literal: When the princess died, he next married her younger sister Babacha.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After the princess died, he married her younger sister Babacha.

manualTranslations.zh: 有旨師出河西，俟北征諸軍齊發，遂留永昌。
manualTranslations.literal: An edict ordered the army out through Hexi, to wait until all northern campaign forces assembled before advancing; he therefore remained at Yongchang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the army to march out through Hexi and wait until all northern campaign forces were ready; he therefore remained at Yongchang.

manualTranslations.zh: 會吐蕃脫思麻作亂，詔以榮祿大夫平章政事，領本部探馬等軍萬人鎮吐蕃宣慰司。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Tibetan Tuosima rebelled, an edict appointed him Grand Master for Splendid Happiness and Pingzhang, commanding ten thousand men of his tribal scouts and other troops to garrison the Tibetan Pacification Commission.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Tibetan Tuosima rebelled, he was appointed Grand Master for Splendid Happiness and Pingzhang, leading ten thousand men of his scouts and other troops to garrison the Tibetan Pacification Commission.

manualTranslations.zh: 威德明信，賊用斂迹，其民賴以安。
manualTranslations.literal: His authority, virtue, and trustworthy word made the rebels withdraw; the people relied on him for peace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His authority and trustworthy rule made the rebels withdraw, and the people were thereby secured.

manualTranslations.zh: 武宗召還，嗣為亦都護，賜之金印，復署其部押西護司之官。
manualTranslations.literal: Wuzong recalled him; he succeeded as Idiqut, was granted a gold seal, and again appointed officials of his tribe's Yaxi Guard Office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wuzong recalled him; he succeeded as Idiqut, received a gold seal, and again appointed officials of his tribe's Yaxi Guard Office.

manualTranslations.zh: 仁宗始稽故實，封為高昌王，別以金印賜之，設王傅之官。
manualTranslations.literal: Renzong then examined ancient precedent, enfeoffed him as King of Gaochang, granted a separate gold seal, and established the office of royal tutor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Renzong then examined precedent, enfeoffed him as King of Gaochang, granted a separate gold seal, and established the office of royal tutor.

manualTranslations.zh: 其王印行諸內郡，亦都護印行諸畏兀兒之境。
manualTranslations.literal: The king's seal was used in the inner commanderies; the Idiqut seal was used in Uyghur territory.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The king's seal was used in the inner commanderies, while the Idiqut seal was used in Uyghur lands.

manualTranslations.zh: 八卜叉公主薨，復尚公主曰兀剌真，安西王之女也。
manualTranslations.literal: When Princess Babacha died, he again married the Princess Wulazhen, daughter of the Prince of Anxi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Princess Babacha died, he married Princess Wulazhen, daughter of the Prince of Anxi.

manualTranslations.zh: 領兵火州，復立畏兀兒城池。
manualTranslations.literal: He led troops at Huozhou and restored Uyghur city defenses.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He led troops at Huozhou and restored the Uyghur cities.

manualTranslations.zh: 延祐五年薨。
manualTranslations.literal: He died in the fifth year of Yanyou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died in the fifth year of Yanyou (1318).

manualTranslations.zh: 子二人，長曰帖木兒補化，次曰籛吉，皆八卜叉公主所生也。
manualTranslations.literal: He had two sons: the elder Temür Buqa and the younger Jij, both born of Princess Babacha.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He had two sons: the elder Temür Buqa and the younger Jij, both children of Princess Babacha.

sourceRange.text: 其弟籛吉乃以讓嗣為亦都護、高昌王。鐵邁赤，合魯氏。善騎射，初事忽蘭皇后帳前，嘗命為挏馬官。從太祖定西夏。又從皇子闊出、忽都〔禿〕、行省鐵木答兒定河南，累有戰功。憲宗之伐宋也，世祖以皇弟受命攻鄂。大駕征西川，遣元帥兀良哈台自交趾擣宋，與諸軍合。歲己未，皇弟駐兵鄂渚，聞兀良哈台由廣西至長沙，遣鐵邁赤將練卒千人、鐵騎三千迎兀良哈台于岳州。兀良哈台得援，抵江夏，北涉黃州，鐵邁赤與有力焉。世祖即位，命從征叛王于失木土之地，勞績益著。至元七年，授蒙古諸萬戶府奧魯總管。十九年，以疾卒。子八人，虎都鐵木祿最顯。

manualTranslations.zh: 其弟籛吉乃以讓嗣為亦都護、高昌王。
manualTranslations.literal: His younger brother Jijinai received the succession as Idiqut and King of Gaochang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His younger brother Jijinai received the succession as Idiqut and King of Gaochang.

manualTranslations.zh: 鐵邁赤，合魯氏。
manualTranslations.literal: Tiemaichi, of the Helu clan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tiemaichi belonged to the Helu clan.

manualTranslations.zh: 善騎射，初事忽蘭皇后帳前，嘗命為挏馬官。
manualTranslations.literal: Skilled in riding and archery, he first served before the tent of Empress Hulan and was once appointed milch-horse officer.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Skilled in riding and archery, he first served in Empress Hulan's camp and was once appointed milch-horse officer.

manualTranslations.zh: 從太祖定西夏。
manualTranslations.literal: He followed Taizu in pacifying Western Xia.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He followed Genghis Khan in pacifying Western Xia.

manualTranslations.zh: 又從皇子闊出、忽都禿、行省鐵木答兒定河南，累有戰功。
manualTranslations.literal: He also followed Princes Kuochu and Qutu, and the Branch Secretariat commander Temüdar, in pacifying Henan, repeatedly winning battle merit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He also followed Princes Kuochu and Qutu and Branch Secretariat commander Temüdar in pacifying Henan, winning repeated distinction in battle.

manualTranslations.zh: 憲宗之伐宋也，世祖以皇弟受命攻鄂。
manualTranslations.literal: When Möngke campaigned against Song, Khubilai as imperial younger brother received orders to attack E.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Möngke campaigned against the Song, Khubilai as imperial younger brother was ordered to attack Ezhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 大駕征西川，遣元帥兀良哈台自交趾擣宋，與諸軍合。
manualTranslations.literal: The imperial procession campaigned in western Sichuan and sent Marshal Uriyangqadai to strike Song from Annam and join the other armies.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The imperial host campaigned in western Sichuan and sent Marshal Uriyangqadai to strike the Song from Annam and unite with the other forces.

manualTranslations.zh: 歲己未，皇弟駐兵鄂渚，聞兀良哈台由廣西至長沙，遣鐵邁赤將練卒千人、鐵騎三千迎兀良哈台于岳州。
manualTranslations.literal: In the year jiwei the imperial younger brother encamped at Ezhou; hearing that Uriyangqadai was coming from Guangxi to Changsha, he sent Tiemaichi with one thousand trained soldiers and three thousand iron cavalry to meet Uriyangqadai at Yuezhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In jiwei (1259) the imperial younger brother encamped at Ezhou. Hearing that Uriyangqadai was advancing from Guangxi toward Changsha, he sent Tiemaichi with one thousand trained soldiers and three thousand armored cavalry to meet Uriyangqadai at Yuezhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 兀良哈台得援，抵江夏，北涉黃州，鐵邁赤與有力焉。
manualTranslations.literal: Uriyangqadai received the relief, reached Jiangxia, and crossed north through Huangzhou; Tiemaichi contributed force to this.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Uriyangqadai received the relief, reached Jiangxia, and crossed north through Huangzhou, with Tiemaichi playing a major part.

manualTranslations.zh: 世祖即位，命從征叛王于失木土之地，勞績益著。
manualTranslations.literal: When Khubilai took the throne, he was ordered to follow the campaign against rebel princes at Shimu, and his labor and merit became still more notable.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Khubilai took the throne, he was ordered to campaign against rebel princes at Shimu, and his service became still more distinguished.

manualTranslations.zh: 至元七年，授蒙古諸萬戶府奧魯總管。
manualTranslations.literal: In the seventh year of Zhiyuan he was appointed overseer of the Mongol Myriarchies' registered households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 7 (1270) he was appointed overseer of the Mongol myriarchies' registered households.

manualTranslations.zh: 十九年，以疾卒。
manualTranslations.literal: In the nineteenth year he died of illness.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year he died of illness.

manualTranslations.zh: 子八人，虎都鐵木祿最顯。
manualTranslations.literal: He had eight sons; Hudutieimu Lu was the most prominent.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He had eight sons; Hudutieimu Lu was the most prominent.

sourceRange.text: 唵木海，蒙古八剌忽䚟氏，與父孛合出俱事太祖，征伐有功。帝嘗問攻城略地，兵仗何先，對曰：「攻城以砲石為先，力重而能及遠故也。」帝悅，即命為砲手。歲甲戌，太師國王木華黎南伐，帝諭之曰：「唵木海言攻城用砲之策甚善，汝能任之，何城不破？」即授金符，使為隨路砲手達魯花赤。唵木海選五百餘人教習之，後定諸國，多賴其力。太宗即位，留為近侍，以講武藝。歲壬辰，從攻河南有功。壬子，憲宗特授虎符，陞都元帥。癸丑，從宗王旭烈兀征剌里西番、斜巨山、桃里寺、河西諸部，悉下之。卒，子忒木台兒以從戰功授金符，襲砲手總管。至元十年，修立正陽東西二城，置砲二百餘座，與宋人戰，却之。十三年，從丞相伯顏伐宋，駐軍臨安之臯亭山，同忙古歹等八人率甲三百入宋宮，取傳國寶。宋太后請解兵延見內殿，期明日奉寶乞降，至期，果遣賈餘慶等奉寶至軍前。以功授行省斷事官，復令其子忽都答兒襲砲手總管。十四年，進昭勇大將軍砲手萬戶，佩元降虎符，鎮平江之常熟。

localRange.text: ○唵木海至元十年，修立正陽東西二城，置炮二百餘座，與宋人戰，卻之。十三年，從丞相伯顏伐宋，駐軍臨安之阜亭山，同忙古歹等八人率甲三百入宋宮，取傳國寶。宋太后請解兵延見內殿，期明日奉寶乞降，至期，果遣賈余慶等奉寶至軍前。以功授行省斷事官，復令其子忽都答兒襲炮手總管。十四年，進昭勇大將軍炮手萬戶，佩元降虎符，鎮平江之常熟。

manualTranslations.zh: 唵木海，蒙古八剌忽䚟氏，與父孛合出俱事太祖，征伐有功。
manualTranslations.literal: Anmuhai, of the Balagun clan of the Mongols, together with his father Boqö served Taizu on campaigns and had merit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Anmuhai, of the Balagun clan of the Mongols, served Genghis Khan together with his father Boqö and won distinction on campaign.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝嘗問攻城略地，兵仗何先，對曰：「攻城以砲石為先，力重而能及遠故也。」
manualTranslations.literal: The Emperor once asked, in storming cities and seizing territory, what weapons should come first. He replied: "In storming cities, catapult stones come first, because their weight can reach far."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Emperor once asked which weapons should come first in storming cities and seizing territory. He replied, "In storming cities, catapult stones come first, because their weight lets them strike far."

manualTranslations.zh: 帝悅，即命為砲手。
manualTranslations.literal: The Emperor was pleased and immediately appointed him an artilleryman.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Emperor was pleased and immediately appointed him master of artillery.

manualTranslations.zh: 歲甲戌，太師國王木華黎南伐，帝諭之曰：「唵木海言攻城用砲之策甚善，汝能任之，何城不破？」
manualTranslations.literal: In the year jiaxu, Grand Preceptor and King Muqali campaigned south; the Emperor instructed him: "Anmuhai's plan for using artillery in storming cities is excellent. If you can take charge of it, what city will not fall?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In jiaxu (1214), when Grand Preceptor and King Muqali marched south, the Emperor told him, "Anmuhai's plan for using artillery in storming cities is excellent. If you can take charge of it, what city will not fall?"

manualTranslations.zh: 即授金符，使為隨路砲手達魯花赤。
manualTranslations.literal: He was immediately granted a gold tally and made route-wide darughachi of the artillery corps.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was immediately granted a gold tally and made route-wide darughachi of the artillery corps.

manualTranslations.zh: 唵木海選五百餘人教習之，後定諸國，多賴其力。
manualTranslations.literal: Anmuhai selected more than five hundred men to train them; afterward in pacifying the various states, much relied on his force.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Anmuhai selected more than five hundred men for training, and later the pacification of many states relied heavily on his corps.

manualTranslations.zh: 太宗即位，留為近侍，以講武藝。
manualTranslations.literal: When Ögedei took the throne, Anmuhai was kept in close attendance to instruct in martial arts.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Ögedei took the throne, Anmuhai was kept in close attendance to instruct in martial arts.

manualTranslations.zh: 歲壬辰，從攻河南有功。
manualTranslations.literal: In the year renchen he followed the attack on Henan with merit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In renchen (1232) he followed the attack on Henan with distinction.

manualTranslations.zh: 壬子，憲宗特授虎符，陞都元帥。
manualTranslations.literal: In renzi Möngke specially granted him a tiger tally and promoted him to grand commander.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In renzi (1252) Möngke specially granted him a tiger tally and promoted him to grand commander.

manualTranslations.zh: 癸丑，從宗王旭烈兀征剌里西番、斜巨山、桃里寺、河西諸部，悉下之。
manualTranslations.literal: In guichou he followed Prince Hülegü in campaigning against Lali Tibetans, Xiējushan, Taolisi, and the various districts of Hexi, and all were taken.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In guichou (1253) he followed Prince Hülegü against the Lali Tibetans, Xiējushan, Taolisi, and the districts of Hexi, and all were subdued.

manualTranslations.zh: 卒，子忒木台兒以從戰功授金符，襲砲手總管。
manualTranslations.literal: He died; his son Temütai'er, for following campaigns with merit, was granted a gold tally and inherited command of the artillery corps.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died; his son Temütai'er, for merit on campaign, received a gold tally and succeeded as commander of the artillery corps.

manualTranslations.zh: 至元十年，修立正陽東西二城，置砲二百餘座，與宋人戰，却之。
manualTranslations.literal: In the tenth year of Zhiyuan he repaired and established the eastern and western cities of Zhengyang, set up more than two hundred artillery emplacements, battled the Song, and repelled them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 10 (1273) he built the eastern and western fortresses at Zhengyang, emplaced more than two hundred artillery pieces, fought the Song, and drove them back.

manualTranslations.zh: 十三年，從丞相伯顏伐宋，駐軍臨安之臯亭山，同忙古歹等八人率甲三百入宋宮，取傳國寶。
manualTranslations.literal: In the thirteenth year he followed Chancellor Bayan in campaigning against Song, encamped at Gaoting Mountain near Lin'an, and together with Mangudai and eight others led three hundred armored men into the Song palace to take the imperial transmission seal.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In 1276 he followed Chancellor Bayan against the Song. The army encamped at Gaoting Mountain outside Lin'an; with Mangudai and seven others he led three hundred armored men into the Song palace to seize the imperial seal of transmission.

manualTranslations.zh: 宋太后請解兵延見內殿，期明日奉寶乞降，至期，果遣賈餘慶等奉寶至軍前。
manualTranslations.literal: The Song empress dowager requested dismissing troops and extending audience in the inner hall, arranged to present the treasure and beg surrender the next day; when the date arrived, indeed Jia Yuqing and others were sent to present the treasure before the army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Song empress dowager asked that hostilities cease and received them in the inner palace, promising to deliver the seal and sue for peace the next day. On the appointed day Jia Yuqing and others duly brought the seal to the Mongol camp.

manualTranslations.zh: 以功授行省斷事官，復令其子忽都答兒襲砲手總管。
manualTranslations.literal: For merit he was appointed Branch Secretariat judicial officer; again his son Hududar was ordered to inherit command of the artillery corps.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: For his service he was made a judicial officer of the branch secretariat, and his son Hududar was appointed to succeed him as commander of the artillery corps.

manualTranslations.zh: 十四年，進昭勇大將軍砲手萬戶，佩元降虎符，鎮平江之常熟。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was advanced to General of Manifest Courage, artillery myriarch; wore the Yuan surrender tiger tally; and guarded Changshu in Pingjiang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he was promoted to General of Manifest Courage and artillery myriarch, given a tiger tally, and posted to Changshu in Pingjiang.

sourceRange.text: 至元十五年，忙漢為管軍千戶。二十四年，從征乃顏。二十六年，從征海都。二十七年，宣授蒙古侍衞親軍千戶，佩金符。元貞元年，有旨命領探馬赤軍，偕哈伯元帥從宗王出伯西征，改授昭信校尉、右都威衞千戶。大德元年，召還。至大四年卒。子乃蠻襲。拙赤哥入宿衞，從世祖征鄂漢，以功賜白金。至元三年，從征李壇，戰死之。子闊闊朮為御史臺都事。至元三十一年，國王速渾察之子拾得既沒，其家有故璽，王將鬻之，命闊闊朮以示中丞崔彧、御史楊桓，辯其文曰：「受命于天，既壽永昌。」蓋秦璽也。彧請獻之徽仁裕聖皇后。后以鈔二千五百貫賜拾得家，金織文段二賜闊闊朮。成宗即位，近臣以其事聞，授闊闊朮漢中廉訪僉事，仕至湖南廉訪使。雪不台，蒙古部兀良罕氏。遠祖捏里弼生孛忽都，雄勇有智略。曾孫合飭溫生哈班、哈不里。哈班生二子：長虎魯渾，次雪不台。

localRange.text: ○雪不臺雪不臺，蒙古部兀良罕氏。遠祖捏裏弼生孛忽都，雄勇有智略。曾孫合飭溫生哈班、哈不裏。哈班生二子：長虎魯渾，次雪不臺。

context.beforeSource: 子忙漢、拙赤哥。
context.afterSource: 太祖初建興都于班朱泥河，今龍居河也。

manualTranslations.zh: 至元十五年，忙漢為管軍千戶。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Zhiyuan, Manghan became army-administering chiliarch.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 15 (1278) Manghan became army-administering chiliarch.

manualTranslations.zh: 二十四年，從征乃顏。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year he followed the campaign against Nayan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year he followed the campaign against Nayan.

manualTranslations.zh: 二十六年，從征海都。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year he followed the campaign against Qaidu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year he followed the campaign against Qaidu.

manualTranslations.zh: 二十七年，宣授蒙古侍衞親軍千戶，佩金符。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year he was proclaimed Mongol Palace Guard personal-army chiliarch and wore a gold tally.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year he was proclaimed Mongol Palace Guard personal-army chiliarch and wore a gold tally.

manualTranslations.zh: 元貞元年，有旨命領探馬赤軍，偕哈伯元帥從宗王出伯西征，改授昭信校尉、右都威衞千戶。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Yuanzhen an edict ordered him to command scout troops; together with Marshal Qabar he followed Prince Chuban on the western campaign; he was changed to Commandant of Manifest Integrity and chiliarch of the Right Capital Guard.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Yuanzhen 1 (1295) an edict ordered him to command scout troops; with Marshal Qabar he followed Prince Chuban on the western campaign and was appointed Commandant of Manifest Integrity and chiliarch of the Right Capital Guard.

manualTranslations.zh: 大德元年，召還。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Dade he was recalled.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Dade 1 (1297) he was recalled.

manualTranslations.zh: 至大四年卒。
manualTranslations.literal: He died in the fourth year of Zhida.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died in the fourth year of Zhida (1311).

manualTranslations.zh: 子乃蠻襲。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Naiman succeeded.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Naiman succeeded.

manualTranslations.zh: 拙赤哥入宿衞，從世祖征鄂漢，以功賜白金。
manualTranslations.literal: Juochige entered the palace guard, followed Shizu in campaigning at E and Han, and for merit was granted white silver.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Juochige joined the palace guard, followed Khubilai in the E-Han campaigns, and received white silver for his service.

manualTranslations.zh: 至元三年，從征李壇，戰死之。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year of Zhiyuan he followed the campaign against Li Tan and died in battle.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 3 (1266) he followed the campaign against Li Tan and died in battle.

manualTranslations.zh: 子闊闊朮為御史臺都事。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Kuokuoshu became secretary of the Censorate.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Kuokuoshu became secretary of the Censorate.

manualTranslations.zh: 至元三十一年，國王速渾察之子拾得既沒，其家有故璽，王將鬻之，命闊闊朮以示中丞崔彧、御史楊桓，辯其文曰：「受命于天，既壽永昌。」
manualTranslations.literal: In the thirty-first year of Zhiyuan, after Prince Suqunqa's son Shide had died, his household possessed an old seal; the prince was about to sell it and ordered Kuokuoshu to show it to Vice Censor-in-Chief Cui Yu and Censor Yang Huan, who read its inscription: "Having received the mandate from Heaven, long life and eternal prosperity."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 31 (1294), after Prince Suqunqa's son Shide died, his household possessed an old seal. The prince was about to sell it and ordered Kuokuoshu to show it to Vice Censor-in-Chief Cui Yu and Censor Yang Huan, who read its inscription: "Having received the mandate from Heaven, long life and eternal prosperity."

manualTranslations.zh: 蓋秦璽也。
manualTranslations.literal: It was the seal of Qin.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: It was the seal of Qin.

manualTranslations.zh: 彧請獻之徽仁裕聖皇后。
manualTranslations.literal: Cui Yu requested presenting it to Empress Huirenyusheng.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Cui Yu requested presenting it to Empress Huirenyusheng.

manualTranslations.zh: 后以鈔二千五百貫賜拾得家，金織文段二賜闊闊朮。
manualTranslations.literal: The empress then granted two thousand five hundred guan of paper notes to Shide's household and two brocade lengths to Kuokuoshu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The empress granted two thousand five hundred guan of paper notes to Shide's household and two lengths of gold brocade to Kuokuoshu.

manualTranslations.zh: 成宗即位，近臣以其事聞，授闊闊朮漢中廉訪僉事，仕至湖南廉訪使。
manualTranslations.literal: When Chengzong took the throne, a close attendant reported the matter; Kuokuoshu was appointed surveillance commissioner of Hanzhong and rose to surveillance commissioner of Hunan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Chengzong took the throne, a close attendant reported the matter; Kuokuoshu was appointed surveillance commissioner of Hanzhong and rose to surveillance commissioner of Hunan.

manualTranslations.zh: 雪不台，蒙古部兀良罕氏。
manualTranslations.literal: Xuebutai, of the Uyirad clan of the Mongol division.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xuebutai belonged to the Uyirad clan of the Mongols.

manualTranslations.zh: 遠祖捏里弼生孛忽都，雄勇有智略。
manualTranslations.literal: Remote ancestor Nili'bi bore Börütu; fierce and brave with wisdom and strategy.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His distant forebear Nili'bi fathered Börütu, a man of fierce courage and keen strategy.

manualTranslations.zh: 曾孫合飭溫生哈班、哈不里。
manualTranslations.literal: Great-grandson Hechiwen bore Qaban and Qaburi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His great-grandson Hechiwen had two sons, Qaban and Qaburi.

manualTranslations.zh: 哈班生二子：長虎魯渾，次雪不台。
manualTranslations.literal: Qaban bore two sons: the elder Qorluqun, the younger Xuebutai.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Qaban's elder son was Qorluqun; the younger was Xuebutai.

sourceRange.text: 先是勳臣子孫為祖父請諡者，帝每靳之，至是敕大臣以美諡諡之，諡曰桓勇。子重喜，始給侍皇子闊端，為親衞。癸丑，從世祖征哈剌章，數有功。中統元年，渾都海反，從總帥汪良臣引兵至拔沙河納火石地逆戰，以功授征行元帥。四年，從討忽都、達吉、散竹台等，克之，制必帖木兒王承制，使襲父職為元帥。入覲，賜金虎符，為臨洮府達魯花赤。時解軍職而轉民官者，例納所佩符。有旨：「趙氏世世勤勞，其金符勿拘常例，使終佩之。」重喜在郡，卲農興學，省刑敦教，以善治聞。請致事不許，詔其長子官卓斯結襲為達魯花赤。陞重喜鞏昌二十四處宣慰使。卒，諡桓襄。

sourceRange.text: 子教化，初為速古兒赤，繼襲父職。必里阿禿叛，奉旨往平之，凱還，賜衣一襲。天曆元年八月，從丞相燕帖木兒戰居庸北，有功。九月，進拱衞直都指揮使。尋遷章佩卿。子者燕不花，初事仁宗為速古兒赤。英宗時為進酒寶兒赤。天曆元年，迎文宗于河南，賜白銀、綵段，命為溫都赤。九月，往居庸關料敵，道逢二軍謂探馬赤諸軍曰：「今北兵且至，其避之。」者燕不花恐搖眾心，即拔所佩刀斬之。授兵部郎中。招集阿速軍四百餘人。十月，進兵部尚書，授雙珠虎符，領軍六百人迎敵通州。會丞相燕帖木兒至檀子山，與禿滿迭兒戰，敗之。遷大司農丞。

sourceRange.text: 次阿散不別，驍勇善騎射，歷事成宗、武宗、仁宗，數被寵遇，計前後所賜楮幣餘四十萬緡，他物稱是，積官榮祿大夫，三珠虎符。子斡都蠻襲職。致和元年八月，自上都逃來，丞相燕帖木兒任為裨將，率壯士百人，圍滅里帖木兒等于陀羅臺驛，擒之以獻，特賜衣一襲，及禿禿馬失甲、金束帶各一，白金一百兩，鈔二百錠。天曆元年九月，充行院同僉。十月，從擊忽剌台、馬扎罕等軍于盧溝橋，敗之，追至紫荊關，多所俘獲，招降安童所將軍一千五百人，復以功受上賞。二年，進樞僉院。三年，以隆鎮衞都指揮使兼領拱衞司。

localRange.text: 次阿散不別，驍勇善騎射，歷事成宗、武宗、仁宗，數被寵遇，計前後所賜楮幣余四十萬緡，他物稱是，積官榮祿大夫，三珠虎符。○抄兒

sourceRange.text: 帖木兒不花子曰塔朮納，曰哈里哈孫，曰伯答沙。伯答沙幼入宿衞，為寶兒赤。歷事成宗、武宗，由光祿少卿擢同知宣徽院事，陞銀青光祿大夫、宣徽院使，遙授左丞相。武宗崩，護梓宮葬于北，守山陵三年，乃還。仁宗即位，眷顧益厚。延祐二年，拜中書右丞相。時承平日久，朝廷清明，君臣端拱廟堂之上，而百姓乂安於下，一時號稱極治。仁宗崩，帖木迭兒執政，改授集賢大學士，仍開府儀同三司、錄軍國重事。未幾，以大宗正札魯忽赤出鎮北方，亦以清靜為治，邊民按堵。泰定間還朝，加太保。及倒剌沙構兵上都，兵潰，伯答沙奉璽紱來上，文宗嘉之。拜太傅，仍為札魯忽赤。至順三年薨。

localRange.text: 帖木兒不花子曰塔術納，曰哈裏哈孫，曰伯答沙。

context.afterSource: 伯答沙為人清慎寬厚，號稱長者。

manualTranslations.zh: 伯答沙幼入宿衞，為寶兒赤。
manualTranslations.literal: From youth Bodasha entered the palace guard and served as ba'erchi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From youth Bodasha entered the palace guard and served as a royal attendant.

manualTranslations.zh: 歷事成宗、武宗，由光祿少卿擢同知宣徽院事，陞銀青光祿大夫、宣徽院使，遙授左丞相。
manualTranslations.literal: He served through the reigns of Chengzong and Wuzong, rising from Vice Director of the Imperial Household to Associate Director of the Xuanhui Court, then to Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and Director of the Xuanhui Court, with a concurrent appointment as Left Chancellor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Serving Chengzong and Wuzong, he rose from Vice Director of the Imperial Household to Associate Director of the Xuanhui Court, then to Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and Director of the Xuanhui Court, with a concurrent appointment as Left Chancellor.

manualTranslations.zh: 武宗崩，護梓宮葬于北，守山陵三年，乃還。
manualTranslations.literal: When Wuzong died, he escorted the imperial coffin north for burial and guarded the imperial tombs for three years before returning.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Wuzong died, he escorted the imperial coffin north for burial and kept watch over the imperial tombs for three years before returning.

manualTranslations.zh: 仁宗即位，眷顧益厚。
manualTranslations.literal: When Renzong acceded to the throne, his favor toward Bodasha grew still greater.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Renzong took the throne, his regard for Bodasha grew even deeper.

manualTranslations.zh: 延祐二年，拜中書右丞相。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Yanyou he was appointed Right Chancellor of the Secretariat.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Yanyou 2 he was appointed Right Chancellor of the Secretariat.

manualTranslations.zh: 時承平日久，朝廷清明，君臣端拱廟堂之上，而百姓乂安於下，一時號稱極治。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time peace had long prevailed; the court was clear and upright, sovereign and ministers sat composed in the hall of state, and the common people lived in order below—an age acclaimed as a pinnacle of good government.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Peace had long prevailed; the court was upright, sovereign and ministers sat composed in the hall of state, and the people lived in order below—an age hailed as a pinnacle of good government.

manualTranslations.zh: 仁宗崩，帖木迭兒執政，改授集賢大學士，仍開府儀同三司、錄軍國重事。
manualTranslations.literal: When Renzong died and Temuder held power, Bodasha was reassigned as Grand Academician of the Jixian Hall while retaining Grand Master with Ceremonial Parity with the Three Excellencies and Recorder of Important State and Military Affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Renzong died and Temuder took power, Bodasha was reassigned as Grand Academician of the Jixian Hall while retaining Grand Master with Ceremonial Parity with the Three Excellencies and Recorder of Important State and Military Affairs.

manualTranslations.zh: 未幾，以大宗正札魯忽赤出鎮北方，亦以清靜為治，邊民按堵。
manualTranslations.literal: Before long he was sent north as Jarquchi of the Grand Council for Princes; there too he governed with restraint and quiet, and the frontier people lived in peace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon he was sent north as Jarquchi of the Grand Council for Princes; there too he governed with restraint, and the frontier people lived in peace.

manualTranslations.zh: 泰定間還朝，加太保。
manualTranslations.literal: During the Taiding reign he returned to court and was promoted to Grand Mentor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During the Taiding reign he returned to court and was promoted to Grand Mentor.

manualTranslations.zh: 及倒剌沙構兵上都，兵潰，伯答沙奉璽紱來上，文宗嘉之。
manualTranslations.literal: When Daolasha raised troops at Shangdu and his army collapsed, Bodasha brought the imperial seal and cord to present to the throne; Wenzong praised him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Daolasha raised troops at Shangdu and his army collapsed, Bodasha brought the imperial seal and cord to the throne; Wenzong praised him.

manualTranslations.zh: 拜太傅，仍為札魯忽赤。
manualTranslations.literal: He was appointed Grand Tutor and again made Jarquchi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was appointed Grand Tutor and again made Jarquchi.

manualTranslations.zh: 至順三年薨。
manualTranslations.literal: He died in the third year of Zhishun.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died in Zhishun 3.

sourceRange.text: 世祖命火兒思蠻從雪雪的斤鎮雲南。月兒思蠻事憲宗，襲父爵，兼領僧人。後因軍帥札忽兒台據別失八里，盡室徙居平涼。與其子阿的迷失帖木兒入覲，世祖詔入宿衞為必闍赤，命從安西王忙哥剌出鎮六盤。安西王薨，其子阿難答嗣。成宗即位，遣使入朝，因奏：「阿的迷失帖木兒父子，本先帝舊臣，來事先王，服勤二十餘年矣。若終老王府，非所以盡其才也，願以歸陛下用之。」成宗可其奏，授阿的迷失帖木兒汝州達魯花赤，積官祕書太監。卒。子阿鄰帖木兒。阿鄰帖木兒，善國書，多聞識，歷事累朝，繇翰林待制累遷榮祿大夫、翰林學士承旨。

localRange.text: 阿鄰帖木兒，善國書，多聞識，歷事累朝，由翰林待制累遷榮祿大夫、翰林學士承旨。

manualTranslations.zh: 世祖命火兒思蠻從雪雪的斤鎮雲南。
manualTranslations.literal: Shizu ordered Huoersiman to follow Xuexuedejin in governing Yunnan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shizu ordered Huoersiman to accompany Xuexuedejin in governing Yunnan.

manualTranslations.zh: 月兒思蠻事憲宗，襲父爵，兼領僧人。
manualTranslations.literal: Yueersiman served Xianzong, inherited his father's title, and concurrently oversaw the Buddhist clergy.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yueersiman served Xianzong, succeeded to his father's rank, and also supervised the Buddhist clergy.

manualTranslations.zh: 後因軍帥札忽兒台據別失八里，盡室徙居平涼。
manualTranslations.literal: Later, because the military commander Zhahuertai seized Bieshibali, the whole household moved to Pingliang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later, when the commander Zhahuertai took Bieshibali, the entire family relocated to Pingliang.

manualTranslations.zh: 與其子阿的迷失帖木兒入覲，世祖詔入宿衞為必闍赤，命從安西王忙哥剌出鎮六盤。
manualTranslations.literal: He and his son Adishitemuer presented themselves at court; Shizu ordered them into the imperial guard as bishchi and commanded them to follow the Prince of Anxi, Mangge-la, to take up garrison at Liupan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He and his son Adishitemuer came to court; Shizu enrolled them in the palace guard as bishchi and ordered them to follow the Prince of Anxi, Mangge-la, in garrisoning Liupan.

manualTranslations.zh: 安西王薨，其子阿難答嗣。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Prince of Anxi died, his son Ananda succeeded.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After the Prince of Anxi died, his son Ananda succeeded him.

manualTranslations.zh: 成宗即位，遣使入朝，因奏：「阿的迷失帖木兒父子，本先帝舊臣，來事先王，服勤二十餘年矣。
manualTranslations.literal: When Chengzong ascended the throne, Yueersiman sent envoys to court and memorialized: "Adishitemuer and his father are former retainers of the late emperor who have served the former prince faithfully for more than twenty years.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Chengzong took the throne, Yueersiman sent envoys to court and memorialized: "Adishitemuer and his father are old retainers of the late emperor who have served the former prince for more than twenty years.

manualTranslations.zh: 若終老王府，非所以盡其才也，願以歸陛下用之。
manualTranslations.literal: To let them end their days in the princely mansion would not make full use of their talents; I beg that Your Majesty take them into your service."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: If they spend their old age in the princely mansion, their talents will not be fully used. I beg that Your Majesty bring them into your service."

manualTranslations.zh: 」成宗可其奏，授阿的迷失帖木兒汝州達魯花赤，積官祕書太監。
manualTranslations.literal: Chengzong approved the memorial and appointed Adishitemuer Darughachi of Ruzhou; through successive promotions he rose to Secretariat Director.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chengzong approved the memorial and appointed Adishitemuer Darughachi of Ruzhou; he eventually rose to Secretariat Director.

manualTranslations.zh: 卒。
manualTranslations.literal: He died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died.

manualTranslations.zh: 子阿鄰帖木兒。
manualTranslations.literal: His son was Alintiemuer.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son was Alintiemuer.

sourceRange.text: 岳璘帖穆爾從太祖征討，多戰功。皇弟斡真求師傅，帝命岳璘帖穆爾往，訓導諸王子以孝弟敦睦、仁厚不殺為先，帝聞而嘉之。從平河南，徙酇縣民萬餘戶入樂安。俄授河南等處軍民都達魯花赤，佩金虎符，并賜宮女四人。所得上方賞賚，悉輦歸故郡，以散親舊。且盛陳漢官儀衞以激厲之，國人羨慕。道出河西，所過榛莽，或時乏水，為之鑿井置堠，居民使客相慶稱便。太祖即位，以中原多盜，選充大斷事官。從斡真出鎮順天等路，布德化，寬征徭，盜遁姦革，州郡清寧。尋復監河南等處軍民。年六十七，卒于保定。後贈宣力保德功臣、山東宣慰使，諡莊簡。子合剌普華，見忠義傳。李楨，字榦臣。

context.beforeSource: 仳理伽普華以疾卒。
context.afterSource: 其先，西夏國族子也。
context.beforeLocal: 仳理伽普華以疾卒。
context.afterLocal: 其先，西夏國族子也。
