manualTranslations.zh: 岳璘帖穆爾從太祖征討，多戰功。
manualTranslations.literal: Yuelintiemuer followed Taizu on campaigns and won many battle honors.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yuelintiemuer followed Taizu on campaign and earned many military honors.

manualTranslations.zh: 皇弟斡真求師傅，帝命岳璘帖穆爾往，訓導諸王子以孝弟敦睦、仁厚不殺為先，帝聞而嘉之。
manualTranslations.literal: The imperial younger brother Wozhen sought a tutor; the Emperor sent Yuelintiemuer to instruct the princes, putting filial piety, brotherly harmony, magnanimity, and restraint from killing foremost, and when the Emperor heard of this he commended him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the imperial younger brother Wozhen asked for a tutor, the emperor sent Yuelintiemuer to teach the princes, emphasizing filial piety, brotherly harmony, magnanimity, and mercy; the emperor praised him when he heard of it.

manualTranslations.zh: 從平河南，徙酇縣民萬餘戶入樂安。
manualTranslations.literal: He followed in the pacification of Henan and moved more than ten thousand households from Zan County into Le'an.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He took part in pacifying Henan and resettled more than ten thousand households from Zan County in Le'an.

manualTranslations.zh: 俄授河南等處軍民都達魯花赤，佩金虎符，并賜宮女四人。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he was appointed Chief Darughachi over military and civilian affairs in Henan and other districts, granted a gold tiger tally, and given four palace women as well.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed Chief Darughachi over military and civilian affairs in Henan and neighboring districts, given a gold tiger tally, and granted four palace women.

manualTranslations.zh: 所得上方賞賚，悉輦歸故郡，以散親舊。
manualTranslations.literal: Whatever rewards he received from the court he sent back in carts to his native commandery to distribute among kinsmen and old friends.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He sent every court reward back to his home commandery in carts and distributed it among relatives and old friends.

manualTranslations.zh: 且盛陳漢官儀衞以激厲之，國人羨慕。
manualTranslations.literal: He also displayed Han official ceremonial and guard in full splendor to inspire his people, and his countrymen looked on with admiration.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He also staged Han official ceremony and guard in full splendor to inspire his people, and his countrymen admired him for it.

manualTranslations.zh: 道出河西，所過榛莽，或時乏水，為之鑿井置堠，居民使客相慶稱便。
manualTranslations.literal: Passing through Hexi, wherever the route ran through wild scrub and water was sometimes scarce, he had wells dug and beacon mounds set up; residents and travelers alike rejoiced at the convenience.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the road through Hexi, wherever the route crossed wild scrub and water ran short, he had wells dug and beacon mounds built; residents and travelers alike praised the convenience.

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖即位，以中原多盜，選充大斷事官。
manualTranslations.literal: When Taizu acceded to the throne, because banditry was rife in the Central Plains, he was chosen to serve as a chief judicial officer.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Taizu took the throne, he was selected as a chief judicial officer because banditry was widespread in the Central Plains.

manualTranslations.zh: 從斡真出鎮順天等路，布德化，寬征徭，盜遁姦革，州郡清寧。
manualTranslations.literal: He followed Wozhen in taking up garrison over Shuntian and other circuits, spreading benevolent rule, easing levies and corvée labor, driving off bandits and reforming wrongdoing until the prefectures and commanderies were tranquil.

sourceRange.text: 世祖即位，擇信臣宣撫十道，命布魯海牙使真定。真定富民出錢貸人者，不踰時倍取其息，布魯海牙正其罪，使償者息如本而止，後定為令。中統鈔法行，以金銀為本，本至，乃降新鈔。時莊聖太后已命取真定金銀，由是真定無本，鈔不可得。布魯海牙遣幕僚邢澤往謂平章王文統曰：「昔奉太后旨，金銀悉送至上京。真定南北要衝之地，居民商賈甚多，今舊鈔既罷，新鈔不降，何以為政？且以金銀為本，豈若以民為本？又太后之取金帛，以賞推戴之功也，其為本不亦大乎！」文統不能奪，立降鈔五千錠，民賴以便。俄遷順德等路宣慰使，佩金虎符。來朝，帝命坐，慰勞之，賜以海東青鶻。至元二年秋卒，年六十九。

sourceRange.text: 太宗即位，授豐（靖）〔淨〕雲內三州都達魯花赤，改太原平陽二路達魯花赤，入為燕京斷事官。憲宗即位，命同塔剌渾行六部事，遷燕京路總管，多惠政，擢採訪使。帝伐蜀，賽典赤主饋餉，供億未嘗闕乏。世祖即位，立十路宣撫司，擢燕京宣撫使。中統二年，拜中書平章政事，皆降制奬諭。至元元年，置陝西五路西蜀四川行中書省，出為平章政事。蒞官三年，增戶九千五百六十五、軍一萬二千二百五十五、鈔六千二百二十五錠、屯田糧九萬七千二十一石，撙節和買鈔三百三十一錠。中書以聞，詔賞銀五千兩，仍命陝西五路四川行院大小官屬並聽節制。七年，分鎮四川。宋將昝萬壽擁強兵守嘉定，與賽典赤軍對壘，一以誠意待之，不為侵掠，萬壽心服。

sourceRange.text: 斡脫赤之歿，鐵哥甫四歲，性穎悟，不為嬉戲。從那摩入見，帝問誰氏子，對曰：「兄斡脫赤子也。」帝方食雞，輟以賜鐵哥，鐵哥捧而不食，帝問之，對曰：「將以遺母。」帝奇之，加賜一雞。世祖即位，幸香山永安寺，見書畏吾字於壁，問誰所書，僧對曰：「國師兄子鐵哥書也。」帝召見，愛其容儀秀麗，語音清亮，命隸丞相孛羅備宿衞。

sourceRange.text: 遣蒙古軍都元帥闍里帖木兒、萬戶懷都，先據無錫州，萬戶忙古歹、晏徹兒巡太湖，遣監戰亦乞里歹、招討使唆都、宣撫使游顯，會闍里帖木兒先趨平江。庚寅，遣降人游介實，奉詔書副本使于宋，仍以書諭宋大臣。十二月辛丑，次無錫，宋將作監柳岳等奉其國主及太皇太后書，併宋之大臣與伯顏書來見，垂泣而言曰：「太皇太后年高，嗣君幼冲，且在衰絰中。自古禮不伐喪，望哀恕班師，敢不每年進奉修好。今日事至此者，皆奸臣賈似道失信誤國耳。」伯顏曰：「主上即位之初，奉國書修好，汝國執我行人一十六年，所以興師問罪。去歲，又無故殺害廉奉使等，誰之過歟？如欲我師不進，將效錢王納土乎？李主出降乎？爾宋昔得天下於小兒之手，今亦失於小兒之手，蓋天道也，不必多言。」岳頓首泣不已。遣招討使抄兒赤，以柳岳來使事，及嚴奉使所齎國書入奏。

sourceRange.text: __TOC__阿朮，兀良氏，都帥兀良合台子也。沉幾有智略，臨陣勇決，氣蓋萬人。憲宗時，從其父征西南夷，率精兵為候騎，所向摧陷，莫敢當其鋒。至平大理，克諸部，降交趾，無不在行。事見兀良合台傳。憲宗嘗勞之曰：「阿朮未有名位，挺身奉國，特賜黃金三百兩，以勉將來。」世祖即位，留典宿衞。中統三年，從諸王拜出、帖哥征李璮有功。九月，自宿衞將軍拜征南都元帥，治兵于汴。復立宿州。至元元年1264年八月，略地兩淮，攻取戰獲，軍聲大振。四年1267年八月，觀兵襄陽，遂入南郡，取僊人、鐵城等柵，俘生口五萬。

sourceRange.text: 於是明里帖木兒等罷兵入朝，特為置驛以通往來。十年1306年，拜榮祿大夫、同知樞密院事，尋拜光祿大夫、知樞密院事，欽察左衞指揮、太僕少卿皆如故。成宗崩，武宗時在渾麻出之海上，牀兀兒請急歸定大業，以副天下之望。武宗納其言，即日南還。及即位，賜以先朝所御大武帳等物，加拜平章政事，仍兼樞密、欽察左衞、太僕。還邊，復封容國公，授以銀印，賜尚服衣段及虎豹之屬。至大二年，入朝，加封句容郡王，改授金印。帝曰：「世祖征大理時所御武帳及所服珠衣，今以賜卿，其勿辭。」翌日，又以世祖所乘安輿賜之，且曰：「以卿有足疾，故賜此。」牀兀兒叩頭泣涕，固辭而言曰：「世祖所御之帳，所服之衣，固非臣所敢當，而乘輿尤非所宜蒙也。貪寵過當，臣實不敢。」帝顧左右曰：「他人不知辭此。」別命有司置馬轎賜之，俾得乘至殿門下。仁宗即位，入朝，特授光祿大夫、平章政事、知樞密院事、欽察親軍都指揮使、左衞親軍都指揮使、太僕少卿。延祐元年，敗叛王也先不花等軍于亦忒海迷失之地，遣使入報，賜以尚服。二年1315年，敗也〔先〕不花所遣將也不干、忽都帖木兒于赤麥干之地。追出其境，至鐵門關，遇其大軍於扎亦兒之地，又敗之。四年1317年，帝念其功而憫其老，召入商議中書省事，知樞密院事。大理國進象牙、金飾轎，即以賜之。每見必賜坐，每食必賜食，待以宗室親王之禮。牀兀兒常曰：「老臣受朝廷之賜厚矣，吾子孫當以死報國。」至治二年1322年卒，年六十三。後累封揚王。

sourceRange.text: 惟忠生恒，恒生有異質，王妃撫之猶己子。中統三年，命恒為尚書斷事官，恒以讓其兄。李璮反漣海，恒從其父棄家入告變，璮怒，繫恒闔門獄中，璮誅，得出。世祖嘉其功，授淄萊路奧魯總管，佩金符，併償其所失家資。至元七年，改宣武將軍、益都淄萊新軍萬戶，從伐宋。襄陽守將呂文煥時出拒敵，殿帥范文虎復援之。恒率本軍築堡萬山扼城西，絕其陸路。文煥等又以漁舟渡漢水窺伺軍形，恒設伏敗之，水路亦絕，遂進攻樊城。十年春，恒以精兵渡漢，自南面先登，樊城破，襄陽亦降。

localRange.text: 惟忠生恆，恆生有异质，王妃抚之犹己子。中统三年，命恆为尚书断事官，恆以让其兄。李璮反涟海，恆从其父弃家入告变，璮怒，系恆阖门狱中。璮诛，得出。世祖嘉其功，授淄莱路奥鲁总管，佩金符，并偿其所失家资。至元七年，改宣武将军、益都淄莱新军万户，从伐宋。襄阳守将吕文焕时出拒敌，殿帅范文虎复援之。恆率本军筑堡万山扼城西，绝其陆路。文焕等又以渔舟渡汉水窥伺军形，恆设伏败之，水路亦绝，遂进攻樊城。十年春，恆以精兵渡汉，自南面先登，樊城破，襄阳亦降。

sourceRange.text: 會大同民饑，不忽木以便宜發倉廩賑之。阿合馬所善幸臣奏不忽木擅發軍儲，又鍛鍊阿合馬使自誣服。帝曰：「使行發粟以活吾民，乃其職也，何罪之有？」命移其獄至京師審視，阿合馬竟伏誅。吐土哈求欽察之為人奴者增益其軍，而多取編民。中書僉省王遇驗其籍改正之。

sourceRange.text: 拜降曰：「民饑如是而不賑之，豈為民父母意耶！」即躬詣行省力請，得發粟四萬石，民賴全活。元貞間，兩浙鹽運司同知范某陰賊為姦，州縣吏以賂咸聽驅役，由是數侵暴細民。民有珍貨腴田，必奪為己有；不與，則朋結無賴，妄訟以羅織之，無不蕩破家業者。兇燄鑠人，人咸側目。里人欲殺之，不果，顧被誣訴逮繫者，亡慮數十人，俱死獄中。蘭溪州民葉一、王十四有美田宅，范欲奪之，不可，因誣以事，繫獄十年不決。事聞于省，省下理問所推鞫之，適拜降至官，寃遂得直。

localRange.text: 拜降曰：「民饥如是而不赈之，岂为民父母意耶！即躬诣行省力请，得发粟四万石，民赖全活。元贞间，两浙盐运司同知范某阴贼为奸，州县吏以赂，咸听驱役，由是数侵暴细民。民有珍货腴田，必夺为己有，不与，则朋结无赖，妄讼以罗织之，无不荡破家业者。凶焰铄人，人咸侧目。里人欲杀之，不果，顾被诬诉逮系者亡虑数十人，俱死狱中。兰溪州民叶一、王十四有美田宅，范欲夺之，不可，因诬以事，系狱十年不决。事闻于省，省下理问所推鞫之，适拜降至官，冤遂得直。

sourceRange.text: 大德元年，遷浙東廉訪副使，令行禁止，豪強懾伏。同寅有貪穢者，拜降抗章覈之于臺，遂免其官。後轉工部侍郎，賜侍燕服一襲，陞工部尚書，有能聲。至大二年，仁宗奉皇太后避暑五臺，拜降供給道路，無有闕遺，恩賚尤渥。

localRange.text: 大德元年，迁浙东廉访副使，令行禁止，豪强慑伏。同寅有贪秽者，拜降抗章核之于台，遂免其官。后转工部侍郎，赐侍燕服一袭，升工部尚书，有能声。至大二年，仁宗奉皇太后避暑五台，拜降供给道路，无有阙遗，恩赉尤渥。

sourceRange.text: 步魯合答，蒙古弘吉剌氏。祖按主奴，太宗時率蒙古軍千人從諸王察合台征河西，至山丹。攻下定、會、階、文諸州，以功為元帥，佩金符，駐軍漢陽禮店，戍守西和、階、文南界，及西蕃邊境。換金虎符，真除元帥。父車里，襲職。從都元帥紐璘攻成都。宋將劉整以重兵守雲頂山，車里擊敗之，進圍其城。整遣裨校出戰，敗走，追至簡州斬之，殺三百餘人，遂拔其城。攻重慶，車里將兵千人為先鋒，渡馬湖江，敗宋兵于馬老山，俘獲百餘人。戊午，諸軍還屯灰山，宋兵夜來劫營，車里擊敗之，斬首三百級。世祖即位，賜金符，為奧魯元帥，又改征行元帥。至元二年，車里以老疾，不任事，諸王阿只吉命步魯合答代領其軍。

context.afterSource: 至元八年，制授管軍千戶，佩金符。

manualTranslations.zh: 步魯合答，蒙古弘吉剌氏。
manualTranslations.literal: Buluheda was of the Mongol Kongirat clan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Buluheda was of the Mongol Kongirat clan.

manualTranslations.zh: 祖按主奴，太宗時率蒙古軍千人從諸王察合台征河西，至山丹。
manualTranslations.literal: His grandfather Anzhunu, in Taizong's time, led one thousand Mongol troops following Prince Chagatai in the campaign against Hexi, reaching Shandan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His grandfather Anzhunu, during Emperor Taizong's reign, led one thousand Mongol troops under Prince Chagatai against Hexi as far as Shandan.

manualTranslations.zh: 攻下定、會、階、文諸州，以功為元帥，佩金符，駐軍漢陽禮店，戍守西和、階、文南界，及西蕃邊境。
manualTranslations.literal: He captured the prefectures of Ding, Hui, Jie, and Wen. For his service he was made marshal, granted a gold tally, and garrisoned at Lidian in Hanyang, guarding the southern borders of Xihe, Jie, and Wen and the frontier with the Tibetans.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He captured Ding, Hui, Jie, and Wen prefectures. For his achievements he was made marshal, granted a gold tally, and stationed at Lidian in Hanyang, guarding the southern borders of Xihe, Jie, and Wen and the Tibetan frontier.

manualTranslations.zh: 換金虎符，真除元帥。
manualTranslations.literal: He exchanged his tally for a gold tiger tally and was formally appointed marshal.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was given a gold tiger tally in place of his former tally and formally appointed marshal.

manualTranslations.zh: 父車里，襲職。
manualTranslations.literal: His father Cheli inherited the post.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His father Cheli inherited the post.

manualTranslations.zh: 從都元帥紐璘攻成都。
manualTranslations.literal: He followed Grand Marshal Niulin in the attack on Chengdu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He followed Grand Marshal Niulin in the attack on Chengdu.

manualTranslations.zh: 宋將劉整以重兵守雲頂山，車里擊敗之，進圍其城。
manualTranslations.literal: Song general Liu Zheng held Yunding Mountain with a large force. Cheli defeated him and advanced to besiege the city.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Song general Liu Zheng held Yunding Mountain with heavy forces. Cheli defeated him and advanced to besiege the city.

manualTranslations.zh: 整遣裨校出戰，敗走，追至簡州斬之，殺三百餘人，遂拔其城。
manualTranslations.literal: Liu Zheng sent a vice commander out to fight, but he was defeated and fled. Pursued to Jian Prefecture, he was beheaded. More than three hundred men were killed, and the city was taken.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Liu Zheng sent a vice commander out to fight, but he was routed and fled. Cheli pursued him to Jian Prefecture, beheaded him, killed more than three hundred men, and took the city.

manualTranslations.zh: 攻重慶，車里將兵千人為先鋒，渡馬湖江，敗宋兵于馬老山，俘獲百餘人。
manualTranslations.literal: Attacking Chongqing, Cheli led one thousand men as vanguard, crossed the Mahu River, defeated Song troops at Mount Maolao, and captured more than a hundred men.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the attack on Chongqing Cheli led one thousand men as vanguard, crossed the Mahu River, defeated Song troops at Mount Maolao, and took more than a hundred prisoners.

manualTranslations.zh: 戊午，諸軍還屯灰山，宋兵夜來劫營，車里擊敗之，斬首三百級。
manualTranslations.literal: In the wuwu year the armies returned and encamped at Huishan. Song troops came by night to raid the camp. Cheli defeated them and beheaded three hundred men.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the wuwu year the armies returned to encamp at Huishan. Song troops raided the camp by night, and Cheli defeated them, taking three hundred heads.

manualTranslations.zh: 世祖即位，賜金符，為奧魯元帥，又改征行元帥。
manualTranslations.literal: When Shizu acceded, Cheli was granted a gold tally, appointed Ordu Marshal, and later made Campaign Marshal.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Shizu acceded, Cheli was granted a gold tally, appointed Ordu Marshal, and later made Campaign Marshal.

manualTranslations.zh: 至元二年，車里以老疾，不任事，諸王阿只吉命步魯合答代領其軍。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of the Zhiyuan era, Cheli was old and ill and could not perform his duties. Prince Aziji ordered Buluheda to take command of his army in his stead.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhiyuan, Cheli was aged and infirm and could no longer serve. Prince Aziji ordered Buluheda to take command of his army in his place.

sourceRange.text: 帖木兒不花，答答里帶人。父帖赤，歲乙未，同都元帥塔海紺卜將兵入蜀，并將蒙古也可明安、和少馬賴及砲手諸軍，攻下興元、利、劍、成都諸郡，所降宋將小王太尉之眾，悉隸麾下。中統二年，賜虎符，授西川便宜都元帥。俄進行樞密院，率諸軍略定西川未下郡邑。至元元年，遷益都等路統軍使，死軍中。

context.beforeSource: 未幾，帝以為松江瀕海重地，復命鎮之，賜三珠虎符，卒于官。
context.afterSource: 帖木兒不花，中統初入備宿衞。

manualTranslations.zh: 俄進行樞密院，率諸軍略定西川未下郡邑。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon he entered the Bureau of Military Affairs and led the armies in pacifying the remaining unsubdued districts of Xichuan.

manualTranslations.zh: 至元元年，遷益都等路統軍使，死軍中。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Zhiyuan he was made Army Controller of Yidu Circuit and the other circuits, and died in the field.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Grand Master of Zide and Right Vice Administrator of the Yunnan Branch Secretariat, and joined Liu Shen in the campaign against the Eight Hundred Wives kingdom.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Huangqing he was posthumously granted Grand Master of Ronglu, Grand Councillor, and Duke of Gong, with the posthumous name Wuhui.

sourceRange.text: 世祖即位，諸王霍忽叛，掠河西諸城。麥里以為帝初即位，而王為首亂，此不可長，與其弟桑忽答兒率所部擊之，一月八戰，奪其所掠扎剌亦兒、脫脫憐諸部民以還。已而桑忽答兒為霍忽所殺，帝聞而憐之，遣使者以銀鈔羊馬迎致麥里，賜號曰答剌罕，尋卒。子禿忽魯。

manualTranslations.zh: 世祖即位，諸王霍忽叛，掠河西諸城。
manualTranslations.literal: When Shizu acceded, Prince Huohu rebelled and plundered the cities of Hexi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Shizu acceded, Prince Huohu rebelled and plundered the cities of Hexi.

manualTranslations.zh: 麥里以為帝初即位，而王為首亂，此不可長，與其弟桑忽答兒率所部擊之，一月八戰，奪其所掠扎剌亦兒、脫脫憐諸部民以還。
manualTranslations.literal: Maili considered that the emperor had just acceded and that the prince was the first to rebel—this could not be allowed to continue. With his younger brother Sanghuda'er he led their followers to attack him. In one month they fought eight battles and recovered the people of the Jalair, Tuotuolian, and other tribes that had been seized.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Maili judged that with the emperor newly enthroned, the prince's rebellion as the first outbreak could not be tolerated. With his younger brother Sanghuda'er he led their followers against him, fought eight battles in one month, and recovered the Jalair, Tuotuolian, and other tribes that had been seized.

manualTranslations.zh: 已而桑忽答兒為霍忽所殺，帝聞而憐之，遣使者以銀鈔羊馬迎致麥里，賜號曰答剌罕，尋卒。

sourceRange.text: 至元二十三年，授廣威將軍、後衞親軍副都指揮使，賜虎符。明年夏，從征乃顏于亦迷河，擒僉家奴、塔不台以歸，賞鈔及衣段，加定遠大將軍。大德元年卒。子別吉連襲。至大四年，河東、陝西、鞏昌、延安、燕南、河北、遼陽、河南、山東諸翼衞探馬赤爭草地訟者二百餘起，命往究之，悉正其罪，積官懷遠大將軍。致和元年，從丞相燕鐵木兒擒倒剌沙黨烏伯都剌等，領諸衞軍守居庸關及諸要害地。天曆元年十月，王禪兵掩至羊頭山，攻破隘口，勢甚張，別吉連從丞相擁眾奮擊之，突入其軍，王禪敗走，文宗賜御衣二襲、三珠虎符，及弓矢、甲冑、金帛等物，以旌其功。尋以疾辭，子也連的襲。

sourceRange.text: 仙鼐幼事世祖於潛藩，從征土蕃、雲南，常為前驅。歲己未，伐宋，至鄂州，先登，奪其外城。中統元年，從征阿里不哥，與其黨遇，大呼馳擊之，其眾駭潰，賞白金貂裘。明年，討李璮，以功賞白金五百兩。授西道都元帥、金虎符、土蕃宣慰使。仙鼐素熟夷情，隨地阨塞設屯鎮撫之，恩威兼著，頑獷皆悅服。賜金幣鈔及玉束帶。為宣慰使歷二十四年，遷雲南行省平章政事。尋改江西行省平章政事。巨盜鍾明亮積年為害，仙鼐討擒之。

sourceRange.text: 昔班事世祖潛邸，命長必闍赤。中統元年，以為真定路達魯花赤，改戶部尚書、宗正府札魯花赤。阿里不哥之叛，帝命昔班詣河西，督糧運給軍。還至西京北，聞萬戶阿失鐵木兒等方選士卒，將從阿里不哥。昔班矯制召其軍赴行在，阿失鐵木兒狐疑未決，昔班委曲諭之，且曰：「皇帝兄也，阿里不哥弟也。從兄順事也，又何疑焉？」阿失鐵木兒等請夜議之，期以翌日復命，且以兵圍昔班以待。明日皆至，曰：「從爾之言矣。」即便宜以西京錢糧給其軍，遂率之以行。入見，帝歎曰：「戰陣之間，得一夫之助，猶為有濟。昔班以二萬軍至，其功豈少哉！

context.afterSource: 」海都叛，世祖大閱兵，將討之。

sourceRange.text: 歲己未，世祖以親王南征，從行至汴，令專饋饟，運濟南鹽百萬斤，以給公私之費。所過州郡汴、蔡、汝、潁之間，商農安業，軍政修舉，月（乃合）〔合乃〕與有力焉。及即位，降詔褒奬。世祖將親征阿里不哥，月（乃合）〔合乃〕出私財，市馬五百以助軍。帝厚贍其家曰：「當償汝也。」拜禮部尚書，佩金虎符。四年，南邊不靖，月（乃合）〔合乃〕建言光、潁等處立榷場，歲可得鐵一百三萬七千餘斤，鑄農器二十萬事，用易粟四萬石輸官，不惟官民兩便，因可以鎮服南方。

sourceRange.text: 成宗即位，遷江浙右丞。適歲旱，方至而雨，民心大悅。未幾，平章不忽木卒，帝思之，問近侍曰：「群臣孰有似不忽木者？」賀伯顏對曰：「禿忽魯其人也，且先帝所知。」遂驛召還，賜雕鞍、弓矢，俄遷樞密副使。大德七年卒，年四十八。贈推忠翊亮佐理功臣、榮祿大夫、江浙等處行中書省平章政事、柱國、大司徒、趙國公，諡文肅。子山僧，仕至晉寧路總管。唐仁祖字壽卿，畏兀人。祖曰唐古直，子孫因以唐為氏。初，畏兀舉國效順，唐古直時年十七，給事太祖，因屬之睿宗，曰：「唐古直可任大事。」睿宗未及用，莊聖皇后擢為札魯火赤。父驥，豪爽好射獵。世祖即位，命驥為裕宗潛邸必闍赤，陞達魯花赤。

sourceRange.text: 帖哥台，初為昭勇大將軍、貴赤親軍都指揮使司達魯花赤。及改充萬戶，則以其叔父脫迭出代之。帖哥台後以萬戶改中衞親軍都指揮使，進銀青榮祿大夫、平章政事。子曰普顏忽里，曰善住。普顏忽里，懷遠大將軍、貴赤親軍都指揮使司達魯花赤。善住，初直宿衞，歷中書直省舍人、諸色人匠達魯花赤，遷奉議大夫、僉中衞親軍都指揮使司事。天曆元年九月，賜佩一珠虎符，從丞相燕帖木兒禦敵檀州等處，又率其家人那海等一十一人，自出乘馬與遼軍戰，却其軍，俘八十四人以歸。丞相嘉之。

sourceRange.text: 子燕不倫，初奉興聖太后旨，充千戶。俄改充萬戶，代其父職。尋罷，歸其父所受司徒印及萬戶符於有司，仍直宿衞。致和元年秋八月，在上都，思武宗之恩，與同志合謀奉迎文宗。會同事者見執，乃率其屬奔還大都。特賜龍衣一襲，命為通政院使。天曆元年九月，同丞相燕帖木兒敗王禪等兵于紅橋，又戰于白浮，又戰于昌平東，又戰于石槽。帝嘉其功，拜榮祿大夫知樞密院事，以世祖常御金帶賜之。

manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth month of the first year of Tianli, together with Chief Councillor Yantu Tiemuer he defeated the army of Wang Chan and others at Hongqiao, fought again at Baifu, again east of Changping, and again at Shicao.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝嘉其功，拜榮祿大夫知樞密院事，以世祖常御金帶賜之。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor praised his service, made him Grand Master of the Imperial Clan and director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and granted him the golden belt the Shizu had habitually worn.

sourceRange.text: 塔出，布兀剌子也。幼孤，長善騎射。至元元年，入侍世祖，占對多稱旨，賜以寶貨衣物。四年，給以察罕食邑賦稅之半，又還其所俘逋戶三十。七年，降金虎符，授昭勇大將軍、山東統軍使，鎮莒、密、膠、沂、郯、邳、宿、即墨等城，設方略，謹斥候，宋人不敢北嚮。九年，詔更統軍司為行樞密院，改僉樞密院事。數將兵攻下瀕淮堡柵，略地漣海，獲人畜萬計。宋人蔣德勝來降，塔出表言宜加賞賚以勸來者，於是賜黃金五十兩，白金倍之。

context.afterSource: 十年，改僉淮西等處行樞密院事，城正陽以扼淮海諸州兵。

manualTranslations.zh: 幼孤，長善騎射。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: Orphaned in childhood, he grew up skilled in riding and archery.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 1 he entered the Shizu's service; his replies often pleased the emperor, and he was rewarded with valuables and garments.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年，給以察罕食邑賦稅之半，又還其所俘逋戶三十。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year he was granted half the tax revenue of Chahan's fief and thirty escaped households he had captured were returned to him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he received half the tax revenue of Chahan's fief, and thirty fugitive households he had captured were restored to him.

manualTranslations.zh: 七年，降金虎符，授昭勇大將軍、山東統軍使，鎮莒、密、膠、沂、郯、邳、宿、即墨等城，設方略，謹斥候，宋人不敢北嚮。
manualTranslations.literal: In the seventh year he was granted the golden tiger tally and appointed General of Manifest Courage and Shandong commander-in-chief; he garrisoned Ju, Mi, Jiao, Yi, Tan, Pi, Su, Jimo, and other cities, laid plans, kept strict watch, and the Song did not dare turn north.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he received the golden tiger tally and was made General of Manifest Courage and commander-in-chief of Shandong; he garrisoned Ju, Mi, Jiao, Yi, Tan, Pi, Su, Jimo, and other cities, set strategy, maintained strict scouting, and the Song dared not march north.

manualTranslations.zh: 九年，詔更統軍司為行樞密院，改僉樞密院事。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth year an edict changed the Commandery-in-Chief Office into a Branch Bureau of Military Affairs, and he was reassigned as commissioner of the bureau.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth year an edict reorganized the commandery-in-chief office as a branch bureau of military affairs, and he was reassigned as its commissioner.

manualTranslations.zh: 數將兵攻下瀕淮堡柵，略地漣海，獲人畜萬計。
manualTranslations.literal: Repeatedly leading troops he stormed fortresses and stockades along the Huai, seized territory around Lianhai, and captured people and livestock by the tens of thousands.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He repeatedly led troops in storming Huai River fortresses and stockades, seized territory around Lianhai, and took people and livestock by the tens of thousands.

manualTranslations.zh: 宋人蔣德勝來降，塔出表言宜加賞賚以勸來者，於是賜黃金五十兩，白金倍之。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Song man Jiang Desheng came over in surrender, Tachu memorialized that generous rewards should be granted to encourage those who followed; thereupon he was granted fifty taels of gold and twice as much in silver.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Song commander Jiang Desheng surrendered, Tachu memorialized that generous rewards should be granted to encourage others to defect; he was then given fifty taels of gold and twice that amount in silver.

sourceRange.text: 子失列門，直宿衞。致和元年秋八月，從知院脫脫木兒至潮河川，獲完者八都兒、愛的斤等十二人，戮八人，執四人歸京師。復於宜興遇失剌、乃馬台等，迎戰，奮戈擊死二人，以功賞白金、楮幣。天曆元年，從擊禿滿台兒之兵于兩家店，殺其四人，復以功受賞。從戰薊州，又殺其四人。十一月，又追殺十二人于檀子山，以功授左衞阿速親軍都指揮使司僉事。曷剌，兀速兒吉氏。至元九年，見世祖，詔入太官直。從討叛王乃顏，賜白金、楮幣、甲冑、槖駝、鞍馬。以其才堪使遠，成宗時使高麗，使和林，使江西、福建，不失使指。授忠勇校尉、中書直省舍人。出監息州，遷奉訓大夫。武宗詔曰：「曷剌世祖舊臣，可授奉議大夫、都水監卿。」明年，加嘉議大夫。又明年，佩金虎符，兼直東水韃靼女直萬戶府達魯花赤。延祐元年，特授資善大夫、遼陽等處行中書省左丞，仍監其軍。三年，召還，特授榮祿大夫、大司農。卒，年六十三，贈推誠宣力保德功臣、太師、開府儀同三司、上柱國，追封薊國公，諡安穆。子不花，宿衞仁宗潛邸。及即位，特授中順大夫、中書直省舍人，改客省副使，遷太中大夫、典瑞太監，改左司員外郎、參議中書省事，拜中奉大夫、中書參知政事，資德大夫、宣徽副使、同知宣徽事，改典瑞院使，兼世其父監軍，佩金虎符，改翰林學士。至治元年，仍翰林學士，監軍，領東蕃諸部奏事。

context.afterSource: 乞台，察台氏。

manualTranslations.zh: 子失列門，直宿衞。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Shiliemen served on direct palace guard duty.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Shiliemen served as a direct palace guardsman.

manualTranslations.zh: 致和元年秋八月，從知院脫脫木兒至潮河川，獲完者八都兒、愛的斤等十二人，戮八人，執四人歸京師。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn of the first year of Zhihe he followed Director Tuotuomuer to the Chaohe River, captured twelve men including Wanzhe Badouer and Aidejin, executed eight, and brought four back to the capital.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn of Zhihe 1 he followed Director Tuotuomuer to the Chaohe River, captured twelve men including Wanzhe Badouer and Aidejin, executed eight, and brought four back to the capital.

manualTranslations.zh: 復於宜興遇失剌、乃馬台等，迎戰，奮戈擊死二人，以功賞白金、楮幣。
manualTranslations.literal: Again at Yixing he met Shila, Naimatai, and others, gave battle, brandished his spear and struck down two men, and for merit was rewarded with white gold and paper currency.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At Yixing he again met Shila, Naimatai, and others, gave battle, killed two men with his spear, and was rewarded with white gold and paper money.

manualTranslations.zh: 天曆元年，從擊禿滿台兒之兵于兩家店，殺其四人，復以功受賞。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Tianli he followed the attack on Tuman Taier's army at Liangjia Store, killed four of them, and again received reward for merit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Tianli 1 he fought Tuman Taier's army at Liangjia Store, killed four men, and was rewarded again.

manualTranslations.zh: 從戰薊州，又殺其四人。
manualTranslations.literal: Following the fighting at Jizhou, he again killed four men.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At Jizhou he killed four more men.

manualTranslations.zh: 十一月，又追殺十二人于檀子山，以功授左衞阿速親軍都指揮使司僉事。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eleventh month he again pursued and killed twelve men at Tanzi Mountain, and for merit was appointed commissioner of the Left Guard Alan Imperial Army Command.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he pursued and killed twelve men at Tanzi Mountain and, for his service, was made commissioner of the Left Guard Alan Imperial Army Command.

manualTranslations.zh: 曷剌，兀速兒吉氏。
manualTranslations.literal: Hela was of the Wusuerji clan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Hela was a Wusuerji.

manualTranslations.zh: 至元九年，見世祖，詔入太官直。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth year of Zhiyuan he was presented to the Shizu and ordered into direct service in the Imperial Kitchen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 9 he was presented to the Shizu and ordered into direct service in the Imperial Kitchen.

manualTranslations.zh: 從討叛王乃顏，賜白金、楮幣、甲冑、槖駝、鞍馬。
manualTranslations.literal: Following the suppression of the rebel prince Nayan, he was granted white gold, paper currency, armor, camels, and saddled horses.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the campaign against the rebel prince Nayan he was rewarded with white gold, paper money, armor, camels, and saddled horses.

manualTranslations.zh: 以其才堪使遠，成宗時使高麗，使和林，使江西、福建，不失使指。
manualTranslations.literal: Because his talent suited distant missions, in the Chengzong era he was envoy to Goryeo, envoy to Karakorum, and envoy to Jiangxi and Fujian, never failing his commission.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because his talents suited distant missions, under the Chengzong he served as envoy to Goryeo, Karakorum, Jiangxi, and Fujian, never failing in his commissions.

manualTranslations.zh: 授忠勇校尉、中書直省舍人。
manualTranslations.literal: He was appointed Loyal and Valiant Corrector and attendant of the Central Secretariat Direct Office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was made Loyal and Valiant Corrector and attendant of the Central Secretariat Direct Office.

manualTranslations.zh: 出監息州，遷奉訓大夫。
manualTranslations.literal: He went out to supervise Xizhou and was transferred to Grand Master for Instruction.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was posted to supervise Xizhou and promoted to Grand Master for Instruction.

manualTranslations.zh: 武宗詔曰：「曷剌世祖舊臣，可授奉議大夫、都水監卿。」
manualTranslations.literal: The Wuzong decreed: "Hela is an old minister of the Shizu; he may be appointed Grand Master for Deliberation and director of the Directorate of Waterworks."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Wuzong decreed, "Hela is an old minister of the Shizu; appoint him Grand Master for Deliberation and director of the Directorate of Waterworks."

manualTranslations.zh: 明年，加嘉議大夫。
manualTranslations.literal: The next year he was given the additional title Grand Master for Deliberation.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The following year he was further made Grand Master for Deliberation.

manualTranslations.zh: 又明年，佩金虎符，兼直東水韃靼女直萬戶府達魯花赤。
manualTranslations.literal: The year after that he bore the golden tiger tally and concurrently served as darughachi of the Eastern Water Tatar Jurchen Ten-thousand Household Office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The year after that he received the golden tiger tally and concurrently served as darughachi of the Eastern Water Tatar Jurchen Ten-thousand Household Office.

manualTranslations.zh: 延祐元年，特授資善大夫、遼陽等處行中書省左丞，仍監其軍。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Yanyou he was specially appointed Grand Master for Fostering Goodness and left councillor of the Liaoyang Branch Secretariat, still supervising his army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Yanyou 1 he was specially made Grand Master for Fostering Goodness and left councillor of the Liaoyang Branch Secretariat while continuing to supervise his army.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年，召還，特授榮祿大夫、大司農。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year he was summoned back and specially appointed Grand Master of the Imperial Clan and Grand Minister of Agriculture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year he was recalled and specially made Grand Master of the Imperial Clan and Grand Minister of Agriculture.

manualTranslations.zh: 卒，年六十三，贈推誠宣力保德功臣、太師、開府儀同三司、上柱國，追封薊國公，諡安穆。
manualTranslations.literal: He died at age sixty-three, was posthumously made Meritorious Minister for Sincere Promotion and Preserving Virtue, Grand Preceptor, Grand Master with Imperial Banners Equal to the Three Dukes, and Pillar of the State, enfeoffed as Duke of Ji, and given the posthumous title Anmu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died at sixty-three and was posthumously honored as Meritorious Minister for Sincere Promotion and Preserving Virtue, Grand Preceptor, Grand Master with Imperial Banners Equal to the Three Dukes, and Pillar of the State, enfeoffed as Duke of Ji with the posthumous name Anmu.

manualTranslations.zh: 子不花，宿衞仁宗潛邸。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Buhua guarded the Renzong's hidden residence.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Buhua served in the guard of the Renzong's household while he was still heir apparent.

manualTranslations.zh: 及即位，特授中順大夫、中書直省舍人，改客省副使，遷太中大夫、典瑞太監，改左司員外郎、參議中書省事，拜中奉大夫、中書參知政事，資德大夫、宣徽副使、同知宣徽事，改典瑞院使，兼世其父監軍，佩金虎符，改翰林學士。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Renzong succeeded, he was specially appointed Grand Master of the Palace, attendant of the Central Secretariat Direct Office, changed to vice envoy of the Guest Reception Office, transferred to Grand Master of the Palace and director of the Registry of Insignia, changed to outer section vice director and deliberator of Central Secretariat affairs, appointed Grand Master for the Promotion of Governance and vice administrator of the Secretariat, Grand Master of Cultivated Virtue, vice commissioner and vice administrator of the Xuanhui Commission, changed to chief of the Registry of Insignia Court while inheriting his father's army supervision, bore the golden tiger tally, and was changed to Hanlin academician.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Renzong succeeded, he was specially made Grand Master of the Palace and attendant of the Central Secretariat Direct Office, then vice envoy of the Guest Reception Office, director of the Registry of Insignia, outer section vice director and deliberator of Secretariat affairs, vice administrator of the Secretariat, Grand Master of Cultivated Virtue, vice commissioner of the Xuanhui Commission, chief of the Registry of Insignia Court while inheriting his father's army command, bearer of the golden tiger tally, and Hanlin academician.

manualTranslations.zh: 至治元年，仍翰林學士，監軍，領東蕃諸部奏事。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Zhizhi he remained Hanlin academician, supervised the army, and handled memorials from the various eastern tribes.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Zhizhi 1 he remained Hanlin academician, supervised the army, and handled memorials from the eastern tribes.

sourceRange.text: 脫因納，答答叉氏。世祖時從征乃顏，以功受上賞。大德七年，授欽察衞親軍千戶所達魯花赤、武德將軍，賜金符。八年，改太僕少卿。十年，遷阿兒魯軍萬戶府達魯花赤，易金虎符，進階懷遠大將軍。尋改中奉大夫、太僕少卿，仍兼前職。至大二年，拜甘肅行尚書省參知政事、通奉大夫。四年，入為太僕卿，陞正奉大夫。皇慶元年，授阿兒魯萬戶府襄陽漢軍達魯花赤，仍領太僕卿。延祐三年，拜資德大夫、甘肅行中書右丞。至治二年，改通政使，轉會福院使，尋復通政。致和元年，分院上都。秋八月，為倒剌沙所殺。文宗即位，特贈宣力守義功臣、榮祿大夫、上柱國、中書平章政事，追封冀國公，諡忠景。有子曰定童、只（沈）〔兒〕哈朗。

manualTranslations.zh: 脫因納，答答叉氏。
manualTranslations.literal: Tuoyinna was of the Dadacha clan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tuoyinna was a Dadacha.

manualTranslations.zh: 世祖時從征乃顏，以功受上賞。
manualTranslations.literal: In the Shizu era he followed the campaign against Nayan and for merit received the highest reward.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Under the Shizu he campaigned against Nayan and received the highest reward for his service.

manualTranslations.zh: 大德七年，授欽察衞親軍千戶所達魯花赤、武德將軍，賜金符。
manualTranslations.literal: In the seventh year of Dade he was appointed darughachi of the Qincha Imperial Guard Thousand-household Office and General of Martial Virtue, and granted the golden tally.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Dade 7 he was made darughachi of the Qincha Imperial Guard Thousand-household Office and General of Martial Virtue, with the golden tally.

manualTranslations.zh: 八年，改太僕少卿。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighth year he was transferred to vice director of the Imperial Stud.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was transferred to vice director of the Imperial Stud.

manualTranslations.zh: 十年，遷阿兒魯軍萬戶府達魯花赤，易金虎符，進階懷遠大將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: In the tenth year he was moved to darughachi of the Aerlu Army Ten-thousand Household Office, exchanged his tally for the golden tiger tally, and was advanced to General for Pacification at a Distance.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was transferred to darughachi of the Aerlu Army Ten-thousand Household Office, received the golden tiger tally, and was promoted to General for Pacification at a Distance.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋改中奉大夫、太僕少卿，仍兼前職。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he was changed to Grand Master for the Promotion of Governance and vice director of the Imperial Stud, still concurrently holding his former post.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was soon made Grand Master for the Promotion of Governance and vice director of the Imperial Stud while retaining his former post.

manualTranslations.zh: 至大二年，拜甘肅行尚書省參知政事、通奉大夫。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Zhida he was appointed vice administrator of the Gansu Branch Secretariat and Grand Master for the Promotion of Governance.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Zhida 2 he was made vice administrator of the Gansu Branch Secretariat and Grand Master for the Promotion of Governance.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年，入為太僕卿，陞正奉大夫。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year he entered service as director of the Imperial Stud and was raised to Grand Master for the Promotion of Governance.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he became director of the Imperial Stud and was promoted to Grand Master for the Promotion of Governance.

manualTranslations.zh: 皇慶元年，授阿兒魯萬戶府襄陽漢軍達魯花赤，仍領太僕卿。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Huangqing he was appointed darughachi of the Han army of the Xiangyang Ten-thousand Household Office under the Aerlu command and still headed the Imperial Stud.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Huangqing 1 he was made darughachi of the Han forces of the Xiangyang Ten-thousand Household under the Aerlu command while continuing as director of the Imperial Stud.

manualTranslations.zh: 延祐三年，拜資德大夫、甘肅行中書右丞。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year of Yanyou he was appointed Grand Master of Cultivated Virtue and right councillor of the Gansu Branch Secretariat.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Yanyou 3 he was made Grand Master of Cultivated Virtue and right councillor of the Gansu Branch Secretariat.

manualTranslations.zh: 至治二年，改通政使，轉會福院使，尋復通政。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Zhizhi he was changed to communications commissioner, transferred to chief of the Huifu Court, and soon restored to communications commissioner.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Zhizhi 2 he was made communications commissioner, then chief of the Huifu Court, and soon returned to the communications commission.

manualTranslations.zh: 致和元年，分院上都。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Zhihe he headed a branch office at Shangdu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Zhihe 1 he headed a branch office at Shangdu.

manualTranslations.zh: 秋八月，為倒剌沙所殺。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn he was killed by Doulasha.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn he was killed by Doulasha.

manualTranslations.zh: 文宗即位，特贈宣力守義功臣、榮祿大夫、上柱國、中書平章政事，追封冀國公，諡忠景。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Wenzong succeeded, he was specially posthumously made Meritorious Minister for Upholding Strength and Keeping Faith, Grand Master of the Imperial Clan, Pillar of the State, and Grand Councillor of the Secretariat, enfeoffed as Duke of Ji, and given the posthumous title Zhongjing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Wenzong succeeded, he was posthumously honored as Meritorious Minister for Upholding Strength and Keeping Faith, Grand Master of the Imperial Clan, Pillar of the State, and Grand Councillor of the Secretariat, enfeoffed as Duke of Ji with the posthumous name Zhongjing.

manualTranslations.zh: 有子曰定童、只兒哈朗。
manualTranslations.literal: He had sons Dingtong and Zhierhalang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He had two sons, Dingtong and Zhierhalang.

items.acceptedSourceText: 脫因納，答答叉氏。世祖時從征乃顏，以功受上賞。大德七年，授欽察衞親軍千戶所達魯花赤、武德將軍，賜金符。八年，改太僕少卿。十年，遷阿兒魯軍萬戶府達魯花赤，易金虎符，進階懷遠大將軍。尋改中奉大夫、太僕少卿，仍兼前職。至大二年，拜甘肅行尚書省參知政事、通奉大夫。四年，入為太僕卿，陞正奉大夫。皇慶元年，授阿兒魯萬戶府襄陽漢軍達魯花赤，仍領太僕卿。延祐三年，拜資德大夫、甘肅行中書右丞。至治二年，改通政使，轉會福院使，尋復通政。致和元年，分院上都。秋八月，為倒剌沙所殺。文宗即位，特贈宣力守義功臣、榮祿大夫、上柱國、中書平章政事，追封冀國公，諡忠景。有子曰定童、只兒哈朗。

sourceRange.text: 陞宣武將軍、管軍總管。從也速答兒征亦奚不薛，又從征都掌蠻，皆以為前鋒，殺獲甚眾。九溪蠻、散猫、大盤蠻尚木的世用等叛，從行省曲立吉思帥師往討，皆擒之，及殺其酋長頭狗等。也速答兒、藥剌罕率兵萬人會雲南兵討烏蒙蠻，至閙竈，其酋長阿蒙率五百餘眾奔麻布蠻地，塔海帖木兒以四百人追至山箐中，大敗之，擒阿蒙以歸。二十六年，又從也速答兒西征，不知所終。口兒吉，阿速氏。憲宗時，與父福得來賜俱直宿衞，領阿速軍二十戶。世祖時，口兒吉以百戶從元帥阿朮伐宋有功，賜以白金等物。宋平，命充大宗正府也可扎魯花赤，領阿速軍從征海都，以功授上賞。師還，成宗命宣撫湖廣等處，訪求民瘼，還仍舊職。至大元年，武宗命充左衞阿速親軍都指揮使，進階廣威將軍。四年，卒。子的迷的兒，由玉典赤改百戶，領阿速軍。從指揮玉爪失征叛王乃顏，却金剛奴軍于鏁寶直之地，降哈丹禿魯干，累以功受賞。至大四年，襲父職，授明威將軍、阿速親軍都指揮使。子香山，事武宗、仁宗，直宿衞。天曆元年九月，兵興，從戰宜興，擊殺敵兵七人，自旦至暮，却敵兵凡一十三處。以功賜金帶一，授左阿速衞都指揮使。

manualTranslations.zh: 口兒吉，阿速氏。
manualTranslations.literal: Kou'erji was of the Alan clan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Kou'erji was an Alan.

manualTranslations.zh: 憲宗時，與父福得來賜俱直宿衞，領阿速軍二十戶。
manualTranslations.literal: In the Xianzong era he and his father Fudelaici both served on direct palace guard duty and led twenty households of Alan troops.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Under the Xianzong he and his father Fudelaici both served as direct palace guardsmen and commanded twenty Alan households.

manualTranslations.zh: 世祖時，口兒吉以百戶從元帥阿朮伐宋有功，賜以白金等物。
manualTranslations.literal: In the Shizu era Kou'erji, as hundred-household commander, followed Marshal Azu in attacking the Song with merit and was granted white silver and other goods.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Under the Shizu, Kou'erji served as hundred-household commander under Marshal Azu against the Song, distinguished himself, and was rewarded with silver and other goods.

manualTranslations.zh: 宋平，命充大宗正府也可扎魯花赤，領阿速軍從征海都，以功授上賞。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Song were pacified he was ordered to serve as yeke jarquchi darughachi of the Grand Council of the Central Secretariat for Mongol Affairs, led Alan troops in campaigning against Kaidu, and for merit received the highest reward.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After the Song conquest he was appointed yeke jarquchi darughachi of the Grand Council of the Central Secretariat for Mongol Affairs, led Alan troops against Kaidu, and received the highest reward for his service.

manualTranslations.zh: 師還，成宗命宣撫湖廣等處，訪求民瘼，還仍舊職。
manualTranslations.literal: When the army returned, the Chengzong ordered him to pacify and reassure Huguang and other regions, inquire into the people's hardships, and on returning he resumed his former post.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After the campaign the Chengzong sent him to pacify Huguang and other regions, investigate popular grievances, and on his return he resumed his former office.

manualTranslations.zh: 至大元年，武宗命充左衞阿速親軍都指揮使，進階廣威將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Zhida the Wuzong ordered him to fill the post of commander of the Left Guard Alan Imperial Army and advanced him to General of Expansive Might.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Zhida 1 the Wuzong appointed him commander of the Left Guard Alan Imperial Army and promoted him to General of Expansive Might.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年，卒。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year he died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he died.

manualTranslations.zh: 子的迷的兒，由玉典赤改百戶，領阿速軍。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Dimadier, transferred from yudianchi attendant to hundred-household commander, led the Alan army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Dimadier, transferred from imperial attendant to hundred-household commander, commanded the Alan forces.

manualTranslations.zh: 從指揮玉爪失征叛王乃顏，却金剛奴軍于鏁寶直之地，降哈丹禿魯干，累以功受賞。
manualTranslations.literal: Following Commander Yuzhuashi he campaigned against the rebel prince Nayan, repelled Jingangnu's army at Suobaozhi, reduced Hadan Tulugan, and repeatedly received rewards for merit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He followed Commander Yuzhuashi against the rebel prince Nayan, repelled Jingangnu's army at Suobaozhi, accepted the surrender of Hadan Tulugan, and was repeatedly rewarded for his service.

manualTranslations.zh: 至大四年，襲父職，授明威將軍、阿速親軍都指揮使。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhida he inherited his father's post and was appointed General of Manifest Might and commander of the Alan Imperial Army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Zhida 4 he succeeded his father and was made General of Manifest Might and commander of the Alan Imperial Army.

manualTranslations.zh: 子香山，事武宗、仁宗，直宿衞。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Xiangshan served the Wuzong and Renzong on direct palace guard duty.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Xiangshan served the Wuzong and Renzong as a direct palace guardsman.

manualTranslations.zh: 天曆元年九月，兵興，從戰宜興，擊殺敵兵七人，自旦至暮，却敵兵凡一十三處。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth month of the first year of Tianli, when war arose, he followed the fighting at Yixing, struck down seven enemy soldiers, and from dawn to dusk repelled enemy forces at thirteen places.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of Tianli 1, when war broke out, he fought at Yixing, killed seven enemy soldiers, and from dawn to dusk drove back enemy forces at thirteen points.

manualTranslations.zh: 以功賜金帶一，授左阿速衞都指揮使。
manualTranslations.literal: For merit he was granted one golden belt and appointed commander of the Left Alan Guard.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: For his service he received a golden belt and was appointed commander of the Left Alan Guard.

sourceRange.text: 忽林失初直宿衞。

context.afterSource: 後以千戶從征乃顏，馳馬奮戈，衝擊敵營，矢下如雨，身被三十三創。

sourceRange.text: 至太宗時，為鎮西行省，領蒙古、漢軍。從攻河中、潼關、河南，與拜只思、扎忽歹、阿思蘭攻秦鞏及仁和諸堡，又與拜只思守京兆。歲乙未，授左手萬戶，從都元帥答海鉗卜出征，卒軍中。憲宗命忽都將其軍從都元帥大答攻巴州，又從都元帥紐璘渡馬湖江，破宋敍州兵於老君山下。中統元年，宋將以舟師二千犯成都新津，忽都逆擊敗之，斬首百五十級。至元元年，授蒙古漢軍總管。二年，從都元帥百家奴敗宋將夏貴於懷安。五年，卒。子扎忽帶，時在宿衞，弟忽都答立襲其職。忽都答立卒，札忽帶嗣，為千戶，從行樞密院圍重慶。

localRange.text: 至太宗時為鎮西行省，領蒙古、漢軍從攻河中、潼關、河南，與拜只思、扎忽歹、阿思蘭攻秦鞏及仁和諸堡，又與拜只思守京兆。歲乙未，授左手萬戶，從都元帥荅海鉗卜出征，卒軍中。子扎忽帶，時在宿衛，弟忽都荅立襲其職。忽都荅立卒，札忽帶嗣，為千戶，從行樞密院圍重慶。

context.beforeSource: 父孛罕，事太祖，備宿衞。
context.afterSource: 重慶守張珏遣勁兵數千出挑戰，札忽帶力戰大破之。

manualTranslations.zh: 至太宗時，為鎮西行省，領蒙古、漢軍。
manualTranslations.literal: In the Taizong era he was made the Western Pacification Branch Secretariat and led Mongol and Han troops.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Under the Taizong he headed the Western Pacification Branch Secretariat and commanded Mongol and Han forces.

manualTranslations.zh: 從攻河中、潼關、河南，與拜只思、扎忽歹、阿思蘭攻秦鞏及仁和諸堡，又與拜只思守京兆。
manualTranslations.literal: He followed in attacking Hezhong, Tongguan, and Henan; with Baizisi, Zhahudai, and Asilan he attacked the Qin-Gong and Renhe forts; and again with Baizisi he defended Jingzhao.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He fought at Hezhong, Tongguan, and Henan; with Baizisi, Zhahudai, and Asilan he stormed the Qin-Gong and Renhe strongholds; and with Baizisi he held Jingzhao.

manualTranslations.zh: 歲乙未，授左手萬戶，從都元帥答海鉗卜出征，卒軍中。
manualTranslations.literal: In the yiwei year he was made Left Hand Ten-thousand Household and followed Commander-in-Chief Dahai Qianbu on campaign, dying in the army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In yiwei he was made commander of the Left Hand Ten-thousand Household and followed Commander-in-Chief Dahai Qianbu on campaign, dying in the field.

manualTranslations.zh: 憲宗命忽都將其軍從都元帥大答攻巴州，又從都元帥紐璘渡馬湖江，破宋敍州兵於老君山下。
manualTranslations.literal: The Xianzong ordered Hudu to lead his army and follow Commander-in-Chief Dada in attacking Bazhou, and again follow Commander-in-Chief Niulin across the Mahu River and defeat the Song forces of Xuzhou below Laojun Mountain.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Xianzong ordered Hudu to lead his army under Commander-in-Chief Dada against Bazhou, then under Commander-in-Chief Niulin across the Mahu River, where he defeated the Song forces of Xuzhou below Laojun Mountain.

manualTranslations.zh: 中統元年，宋將以舟師二千犯成都新津，忽都逆擊敗之，斬首百五十級。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Zhongtong a Song general with two thousand warships attacked Xindu of Chengdu; Hudu met the attack and defeated them, beheading one hundred fifty.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Zhongtong 1 a Song commander attacked Xindu near Chengdu with two thousand warships; Hudu met the attack, defeated them, and took one hundred fifty heads.

manualTranslations.zh: 至元元年，授蒙古漢軍總管。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Zhiyuan he was appointed commander of Mongol and Han troops.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 1 he was made commander of Mongol and Han forces.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年，從都元帥百家奴敗宋將夏貴於懷安。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year he followed Commander-in-Chief Baijianu in defeating the Song general Xia Gui at Huaian.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year he followed Commander-in-Chief Baijianu in defeating the Song commander Xia Gui at Huaian.

manualTranslations.zh: 五年，卒。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth year he died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he died.

sourceRange.text: 從武宗親征哈剌阿答。

context.afterSource: 復從創兀兒征不別、八憐，為前鋒，以功受賞賚。

manualTranslations.zh: 子斡羅思，由宿衞陞僉隆鎮衞都指揮使司事，賜一珠虎符。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Woluosi, from palace guard service, was raised to commissioner of the Longzhen Guard Command and granted the one-pearl tiger tally.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Woluosi rose from palace guard duty to commissioner of the Longzhen Guard Command and received the one-pearl tiger tally.

manualTranslations.zh: 天曆元年，諭降上都軍凡若干數，特賜三珠虎符，陞本衞都指揮使。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Tianli he was ordered to induce the surrender of a certain number of Shangdu troops, was specially granted the three-pearl tiger tally, and was raised to commander of that guard.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Tianli 1 he was ordered to accept the surrender of a large body of Shangdu troops, was specially granted the three-pearl tiger tally, and was promoted to commander of the guard.

sourceRange.text: 至大三年，進忠翊校尉、後衞親軍副千戶，賜金符。延祐二年，江西寧都寇起，殺守土官吏，從元帥乞住等總兵討之，生擒賊酋蔡五九誅之，擣其巢穴。致和元年八月，西安王以兵討倒剌沙，命從丞相燕帖木兒擒烏伯都剌，分兵備禦。天曆元年九月，從戰通州，以功賞名馬。從擊犯紅橋之兵，手戈刺死二人，敗之，奪紅橋。及紐（鄰）澤大夫等力戰於白浮，殺其四人。和尚白丞相曰：「兩軍相戰，當有辨，今號纓俱黑，無辨，我軍宜易以白。」丞相然之。戰于昌平栗園，殺二人。又與亞失帖木兒戰于石槽，殺三人。十月，從擊禿滿台兒於檀州南桑口，敗之。又從丞相追擊其軍于檀州之北，有功。十一月，命領八衞把總金鼓都鎮撫司事。

context.beforeSource: 怯烈吉卒，和尚襲。
context.beforeLocal: 怯烈吉卒，和尚襲。

manualTranslations.zh: 至大三年，進忠翊校尉、後衞親軍副千戶，賜金符。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year of Zhida he was advanced to Loyal Assistant Corrector and vice thousand-household commander of the Rear Guard Imperial Army, and granted the golden tally.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Zhida 3 he was promoted to Loyal Assistant Corrector and vice thousand-household commander of the Rear Guard Imperial Army and received the golden tally.

manualTranslations.zh: 延祐二年，江西寧都寇起，殺守土官吏，從元帥乞住等總兵討之，生擒賊酋蔡五九誅之，擣其巢穴。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Yanyou bandits rose in Ningdu, Jiangxi, killing local officials; he followed Marshal Qizhu and others in commanding troops to suppress them, captured the bandit chief Cai Wujiu alive and executed him, and destroyed their lair.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Yanyou 2 bandits rose in Ningdu, Jiangxi, and killed local officials; he followed Marshal Qizhu and others against them, captured the bandit chief Cai Wujiu alive and executed him, and destroyed their stronghold.

manualTranslations.zh: 致和元年八月，西安王以兵討倒剌沙，命從丞相燕帖木兒擒烏伯都剌，分兵備禦。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighth month of the first year of Zhihe the Prince of Xi'an marched with troops against Doulasha and ordered him to follow Chief Councillor Yantu Tiemuer in capturing Wubudoula and dividing forces for defense.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Zhihe 1 the Prince of Xi'an marched against Doulasha and ordered him to follow Chief Councillor Yantu Tiemuer in capturing Wubudoula while detaching troops for defense.

manualTranslations.zh: 天曆元年九月，從戰通州，以功賞名馬。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth month of the first year of Tianli he followed the fighting at Tongzhou and for merit was rewarded with a famous horse.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of Tianli 1 he fought at Tongzhou and was rewarded with a fine horse for his service.

manualTranslations.zh: 從擊犯紅橋之兵，手戈刺死二人，敗之，奪紅橋。
manualTranslations.literal: He followed the attack on the troops assaulting Hongqiao, personally speared two men to death with his halberd, defeated them, and seized Hongqiao.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He joined the attack on the troops assaulting Hongqiao, personally killed two men with his halberd, routed them, and seized Hongqiao.

manualTranslations.zh: 及紐澤大夫等力戰於白浮，殺其四人。
manualTranslations.literal: Together with Niuzedafu and others he fought fiercely at Baifu and killed four men.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: With Niuzedafu and others he fought fiercely at Baifu and killed four men.

manualTranslations.zh: 和尚白丞相曰：「兩軍相戰，當有辨，今號纓俱黑，無辨，我軍宜易以白。」
manualTranslations.literal: Heshang told the chief councillor: "When two armies fight there should be distinction; now the tassel badges are all black and indistinguishable; our army should change to white."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Heshang told the chief councillor, "When two armies fight they must be distinguishable; now all the tassel badges are black and indistinguishable, so our army should change to white."

manualTranslations.zh: 丞相然之。
manualTranslations.literal: The chief councillor agreed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The chief councillor agreed.

manualTranslations.zh: 戰于昌平栗園，殺二人。
manualTranslations.literal: He fought at Chestnut Garden in Changping and killed two men.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He fought at Chestnut Garden in Changping and killed two men.

manualTranslations.zh: 又與亞失帖木兒戰于石槽，殺三人。
manualTranslations.literal: Again he fought Yashitemuer at Shicao and killed three men.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He again fought Yashitemuer at Shicao and killed three men.

manualTranslations.zh: 十月，從擊禿滿台兒於檀州南桑口，敗之。
manualTranslations.literal: In the tenth month he followed the attack on Tuman Taier at Nansangkou, Tanzhou, and defeated him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he joined the attack on Tuman Taier at Nansangkou in Tanzhou and defeated him.

manualTranslations.zh: 又從丞相追擊其軍于檀州之北，有功。
manualTranslations.literal: Again he followed the chief councillor in pursuing that army north of Tanzhou and had merit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He again followed the chief councillor in pursuing that army north of Tanzhou and distinguished himself.

manualTranslations.zh: 十一月，命領八衞把總金鼓都鎮撫司事。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eleventh month he was ordered to head the Eight Guards Command Banner General Gold-Drum Pacification Office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he was ordered to head the Eight Guards Command Banner General Gold-Drum Pacification Office.

items.acceptedSourceText: 至大三年，進忠翊校尉、後衞親軍副千戶，賜金符。延祐二年，江西寧都寇起，殺守土官吏，從元帥乞住等總兵討之，生擒賊酋蔡五九誅之，擣其巢穴。致和元年八月，西安王以兵討倒剌沙，命從丞相燕帖木兒擒烏伯都剌，分兵備禦。天曆元年九月，從戰通州，以功賞名馬。從擊犯紅橋之兵，手戈刺死二人，敗之，奪紅橋。及紐澤大夫等力戰於白浮，殺其四人。和尚白丞相曰：「兩軍相戰，當有辨，今號纓俱黑，無辨，我軍宜易以白。」丞相然之。戰于昌平栗園，殺二人。又與亞失帖木兒戰于石槽，殺三人。十月，從擊禿滿台兒於檀州南桑口，敗之。又從丞相追擊其軍于檀州之北，有功。十一月，命領八衞把總金鼓都鎮撫司事。

sourceRange.text: 至元三十年，海都叛，成宗以皇孫撫軍於北。阿沙不花從行，踰金山戰杭海有功。成宗即位，會大宗正扎魯火赤脫兒速以贓污聞，詔鞫問之，脫兒速伏罪，就命代之。成宗目之曰阿即剌。阿即剌，譯言閻羅王也。有訴朱清、張瑄陰私，既抵罪，帝遣兵馬都指揮使忽剌朮籍沒其家，以受賂誅。更命阿沙不花往，具以實聞，賜宅一區、鈔萬五千緡，兼兩城兵馬都指揮使事。武宗時為懷寧王，總軍漠北，問：「今日材可大用者為誰？」對曰：「母弟脫脫將相才也，無以易之。」遂命從行，後果為名臣。成宗崩，安西王阿難答乘間謀繼大統，成后及丞相阿忽台、諸王迷里帖木兒皆陰為之助。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan were accused of secret misconduct and convicted, the emperor sent Military and Horse Commander Hulazhu to confiscate their property; Hulazhu was executed for taking bribes.

sourceRange.text: 至鎮，斬為盜者一人。分遣使者賑降戶。奏出鈔帛易牛羊以給之，近水者教取魚食。會大雪，民無取得食，命諸部置傳車，相去各三百里，凡十傳，轉米數萬石以餉饑民，不足則益以牛羊。又度地置內倉，積粟以待來者。浚古渠，溉田數千頃。治稱海屯田，教部落雜耕其間，歲得米二十餘萬。北邊大治。至大元年，賜大帳，如諸王諸藩禮。〔閏〕十一月，寢疾，語其屬曰：「吾不復能佐理國事矣。行省之務，汝曹勉之，毋貽朝廷憂。」薨，年五十二。帝聞之，驚悼曰：「喪我賢相。」賻鈔二萬五千貫。詔歸葬昌平，追贈推誠履政佐運功臣、太師、開府儀同三司、上柱國，追封順德王，諡忠獻。子脫歡，由太子賓客拜御史中丞，襲號答剌罕，進御史大夫，行臺江南。

sourceRange.text: 拜住，安童孫也。五歲而孤，太夫人教養之。稍長，宏遠端亮，有祖風。至大二年，襲為宿衞長。仁宗即位，延祐二年，拜資善大夫、太常禮儀院使。四年，進榮祿大夫、大司徒。五年，進金紫光祿大夫。六年，加開府儀同三司，餘並如故。每議大政，必問曰：「合典故否？」同官有異見者，曰：「大朝止說典故耶？」拜住微笑曰：「公試言之，國朝何事不依典故？」同官不能對。太常事簡，每退食必延儒士諮訪古今禮樂刑政、治亂得失，盡日不倦。嘗曰：「人之仕宦，隨所職司，事皆可習。至於學問有本，施於事業，此儒者之能事，宰相之資也。

context.beforeSource: 後遷翰林侍讀學士。
context.afterSource: 」英宗在東宮，問宿衞之臣於左右，咸稱拜住賢。

manualTranslations.zh: 四年，進榮祿大夫、大司徒。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year he was advanced to Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and Grand Steward.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was promoted to Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and Grand Steward.

manualTranslations.zh: 五年，進金紫光祿大夫。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth year he was advanced to Grand Master of the Golden Purple and Glorious Happiness.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was promoted to Grand Master of the Golden Purple and Glorious Happiness.

manualTranslations.zh: 六年，加開府儀同三司，餘並如故。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth year he was granted Commissioner with Equal Protocol to the Three Dukes, with all else remaining as before.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was granted Commissioner with Equal Protocol to the Three Dukes, with all else remaining as before.

manualTranslations.zh: 每議大政，必問曰：「合典故否？」
manualTranslations.literal: Whenever great affairs of government were discussed, he invariably asked, "Does this accord with precedent?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Whenever great affairs of government were discussed, he invariably asked, "Does this accord with precedent?"

manualTranslations.zh: 同官有異見者，曰：「大朝止說典故耶？」
manualTranslations.literal: A colleague who held a different view said, "Does the great court speak of nothing but precedent?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: A colleague who disagreed said, "Does the great court speak of nothing but precedent?"

manualTranslations.zh: 拜住微笑曰：「公試言之，國朝何事不依典故？」
manualTranslations.literal: Baizhu smiled and said, "Try to say—what affair of the dynastic state does not follow precedent?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Baizhu smiled and said, "Try to say—what affair of the dynastic state does not follow precedent?"

manualTranslations.zh: 同官不能對。
manualTranslations.literal: The colleague could not reply.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The colleague could not reply.

manualTranslations.zh: 太常事簡，每退食必延儒士諮訪古今禮樂刑政、治亂得失，盡日不倦。
manualTranslations.literal: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices had light duties; after each meal he invariably summoned Confucian scholars to consult on ancient and modern ritual, music, penal administration, political order and disorder, gains and losses, spending the whole day without tiring.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices had light duties; after each meal he summoned Confucian scholars to consult on ancient and modern ritual, music, penal administration, and the gains and losses of order and disorder, spending the whole day without tiring.

manualTranslations.zh: 嘗曰：「人之仕宦，隨所職司，事皆可習。
manualTranslations.literal: He once said, "In human official service, following one's office, affairs may all be learned.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He once said, "In official service, following one's office, affairs may all be learned.

manualTranslations.zh: 至於學問有本，施於事業，此儒者之能事，宰相之資也。」
manualTranslations.literal: But as for learning with root, applied to achievement—this is what the Confucian excels at, and the chancellor's qualification."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: But learning with root, applied to achievement—this is what the Confucian excels at, and the chancellor's qualification."

sourceRange.text: 至大元年，閱戶口江南諸省，還進太子府正，加昭文館大學士，遷家令。武宗崩，仁宗哀慟不已。察罕再拜啟曰：「庶民修短，尚云有數，聖人天命，夫豈偶然？天下重器懸於殿下，縱自苦，如宗廟、太后何？」仁宗輟泣曰：「曩者大喪必命浮屠，何益？吾欲發府庫以賑鰥寡孤獨，若何？」曰：「發政施仁，文王所以為聖。殿下行之幸甚。」東宮故有左右衞兵，命囊加台、察罕總右衞，且令審擇官屬。仁宗即位，拜中書參知政事，但總持綱維，不屑細務，識者謂得大臣體。

manualTranslations.zh: 武宗崩，仁宗哀慟不已。
manualTranslations.literal: When Wuzong died, Renzong grieved and mourned unceasingly.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Wuzong died, Renzong grieved without cease.

manualTranslations.zh: 察罕再拜啟曰：「庶民修短，尚云有數，聖人天命，夫豈偶然？
manualTranslations.literal: Chahan bowed twice and addressed him, saying: "The length of a commoner's life is said to have its allotted span; the mandate of a sage is Heaven's will—how could it be mere chance?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chahan bowed twice and addressed him: "Even commoners' allotted spans are said to be fixed; how much less could a sage's mandate be mere chance?

manualTranslations.zh: 天下重器懸於殿下，縱自苦，如宗廟、太后何？」
manualTranslations.literal: The great vessel of the realm hangs upon Your Highness; even if you afflict yourself, what of the ancestral temples and the empress dowager?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The great charge of empire rests upon Your Highness; if you afflict yourself, what becomes of the ancestral temples and the empress dowager?"

manualTranslations.zh: 仁宗輟泣曰：「曩者大喪必命浮屠，何益？
manualTranslations.literal: Renzong checked his weeping and said: "In past great mourning Buddhist monks were always summoned—of what use was it?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Renzong restrained his tears and said: "At past imperial funerals Buddhist monks were always summoned—what good did it do?

manualTranslations.zh: 吾欲發府庫以賑鰥寡孤獨，若何？」
manualTranslations.literal: I wish to open the treasury to relieve widowers, widows, orphans, and the solitary—what do you think?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I wish to open the treasury to relieve widowers, widows, orphans, and the helpless—what say you?"

manualTranslations.zh: 曰：「發政施仁，文王所以為聖。
manualTranslations.literal: He said: "Issuing benevolent policies and dispensing kindness—this is why King Wen became a sage.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He replied: "Issuing benevolent policies and extending kindness—this is why King Wen became a sage.

manualTranslations.zh: 殿下行之幸甚。」
manualTranslations.literal: If Your Highness carries it out, it would be most fortunate."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: If Your Highness does the same, it would be a great blessing."

manualTranslations.zh: 東宮故有左右衞兵，命囊加台、察罕總右衞，且令審擇官屬。
manualTranslations.literal: The Eastern Palace had long had left and right guard troops; he ordered Nangatai and Chahan to command the Right Guard, and also directed them to scrutinize and select officials.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Eastern Palace already had left and right guard troops. Renzong ordered Nangatai and Chahan to command the Right Guard and directed them to select their staff with care.

manualTranslations.zh: 仁宗即位，拜中書參知政事，但總持綱維，不屑細務，識者謂得大臣體。
manualTranslations.literal: When Renzong took the throne, Chahan was appointed Associate Grand Councillor of the Central Secretariat; he held only to the great principles and disdained petty affairs, and those who understood such things said he had the bearing of a great minister.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Renzong ascended the throne, Chahan was made associate grand councillor of the Central Secretariat. He held to the broad outlines of policy and disdained petty detail, and observers said he had the bearing of a true statesman.

sourceRange.text: 九月，懷王即皇帝位，是為文宗，特加伯顏銀青榮祿大夫，仍領宿衞。尋加太尉，賜黃金二百五十兩、白金一千兩、楮幣二十五萬緡，進開府儀同三司、錄軍國重事、御史大夫、中政院使。天曆二年正月，拜太保。二月，加授儲慶使，加賜虎符，特授忠翊侍衞親軍都指揮使。未幾，明宗即位，文宗居東宮，拜太子詹事、太保，開府如故。八月，拜中書左丞相。明宗崩，文宗嗣位，加儲政院使。三年正月，拜知樞密院事。至順元年，文宗以伯顏功大，不有異數不足以報稱，特命尚世祖闊〔闊〕出太子女孫曰卜顏的斤，分賜虎士三百：怯薛丹百、默而吉軍百、阿速軍百，隸左右宿衞。又賜黃金雙龍符，鐫文曰「廣忠宣義正節振武佐運功臣」，組以寶帶，世為明券。又命凡宴飲視諸宗王禮。二年八月，進封浚寧王，特加授侍正府侍正，追封其先三世為王。又加伯顏昭功宣毅萬戶、忠翊侍衞都指揮使。三年，拜太傅，加徽政使。八月，文宗崩。十月，伯顏奉太皇太后命，立明宗之子懿璘質班，是為寧宗。十一月，寧宗崩。

sourceRange.text: 四年，文宗大漸，遺詔立兄明宗之子。已而文宗崩，明宗次子懿璘質班即位，四十三日而崩。文宗后臨朝。燕鐵木兒與羣臣議立文宗子燕帖古思。文宗后曰：「天位至重，吾兒年方幼冲，豈能任耶！明宗有子妥懽貼睦爾，出居廣西，今年十三矣，可嗣大統。」於是奉太后命，召還京師，至良鄉，具鹵簿迎之。燕鐵木兒與之並馬而行，於馬上舉鞭指畫，告以國家多難遣使奉迎之故。而妥懽貼睦爾卒無一語酬之。燕鐵木兒疑其意不可測，且明宗之崩，實與逆謀，恐其即位之後追舉前事，故宿留數月，而心志日以瞀亂。先是，燕鐵木兒自秉大權以來，挾震主之威，肆意無忌。一宴或宰十三馬，取泰定帝后為夫人，前後尚宗室之女四十人，或有交禮三日遽遣歸者，而後房充斥不能盡識。一日宴趙世延家，男女列坐，名鴛鴦會。見座隅一婦色甚麗，問曰：「此為誰？」意欲與俱歸。左右曰：「此太師家人也。」至是荒淫日甚，體羸溺血而薨。燕鐵木兒既死，妥懽貼睦爾始即位，是為順帝。乃以撒敦為左丞相，唐其勢為御史大夫。元統二年四月，命唐其勢總管高麗女直漢軍萬戶府達魯花赤。授撒敦開府儀同三司、上柱國、錄軍國重事、答剌罕、榮王、太傅、中書左丞相，賜廬州路為食邑，宥世世子孫九死。贈燕鐵木兒太師公忠開濟弘謨同德協運佐命功臣、開府儀同三司、太師、中書右丞相、上柱國，追封德王，諡忠武。至元元年三月，立燕鐵木兒女伯牙吾氏為皇后。

sourceRange.text: 脫脫字大用，生而岐嶷，異於常兒。及就學，請於其師浦江吳直方曰：「使脫脫終日危坐讀書，不若日記古人嘉言善行服之終身耳。」稍長，膂力過人，能挽弓一石。年十五，為皇太子怯憐口怯薛官。天曆元年，襲授成製提舉司達魯花赤。二年，入覲，文宗見之，悅曰：「此子後必可大用。」遷內宰司丞，兼前職。五月，命為府正司丞。至順二年，授虎符、忠翊侍衞親軍都指揮使。元統二年，同知宣政院事，兼前職。五月，遷中政使。六月，遷同知樞密院事。至元元年，唐其勢陰謀不軌，事覺伏誅，其黨答里及剌剌等稱兵外應。脫脫選精銳與之戰，盡禽以獻。歷太禧宗禋院使，拜御史中丞、虎符親軍都指揮使，提調左阿速衞。四年，進御史大夫，仍提調前職，大振綱紀，中外肅然。扈從上都還，至鷄鳴山之渾河，帝將畋于保安州，馬蹶。脫脫諫曰：「古者帝王端居九重之上，日與大臣宿儒講求治道，至於飛鷹走狗，非其事也。」帝納其言，授金紫光祿大夫，兼紹熙宣撫使。

sourceRange.text: 紐的該有識量，處事平允。倭人攻金復州，殺紅軍據其州者，即奏遣人往賞賚而撫安之。浙西張士誠既降，紐的該處置江南諸事，咸得其宜，士誠大服。興和路富民調戲子婦，繫獄，車載楮幣至京師行賂，以故刑部官持其事久不決。紐的該乃除刑部侍郎為興和路達魯花赤，俾決其事，富民遂自縊死。

sourceRange.text: 召入覲，賞賚優渥，進階金紫光祿大夫、知樞密院事。既而賊雷帖木兒不花、程思忠等陷永平，詔也速出師，遂復灤州及遷安縣。時遼東郡縣惟永平不被兵，儲粟十萬，芻藳山積，居民殷富。賊乘間竊入，增土築城，因河為塹，堅守不可下。也速乃外築大營，絕其樵采，數與賊戰，獲其偽帥二百餘人，平山寨數十。

sourceRange.text: 嘗預修英宗實錄，又譯潤皇圖大訓、承華事略，又編集列后金鑑、千秋記略以進，受賜優渥。文宗嘗駐驆龍虎臺，祖常應制賦詩，尤被歎賞，謂中原碩儒唯祖常云。（巙巙）〔巎巎〕字子山，康里氏。

localRange.text: 尝预修《英宗实录》，又译润《皇图大训》、《承华事略》，又编集《列后金鉴》、《千秋记略》以进，受赐优渥。文宗尝驻跸龙虎台，祖常应制赋诗，尤被叹赏，谓中原硕儒唯祖常云。巙巙字子山，康里氏。

sourceRange.text: 闕度軍有餘力，乃浚隍增陴，隍外環以大防，深塹三重，南引江水注之，環植木為柵，城上四面起飛樓，表裏完固。俄陞都元帥。廣西猫軍五萬從元帥阿思蘭沿江下抵廬州，闕移文謂苗蠻不當使之窺中國，詔阿思蘭還軍。猫軍有暴於境者，即收殺之，凜凜莫敢犯。時羣盜環布四外，闕居其中，左提右挈，屹為江淮一保障。

localRange.text: 阙度军有餘力，乃浚隍增陴，隍外环以大防，深堑三重，南引江水注之，环植木为栅，城上四面起飞楼，表里完固。俄升都元帅。广西猫军五万从元帅阿思兰沿江下抵庐州，阙移文谓苗蛮不当使之窥中国，诏阿思兰还军。猫军有暴于境者，即收杀之，凛凛莫敢犯。时群盗环布四外，阙居其中，左提右挈，屹为淮一保障。

sourceRange.text: 」近臣知帝意在（巙巙）〔巎巎〕，不復薦人。至京七日，感熱疾卒，實至正五年五月辛卯也，年五十一。家貧，幾無以為斂。帝聞，為震悼，賜賻銀五錠。其所負官中營運錢，臺臣奏以罰布為之代償。（巙巙）〔巎巎〕善真行草書，識者謂得晉人筆意，單牘片紙人爭寶之，不翅金玉。

sourceRange.text: 卜顏鐵木兒字珍卿，唐兀吾密氏。性明銳倜儻，早備宿衞，歷事武宗、仁宗、英宗。天曆初，由太常署丞拜監察御史，陞殿中侍御史，累除大都路達魯花赤、都轉運鹽使、肅政廉訪使，由行中書省參知政事陞左右丞，擢行御史臺中丞，遂拜江浙行省平章政事。至正十二年春，蘄、黃賊徐壽輝遣兵陷湖廣，侵江東、西，詔卜顏鐵木兒率軍討之。卜顏鐵木兒益募壯健為兵，得驍勇士三千人、戰艦三百艘。時湖廣平章政事也先帖木兒、江西平章政事星吉、江南行臺御史中丞蠻子海牙皆以兵駐太平，宿留不進。

sourceRange.text: 至治元年，除濟寧路總管，興學勸農，百廢具修，府無停事。濟陽縣有牧童持鐵連結擊野雀，誤殺同牧者，繫獄數歲。答里麻曰：「小兒誤殺同牧者，實無殺人意，難以定罪。」罰銅遣之。泰定元年，陞福建廉訪使。朝廷遣宦官伯顏催督綉段，橫取民財，宣政院判官朮鄰亦取賂于富僧，答里麻皆劾之。遷浙西廉訪使。會文宗發江陵，阿兒哈禿來諭旨，求賂不獲，還譖于朝，召至京，處以重罪。

localRange.text: 至治元年，除济宁路总管，兴学劝农，百废具修，府无停事。济阳县有牧童持铁连结击野雀，误杀同牧者，系狱数岁。答里麻曰：「小兒误杀同牧者，实无杀人意，难以定罪。罚铜遣之。泰定元年，升福建廉访使。朝廷遣宦官伯颜催督绣段，横取民财，宣政院判官术邻亦取赂于富僧，答里麻皆劾之。迁浙西廉访使。会文宗发江陵，阿兒哈秃来谕旨，求赂不获，还谮于朝，召至京，处以重罪。

sourceRange.text: 己丑秋，太宗將即位，宗親咸會，議猶未決。時睿宗為太宗親弟，故楚材言於睿宗曰：「此宗社大計，宜早定。」睿宗曰：「事猶未集，別擇日可乎？」楚材曰：「過是無吉日矣。」遂定策，立儀制，乃告親王察合台曰：「王雖兄，位則臣也，禮當拜。王拜，則莫敢不拜。」王深然之。及即位，王率皇族及臣僚拜帳下，既退，王撫楚材曰：「真社稷臣也。」國朝尊屬有拜禮自此始。時朝集後期應死者眾，楚材奏曰：「陛下新即位，宜宥之。」太宗從之。

manualTranslations.zh: 己丑秋，太宗將即位，宗親咸會，議猶未決。
manualTranslations.literal: In autumn of the jichou year, as Taizong was about to ascend the throne, the imperial kinsmen all assembled, but deliberation was still unresolved.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That autumn in the jichou year, as Taizong was about to take the throne, the imperial kinsmen all gathered, yet no decision had been reached.

manualTranslations.zh: 時睿宗為太宗親弟，故楚材言於睿宗曰：「此宗社大計，宜早定。」
manualTranslations.literal: At the time Prince Ruizong was Taizong's younger brother, so Chucai spoke to Ruizong, saying, "This is a great matter of altars and state; it should be settled early."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Prince Ruizong was then Taizong's younger brother, so Chucai told him, "This is a matter of altars and state and should be settled at once."

manualTranslations.zh: 睿宗曰：「事猶未集，別擇日可乎？」
manualTranslations.literal: Ruizong said, "The matter is not yet ready—might we choose another day?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Ruizong said, "The arrangements are not complete—could we choose another day?"

manualTranslations.zh: 楚材曰：「過是無吉日矣。」
manualTranslations.literal: Chucai said, "After this there will be no auspicious day."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chucai said, "After that there will be no auspicious day left."

manualTranslations.zh: 遂定策，立儀制，乃告親王察合台曰：「王雖兄，位則臣也，禮當拜。
manualTranslations.literal: Thereupon the plan was fixed and ceremonial regulations established; he then told Prince Chagatai, "Though you are the elder brother, in rank you are a subject; by ritual you should bow.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The decision was fixed and court ceremony established; he then told Prince Chagatai, "Though you are the elder brother, in rank you are a subject and should bow by ritual.

manualTranslations.zh: 王拜，則莫敢不拜。」
manualTranslations.literal: When you bow, none will dare not bow."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: If you bow, none will dare refuse."

manualTranslations.zh: 王深然之。
manualTranslations.literal: The prince deeply approved.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The prince strongly agreed.

manualTranslations.zh: 及即位，王率皇族及臣僚拜帳下，既退，王撫楚材曰：「真社稷臣也。」
manualTranslations.literal: When the enthronement took place, the prince led the imperial clan and officials in bowing before the tent; after they withdrew, the prince patted Chucai and said, "A true minister of altars and state."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the enthronement the prince led the imperial clan and officials in bowing before the tent; afterward he patted Chucai and said, "A true minister of the realm."

manualTranslations.zh: 國朝尊屬有拜禮自此始。
manualTranslations.literal: From this the dynasty's custom of bowing by honored kinsmen began.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From this the dynasty's custom of bowing by senior imperial kinsmen began.

manualTranslations.zh: 時朝集後期應死者眾，楚材奏曰：「陛下新即位，宜宥之。」
manualTranslations.literal: At the time many who were late for court assembly should have been put to death; Chucai memorialized, "Your Majesty has newly ascended; they should be pardoned."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Many who were late for court assembly were due for execution; Chucai memorialized, "Your Majesty has just ascended—they should be pardoned."

manualTranslations.zh: 太宗從之。
manualTranslations.literal: Taizong followed his counsel.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Taizong agreed.

sourceRange.text: 」楚材請製旗數百，以給降民，使歸田里，全活甚眾。

localRange.text: 楚材請制旗數百，以給降民，使歸田裡，全活甚眾。

sourceRange.text: 十年，詔其子江淮安撫使南合嗣行軍前中書省事。時大將察罕圍壽春，七日始下，欲屠其城，南合曰：「不降者獨守將耳，其民何罪？」由是獲免。初，世祖伐宋軍于汴，南合進曰：「李璮承國厚恩，坐制一方，然其人多詐，叛無日矣。」帝亦患之。中統元年，兩遷宣撫使。明年，授中書右丞、中興等路行中書省事。三年，遷秦蜀五路四川行中書省事。其年，李璮反益都，帝使諭南合曰：「卿言猶在耳，璮果反矣。卿宜謹守西鄙。」對曰：「臣謹受詔，不敢以西鄙為陛下憂。」明年，授中書平章政事。四年，病卒。封魏國公，諡宣昭。子博溫察兒，知河中府。

manualTranslations.zh: 十年，詔其子江淮安撫使南合嗣行軍前中書省事。
manualTranslations.literal: In the tenth year an edict ordered his son Nanhe, Jiang-Huai pacification commissioner, to succeed to Secretariat affairs before the army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the tenth year an edict ordered his son Nanhe, Jiang-Huai pacification commissioner, to succeed to Secretariat affairs with the army.

manualTranslations.zh: 時大將察罕圍壽春，七日始下，欲屠其城，南合曰：「不降者獨守將耳，其民何罪？」
manualTranslations.literal: At the time the great general Chaghan besieged Shouchun and took it only after seven days; he wished to slaughter the city. Nanhe said, "Only the defending commander refused to surrender—what crime have the people committed?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the great general Chaghan besieged Shouchun and took it only after seven days, he wished to massacre the city. Nanhe said, "Only the commander refused to surrender—what crime have the people committed?"

manualTranslations.zh: 由是獲免。
manualTranslations.literal: The city was thereby spared.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The people were thereby spared.

manualTranslations.zh: 初，世祖伐宋軍于汴，南合進曰：「李璮承國厚恩，坐制一方，然其人多詐，叛無日矣。」
manualTranslations.literal: Earlier, when Shizu campaigned against Song at Bian, Nanhe advanced and said, "Li Tan has received deep favor from the state and controls a region on his own, yet his people are full of deceit—rebellion is only a matter of time."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Kublai campaigned against Song at Bian, Nanhe said, "Li Tan has received great favor from the state and holds a region on his own, yet his followers are treacherous—rebellion is only a matter of time."

manualTranslations.zh: 帝亦患之。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor was troubled as well.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor was troubled too.

manualTranslations.zh: 中統元年，兩遷宣撫使。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Zhongtong he was twice transferred as pacification commissioner.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Zhongtong he was twice promoted as pacification commissioner.

manualTranslations.zh: 明年，授中書右丞、中興等路行中書省事。
manualTranslations.literal: The next year he was appointed right vice director of the Secretariat and put in charge of Secretariat affairs for the Zhongxing circuit and other routes.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The next year he was appointed right vice director of the Secretariat and put in charge of Secretariat affairs for Zhongxing and other circuits.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年，遷秦蜀五路四川行中書省事。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year he was transferred to oversee Secretariat affairs for the five Qin-Shu circuits of Sichuan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year he was transferred to oversee Secretariat affairs for the five Qin-Shu circuits of Sichuan.

manualTranslations.zh: 其年，李璮反益都，帝使諭南合曰：「卿言猶在耳，璮果反矣。
manualTranslations.literal: That year Li Tan rebelled at Yidu; the emperor sent word to Nanhe, saying, "Your words are still in my ears—Tan has indeed rebelled.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That year Li Tan rebelled at Yidu; the emperor sent word to Nanhe, "Your warning is still in my ears—Tan has rebelled as you said.

manualTranslations.zh: 卿宜謹守西鄙。」
manualTranslations.literal: You should diligently guard the western frontier."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Guard the western frontier carefully."

manualTranslations.zh: 對曰：「臣謹受詔，不敢以西鄙為陛下憂。」
manualTranslations.literal: He replied, "Your subject respectfully accepts the edict and dares not trouble Your Majesty over the western marches."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He replied, "I accept the edict and will not trouble Your Majesty over the western marches."

manualTranslations.zh: 明年，授中書平章政事。
manualTranslations.literal: The next year he was appointed grand councillor of the Secretariat.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The next year he was appointed grand councillor of the Secretariat.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年，病卒。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year he died of illness.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he died of illness.

manualTranslations.zh: 封魏國公，諡宣昭。
manualTranslations.literal: He was enfeoffed as Duke of Wei with the posthumous name Xuanzhao.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was enfeoffed as Duke of Wei with the posthumous name Xuanzhao.

manualTranslations.zh: 子博溫察兒，知河中府。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Bowencha'er served as prefect of Hezhong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Bowencha'er served as prefect of Hezhong.

sourceRange.text: 癸未春，還軍河中，木華黎上其功，賜金虎符，授蒙古漢軍兵馬都元帥，總十二萬戶，鎮河中。冬，徇西夏，破賀蘭山。還，遇賊，射傷額，出血，目為之昏。甲申，歸北京，授右副北京等七路兵馬都元帥。庚寅，朝太宗於盧朐河，乞致仕，不允。辛卯，太宗用兵河南，強之從行，轉漕河上，給餉諸軍。壬辰，命天祥領汴京百工數千，屯霸州之益津，行元帥府事，賜錦衣一襲。初，天祥夜中流矢，鏃入頰骨，不能出，至是，金瘡再發，鏃自口出。睿宗聞而閔之，授海濱和眾利州等處總管，兼領霸州御衣局人匠都達魯花赤，行北京七路兵馬都元帥府事。憲宗即位，俾仍舊職。戊午秋九月，以疾卒，年六十八。

context.beforeSource: 壬午，木華黎攻青龍、金勝諸堡，花帽軍堅守不下，既破，欲屠之，天祥力諫而止，獲壯士五千人。
context.afterSource: 天祥幼有大志，長身駢脅，力絕人，性不嗜酒，喜稼穡，好施予。

manualTranslations.zh: 癸未春，還軍河中，木華黎上其功，賜金虎符，授蒙古漢軍兵馬都元帥，總十二萬戶，鎮河中。
manualTranslations.literal: In the spring of the year guiwei he returned his army to Hezhong; Muqali reported his merit; he was granted a golden tiger tally, made Marshal of Mongol and Han Armies, commanded twelve ten-thousand-households, and garrisoned Hezhong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the spring of guiwei year he withdrew his army to Hezhong. Muqali reported his achievements, and he received a golden tiger tally and was appointed Marshal of Mongol and Han Armies, commanding twelve ten-thousand-households and garrisoning Hezhong.

manualTranslations.zh: 冬，徇西夏，破賀蘭山。
manualTranslations.literal: In winter he campaigned against Western Xia and broke Helan Mountain.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That winter he campaigned against Western Xia and captured Helan Mountain.

manualTranslations.zh: 還，遇賊，射傷額，出血，目為之昏。
manualTranslations.literal: On the return he encountered bandits; an arrow wounded his forehead, blood flowed, and his eyes were dimmed thereby.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the return march he encountered bandits. An arrow struck his forehead, blood flowed, and his vision was clouded.

manualTranslations.zh: 甲申，歸北京，授右副北京等七路兵馬都元帥。
manualTranslations.literal: On the day jiashen he returned to Beijing and was made Right Vice Marshal of the Seven Circuits of Beijing and others.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On jiashen day he returned to Beijing and was appointed Right Vice Marshal of the Seven Circuits of Beijing and other regions.

manualTranslations.zh: 庚寅，朝太宗於盧朐河，乞致仕，不允。
manualTranslations.literal: On the day gengyin he had audience with Taizong at the Luju River, begged to retire, and was not permitted.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On gengyin day he had audience with Ögedei Khan at the Luju River and asked to retire, but his request was denied.

manualTranslations.zh: 辛卯，太宗用兵河南，強之從行，轉漕河上，給餉諸軍。
manualTranslations.literal: On the day xinmao Taizong used troops in Henan, compelled him to follow the campaign, transported grain along the river, and supplied provisions to the armies.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Ögedei Khan campaigned in Henan and compelled him to accompany the expedition. He transported grain along the river and supplied provisions to the armies.

manualTranslations.zh: 壬辰，命天祥領汴京百工數千，屯霸州之益津，行元帥府事，賜錦衣一襲。
manualTranslations.literal: On the day renchen Tianxiang was ordered to lead several thousand artisans of Bianjing, encamped at Yijin in Bazhou, acted as marshal headquarters, and was granted one suit of brocade robes.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On renchen day Tianxiang was ordered to lead several thousand artisans from Bianjing, encamped at Yijin in Bazhou, and acted as marshal headquarters. He was granted a suit of brocade robes.

manualTranslations.zh: 初，天祥夜中流矢，鏃入頰骨，不能出，至是，金瘡再發，鏃自口出。
manualTranslations.literal: Earlier Tianxiang had been struck by an arrow at night; the arrowhead entered his cheekbone and could not be removed; now the wound broke open again and the arrowhead came out through his mouth.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Earlier Tianxiang had been struck by an arrow at night; the arrowhead lodged in his cheekbone and could not be removed. Now the wound reopened, and the arrowhead came out through his mouth.

manualTranslations.zh: 睿宗聞而閔之，授海濱和眾利州等處總管，兼領霸州御衣局人匠都達魯花赤，行北京七路兵馬都元帥府事。
manualTranslations.literal: Prince Ruizong heard and pitied him, appointing him Chief Administrator of Haibin, Hezhong, Lizhou and other places, concurrently commanding the darughachi of the Imperial Wardrobe Bureau artisans at Bazhou, and acting as marshal headquarters of the Seven Circuits of Beijing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tolui heard and took pity on him. He was appointed Chief Administrator of Haibin, Hezhong, Lizhou, and other districts, concurrently made darughachi of the Imperial Wardrobe Bureau artisans at Bazhou, and placed in charge of the marshal headquarters of the Seven Circuits of Beijing.

manualTranslations.zh: 憲宗即位，俾仍舊職。
manualTranslations.literal: When Xianzong took the throne, he was ordered to retain his former post.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Möngke Khan took the throne, he was ordered to retain his former post.

manualTranslations.zh: 戊午秋九月，以疾卒，年六十八。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth month of autumn of the year wuwu he died of illness at age sixty-eight.

sourceRange.text: 中統元年，世祖即位，詔班師。阿里不哥反，世祖北征，詔柔入衞，至廬朐河，有詔止之。分其兵三千五百衞京師，以子弘慶為質。二年，以金實錄獻諸朝，且請致仕，封安肅公，命第八子弘略襲職。至元三年，加榮祿大夫，判行工部事，城大都。四年，進封蔡國公。五年六月卒，年七十九。贈推忠宣力翊運功臣、太師、開府儀同三司、上柱國，諡武康。延祐五年，加封汝南王，諡忠武。子十有一人，弘略、弘範最顯，弘範自有傳。

sourceRange.text: 世祖即位，建元中統。文用持詔宣諭邊郡，且擇諸軍充侍衞，七月，還朝。中書左丞張文謙宣撫大名等路，奏文用為左右司郎中。二年八月，以兵部郎中參議都元帥府事。三年，李璮叛，據濟南，從元帥闊闊帶統兵誅之，山東平。阿朮奉詔伐宋，召文用為其屬，文用辭曰：「新制，諸侯總兵者，其子弟勿復任兵事。今吾兄文炳以經略使總重兵鎮山東，我不當行。」阿朮曰：「潛邸舊臣，不得引此為說。」文用謝病不行。

manualTranslations.literal: When Shizu took the throne, he established the Bureau of Seals and Talismans, appointed Wenzhong as an officer, granted him Grand Master for Fostering Instruction, placed him ever closer in intimate service, and would call him Dong Ba rather than by his formal name.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Kublai took the throne, he established the Bureau of Seals and Talismans, appointed Wenzhong as an officer, granted him Grand Master for Fostering Instruction, placed him ever closer in intimate service, and would call him Dong Ba rather than by his formal name.

manualTranslations.zh: 文忠不為容悅，隨事獻納，中禁事祕，外多不聞。
manualTranslations.literal: Wenzhong did not curry favor; on each matter he offered remonstrance and proposals. Inner-palace affairs were kept secret, and outside people mostly did not hear of them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wenzhong did not curry favor; on each matter he offered remonstrance and proposals. Inner-palace affairs were kept secret, and few outside the palace heard of them.

manualTranslations.zh: 至元二年，安童以右丞相入領中書，建陳十事，言忤旨，文忠曰：「丞相素有賢名，今秉政之始，人方傾聽，所請不得，後何以為？」
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Zhiyuan, Antong as Right Chancellor entered to head the Secretariat and memorialized ten proposals; his words offended the throne. Wenzhong said: "The Chancellor has long had a reputation for worth; now at the start of holding power people are all listening—if what you request is not granted, what will you do afterward?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhiyuan (1265), Antong as Right Chancellor entered to head the Secretariat and memorialized ten proposals; his words offended the throne. Wenzhong said, "The Chancellor has long had a reputation for worth; now at the start of holding power people are all listening—if what you request is not granted, what will you do afterward?"

manualTranslations.zh: 遂從旁代對，懇悃詳切，如身條是疏者，始得允可。

He received a gold tiger tally, was made chief commander of the military households of Pingyang, Xuande, and other circuits, served concurrently in the Grand Tutor's office, and commanded the Han armies.

manualTranslations.literal: At Sanfeng Mountain he encountered the Jin grand general Heda, gave battle, routed him utterly, captured Heda, and took tens of thousands of heads; pressing the victory he captured Xiangshan Stockade and Junzhou, and was granted western brocade, fine horses, and sable-fur garments to honor his merit.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: When seven additional commands of ten thousand households were established, Heima again headed the list, followed by Zhongxi, Shi Tianze, Yan Shi, and others.

sourceRange.text: 中統元年，世祖即位，廉希憲、商挺奏以為成都經略使總管萬戶。宋瀘州守將劉整密送款求降，黑馬遣元振往受之。諸將皆曰：「劉整無故而降，不可信也。」元振曰：「宋權臣當國，賞罰無章，有功者往往以計除之，是以將士離心；且整本非南人，而居瀘南重地，事勢與李全何異，整此舉無可疑者。」遂行。黑馬戒之曰：「劉整，宋之名將，瀘乃蜀之衝要，今整遽以瀘降，情偽不可知，汝無為一身慮，事成則為國家之利，不成則當效死，乃其分也。」元振至瀘，整開門出迎，元振棄眾而先下馬，與整相見，示以不疑。明日，請入城，元振釋戎服，從數騎，與整聯轡而入，飲燕至醉，整心服焉。獻金六千兩、男女五百人，元振以金分賜將士，而歸還其男女。
