manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Möngke died, Kublai acceded.

manualTranslations.zh: 中統元年，拜燕京宣慰使。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Zhongtong he was appointed Pacification Commissioner of Yanjing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Zhongtong 1 he was made Pacification Commissioner of Yanjing.

manualTranslations.zh: 時供給蜀軍，府庫已竭，及用兵北邊，璧經畫饋運，相繼不絕。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time supplies for the Shu army had exhausted the treasury; when troops were used on the northern frontier, Bi planned transport and relayed provisions without cease.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Supplies for the Shu army had emptied the treasury; when war opened on the northern frontier, Bi organized transport and kept provisions flowing.

manualTranslations.zh: 中書省立，授平章政事，議加答剌罕之號，力辭不受。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Secretariat was established he was appointed Grand Councillor; when the title of Darqan was proposed he firmly declined to accept it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Secretariat was set up he became Grand Councillor; offered the title Darqan, he firmly declined.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年，從北征，命還燕，以平章政事兼大都督領諸軍。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year he joined the northern campaign, was ordered back to Yan, and served as Grand Councillor while also commanding all armies as Metropolitan Commander.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year he joined the northern campaign, was ordered back to Yan, and served as Grand Councillor and Metropolitan Commander of all armies.

manualTranslations.zh: 是年，始製太廟雅樂。
manualTranslations.literal: That year the court music of the Imperial Ancestral Temple was first composed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That year the Imperial Ancestral Temple court music was first composed.

manualTranslations.zh: 樂工党仲和、郭伯達以知音律在選中，為造偽鈔者連坐，繫獄。
manualTranslations.literal: The musicians Dang Zhonghe and Guo Boda, chosen for their knowledge of pitch and measure, were implicated by association with counterfeiters and imprisoned.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Musicians Dang Zhonghe and Guo Boda, chosen for their mastery of pitch, were implicated with counterfeiters and imprisoned.

manualTranslations.zh: 璧曰：「太廟雅樂，大饗用之，聖上所以昭孝報本也，豈可繫及無辜，而廢雅樂之成哉！」
manualTranslations.literal: Bi said: "The ancestral temple court music is used at the great feast—His Majesty thereby displays filial piety and returns to the root; how can the innocent be imprisoned and the completion of the court music abandoned!"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Bi said: "Ancestral temple music is used at the great feast—His Majesty thereby shows filial piety and honors the root; how can innocents be imprisoned and the music abandoned!"

manualTranslations.zh: 奏請原之。
manualTranslations.literal: He memorialized asking that they be pardoned.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He memorialized asking pardon for them.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年，李璮反益都，從親王合必赤討之。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year Li Tan rebelled at Yidu; Bi followed Prince Hügebei to suppress him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year Li Tan rebelled at Yidu; Bi followed Prince Hügebei against him.

manualTranslations.zh: 璮已據濟南，諸軍乏食，璧從濟河得粟及羊豕以饋軍，軍復大振。
manualTranslations.literal: Tan already held Jinan and the armies lacked food; Bi obtained grain, sheep, and swine along the Ji River to feed the troops, and the army revived greatly.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tan held Jinan and the armies were starving; Bi gathered grain, sheep, and swine along the Ji River to feed them, and the army rallied.

manualTranslations.zh: 至元元年，官制行，加榮祿大夫。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Zhiyuan, when the official system took effect, he was promoted Grand Master of Glorious Blessing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 1, when the new official system took effect, he was made Grand Master of Glorious Blessing.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝欲作文檄宋，執筆者數人，不稱旨，乃召璧為之。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor wished to draft a proclamation against Song; several writers failed to please him, so Bi was summoned to do it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor wanted a proclamation against Song; several writers displeased him, so Bi was summoned to draft it.

manualTranslations.zh: 文成，帝大喜曰：「惟秀才曲盡我意。」
manualTranslations.literal: When the text was finished the emperor was greatly pleased and said: "Only Xiucai has fully expressed my meaning."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When it was finished the emperor was delighted and said: "Only Xiucai has fully caught my meaning."

manualTranslations.zh: 改樞密副使。
manualTranslations.literal: He was changed to Vice Director of the Privy Council.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was made Privy Council Vice Director.

manualTranslations.zh: 六年，宋守臣有遣間使約降者，帝命璧詣鹿門山都元帥阿朮營密議。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth year a Song frontier official sent a secret envoy to negotiate surrender; the emperor ordered Bi to the camp of Marshal Aju at Lumen Mountain for confidential deliberation.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth year a Song defender sent a secret envoy to negotiate surrender; the emperor sent Bi to Marshal Aju's camp at Lumen Mountain for secret talks.

manualTranslations.zh: 命璧同行漢軍都元帥府事。
manualTranslations.literal: Bi was ordered to jointly conduct Han Army Metropolitan Marshalate affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Bi was ordered to jointly direct Han Army Metropolitan Marshalate affairs.

manualTranslations.zh: 宋將夏貴率兵五萬，饋糧三千艘，自武昌泝流，入援襄陽。
manualTranslations.literal: The Song general Xia Gui led fifty thousand troops and three thousand grain ships upstream from Wuchang to relieve Xiangyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Song general Xia Gui led fifty thousand men and three thousand grain ships upstream from Wuchang to relieve Xiangyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 時漢水暴漲，璧據險設伏待之。
manualTranslations.literal: The Han River was in sudden flood; Bi took a strong position and set an ambush to await him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Han was in sudden flood; Bi held a strong position and laid an ambush.

manualTranslations.zh: 貴果中夜潛上，璧策馬出鹿門，行二十餘里，發伏兵，奪其五舟，大呼曰：「南船已敗，我水軍宜速進。」
manualTranslations.literal: Gui indeed stole upstream at midnight; Bi spurred his horse out of Lumen, rode more than twenty li, released the ambush, seized five of his boats, and shouted: "The southern boats are defeated—our navy should advance quickly."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Gui did steal upstream at midnight; Bi rode out of Lumen more than twenty li, sprang the ambush, seized five boats, and shouted: "The southern fleet is beaten—our navy should advance at once."

manualTranslations.zh: 貴懾不敢動。
manualTranslations.literal: Gui was afraid and dared not move.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Gui was terrified and dared not stir.

manualTranslations.zh: 明旦，阿朮至，領諸將渡江西追貴騎兵，璧率水軍萬戶解汝楫等追貴舟師。
manualTranslations.literal: At dawn Aju arrived, led the generals across the river westward in pursuit of Gui's cavalry, and Bi led Naval Ten-Thousand-Household Xie Ruji and others in pursuit of Gui's fleet.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At dawn Aju came, led the generals west across the river after Gui's cavalry, while Bi led Naval Ten-Thousand-Household Xie Ruji and others after Gui's fleet.

manualTranslations.zh: 遂合戰於虎尾洲，貴大敗走，士卒溺死甚眾，奪戰艦五十，擒將士三百餘人。
manualTranslations.literal: They joined battle at Tiger Tail Shoal; Gui was greatly defeated and fled, very many soldiers drowned, fifty warships were captured, and more than three hundred officers and men were seized.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: They fought at Tiger Tail Shoal; Gui was routed and fled, many soldiers drowned, fifty warships were taken, and more than three hundred officers and men were captured.

sourceRange.text: （庚）〔壬〕子，世祖居潛邸，以肅為邢州安撫使。肅興鐵冶，及行楮幣，公私賴焉。中統元年，擢真定宣撫使。時中統新鈔行，罷（鈔銀）〔銀鈔〕不用。真定以銀鈔交通于外者，凡八千餘貫，公私囂然，莫知所措。肅建三策：一曰仍用舊鈔，二曰新舊兼用，三曰官以新鈔如數易舊鈔。中書從其第三策，遂降鈔五十萬貫。二年，授左三部尚書，官曹典憲，多所議定。未幾，兼商議中書省事。三年，致仕，給半俸。四年，卒，年七十六。

sourceRange.text: 庚申，世祖即位，建元中統。首授翰林學士承旨，制誥典章，皆所裁定。至元元年，加資善大夫。上奏：「自古帝王得失興廢可考者，以有史在也。我國家以神武定四方，天戈所臨，無不臣服者，皆出太祖皇帝廟謨雄斷所致，若不乘時紀錄，竊恐久而遺亡，宜置局纂就實錄，附修遼、金二史。」又言：「唐太宗始定天下，置弘文舘學士十八人，宋太宗承太祖開創之後，設內外學士院，史冊爛然，號稱文治。堂堂國朝，豈無英才如唐、宋者乎！」皆從之，始立翰林學士院，鶚遂薦李冶、李昶、王磐、徐世隆、高鳴為學士。復奏立十道提舉學校官。

manualTranslations.literal: In the autumn of the second year he mobilized troops out of Tongchuan, fought the Song general Xian Gong, and captured Commander Bai Jiyuan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the second year (1261) he led troops out of Tongchuan, fought the Song general Xian Gong, and captured Commander Bai Jiyuan.

manualTranslations.zh: 秦蜀行省以大淵及青居山征南都元帥欽察麾下將校六十三人有功，言于朝。
manualTranslations.literal: The Qin-Shu Branch Secretariat reported to court that Dayuan and sixty-three officers and soldiers under the Southern Campaign Marshal Qincha at Qingju Mountain had merit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Qin-Shu Branch Secretariat memorialized that Dayuan and sixty-three officers and soldiers under the Southern Campaign Marshal Qincha at Qingju Mountain had earned merit.

manualTranslations.zh: 詔給虎符一、金符五、銀符五十七，令論功定官，以名聞。
manualTranslations.literal: An edict granted one tiger tally, five gold tallies, and fifty-seven silver tallies, ordering that merit be assessed to fix offices and that names be reported.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: An edict granted one tiger tally, five gold tallies, and fifty-seven silver tallies, ordering that merit be assessed to fix offices and that names be reported to court.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年春，世祖命出開、達，與宋兵戰于平田，復戰于巴渠，擒其知軍范燮、統制魏興、路分黃迪、節幹陳子潤等。
manualTranslations.literal: In the spring of the third year the Founder ordered him out against Kai and Da; he fought Song troops at Pingtian and again at Baqu, capturing their Military Prefect Fan Xie, Commander Wei Xing, Route Commander Huang Di, Staff Officer Chen Zirun, and others.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the spring of the third year (1262) the Founder ordered him against Kai and Da. He fought Song forces at Pingtian and again at Baqu, capturing Military Prefect Fan Xie, Commander Wei Xing, Route Commander Huang Di, Staff Officer Chen Zirun, and others.

sourceRange.text: 大淵總兵守閬州。

context.afterSource: 歲戊午，憲宗兵至閬州之大獲城，遣宋降臣王仲入招大淵，大淵殺之。

sourceRange.text: 中統元年，授文安監軍。攻禮義城，殺傷甚眾，奪其糧船，繞出通川，獲宋將黃文才、高坦之。二年，復出通川，與宋將鮮恭大戰，擒統制白繼源。三年，出開、達，戰屢勝，擒知軍范燮、統制魏興、黃迪、陳子閏等。授文安開達忠萬梁山等處招討使。軍於巴渠，萬安寨主盧植降。遂築蟠龍城，以據夔、達要路。宋兵來爭，相持半月，文仲以兵來援，宋兵宵遁，文安追擊，大敗之。四年，佩銀符，陞千戶，監軍如故，進築虎嘯城，以困大良。至元元年，宋都統張喜引兵攻蟠龍，大戰，敗之，喜潛師宵遁，出得漢城，文安遣兵追襲，又敗之，擒裨將陳亮。復築方斗城，為蟠龍聲援，令裨將高先守之。宋兵攻潼川，行省命文安赴援，敗宋師于射洪之納垻，斬獲甚眾。宋都統祁昌以重兵運糧餉得漢，且遷其官屬於內地，大淵命文安先邀之，昌立柵椒原以守，合兵攻之，連戰三日，獲祁昌，俘得漢守臣向良家屬，以招良，良以城降，以所俘獻闕下。二年，改授金符，仍前職，還攻宋開、達等州，擒其統制張剛、總管伏林。八月，宋兵由開州運糧餉達，文安率奇兵，間道邀擊之，獲總管方富等。

localRange.text: 二年，改授金符，仍前職，還攻宋開、達等州，擒其統制張剛、緫管伏林。八月，宋兵由開州運糧餉達，文安率奇兵，間道邀擊之，獲緫管方富等。

manualTranslations.zh: 中統元年，授文安監軍。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Zhongtong, Wen'an was appointed military supervisor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Zhongtong (1260), Wen'an was appointed military supervisor.

manualTranslations.zh: 攻禮義城，殺傷甚眾，奪其糧船，繞出通川，獲宋將黃文才、高坦之。
manualTranslations.literal: He attacked Liyi City, killing and wounding very many, seized its grain boats, circled out through Tongchuan, and captured the Song generals Huang Wencai and Gao Tanzhi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He attacked Liyi City, inflicting heavy casualties, seized its grain boats, circled out through Tongchuan, and captured the Song generals Huang Wencai and Gao Tanzhi.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年，復出通川，與宋將鮮恭大戰，擒統制白繼源。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year he again came out through Tongchuan, fought a great battle with the Song general Xian Gong, and captured Commander Bai Jiyuan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year he again advanced through Tongchuan, fought a major battle with the Song general Xian Gong, and captured Commander Bai Jiyuan.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年，出開、達，戰屢勝，擒知軍范燮、統制魏興、黃迪、陳子閏等。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year he advanced against Kai and Da, won repeated victories, and captured Military Prefect Fan Xie, Commander Wei Xing, Huang Di, Chen Zirun, and others.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year he advanced against Kai and Da, won repeated victories, and captured Military Prefect Fan Xie, Commander Wei Xing, Huang Di, Chen Zirun, and others.

manualTranslations.zh: 授文安開達忠萬梁山等處招討使。
manualTranslations.literal: Wen'an was appointed Pacification Commissioner of Kai, Da, Zhong, Wan, Liang Mountain, and other districts.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wen'an was appointed Pacification Commissioner of Kai, Da, Zhong, Wan, Liang Mountain, and other districts.

manualTranslations.zh: 軍於巴渠，萬安寨主盧植降。
manualTranslations.literal: He encamped at Baqu; Lu Zhi, chief of Wan'an Stockade, surrendered.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He encamped at Baqu, and Lu Zhi, chief of Wan'an Stockade, submitted.

manualTranslations.zh: 遂築蟠龍城，以據夔、達要路。
manualTranslations.literal: He then built Panlong City to hold the vital routes of Kui and Da.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He then built Panlong City to control the vital routes of Kui and Da.

manualTranslations.zh: 宋兵來爭，相持半月，文仲以兵來援，宋兵宵遁，文安追擊，大敗之。
manualTranslations.literal: Song troops came to contest it; after a standoff of half a month Wenzhong came with troops to reinforce; the Song army fled by night; Wen'an pursued and inflicted a great defeat.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Song troops came to dispute the position. After a standoff of half a month Wenzhong arrived with reinforcements; the Song army fled by night, and Wen'an pursued and routed them.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年，佩銀符，陞千戶，監軍如故，進築虎嘯城，以困大良。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year he wore a silver tally, was promoted to chiliarch, retained his post as military supervisor, and advanced to build Huxiao City to press Daliang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he received a silver tally, was promoted to chiliarch while retaining his post as military supervisor, and built Huxiao City to besiege Daliang.

manualTranslations.zh: 至元元年，宋都統張喜引兵攻蟠龍，大戰，敗之，喜潛師宵遁，出得漢城，文安遣兵追襲，又敗之，擒裨將陳亮。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Zhiyuan the Song commander-in-chief Zhang Xi led troops to attack Panlong; after a great battle Wen'an defeated him; Xi slipped away by night with his army; he came out toward Dehan City; Wen'an sent troops in pursuit and again defeated him, capturing Vice-General Chen Liang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Zhiyuan (1264) the Song commander-in-chief Zhang Xi attacked Panlong. Wen'an defeated him in a major battle; Xi slipped away by night toward Dehan City; Wen'an sent troops in pursuit, defeated him again, and captured Vice-General Chen Liang.

manualTranslations.zh: 復築方斗城，為蟠龍聲援，令裨將高先守之。
manualTranslations.literal: He again built Fangdou City as a supporting position for Panlong and ordered Vice-General Gao Xian to defend it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He also built Fangdou City to support Panlong and ordered Vice-General Gao Xian to hold it.

manualTranslations.zh: 宋兵攻潼川，行省命文安赴援，敗宋師于射洪之納垻，斬獲甚眾。
manualTranslations.literal: Song troops attacked Tongchuan; the Branch Secretariat ordered Wen'an to go to reinforce and defeated the Song army at Naba in Shehong, killing and capturing very many.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Song forces attacked Tongchuan, the Branch Secretariat ordered Wen'an to reinforce. He defeated the Song army at Naba in Shehong and killed or captured a great number.

manualTranslations.zh: 宋都統祁昌以重兵運糧餉得漢，且遷其官屬於內地，大淵命文安先邀之，昌立柵椒原以守，合兵攻之，連戰三日，獲祁昌，俘得漢守臣向良家屬，以招良，良以城降，以所俘獻闕下。
manualTranslations.literal: The Song commander-in-chief Qi Chang transported grain in force to supply Dehan and also moved his officials' households to the interior; Dayuan ordered Wen'an to intercept him first; Chang built a stockade at Jiaoyuan to defend; they joined forces to attack; after three days of fighting Qi Chang was captured; the family of Dehan's defending official Xiang Liang was taken prisoner to summon Liang; Liang surrendered the city; the captives were presented at court.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Song commander-in-chief Qi Chang shipped grain in force to Dehan and also moved his officials' families inland. Dayuan ordered Wen'an to intercept him first. Chang built a stockade at Jiaoyuan to defend, but their combined forces attacked for three days and captured Qi Chang. They took the family of Dehan's defender Xiang Liang to summon him; Liang surrendered the city, and the captives were presented at court.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年，改授金符，仍前職，還攻宋開、達等州，擒其統制張剛、緫管伏林。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year he was reassigned the gold tally-token while retaining his former post; returning, he attacked Song Kai, Da, and other prefectures and captured their commanders Zhang Gang and Supervisor Fulin.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year he received a gold tally-token while keeping his former duties. On campaign he took the Song prefectures of Kai and Da and captured the commanders Zhang Gang and Supervisor Fulin.

manualTranslations.zh: 八月，宋兵由開州運糧餉達，文安率奇兵，間道邀擊之，獲緫管方富等。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighth month, Song troops transported grain from Kai Prefecture to supply Da; Wen'an led picked troops by a hidden route to intercept them and captured Supervisor Fang Fu and others.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Song forces shipped grain from Kaizhou to Da. Wen'an led picked troops along a bypath, ambushed the convoy, and took Supervisor Fang Fu and others.

Yue'erlu memorialized: "Bi and the others, with five thousand men, crossed two hundred fifty thousand li of sea and entered countries unprecedented in recent times; they captured the king and induced nearby small states to submit—they deserve added compassion and favor."

Yue'erlu memorialized, "Bi and his men, five thousand strong, crossed two hundred fifty thousand li of sea into lands no expedition had reached in living memory; they took the king captive and brought neighboring petty states to submit—they deserve added compassion and favor."

manualTranslations.zh: 遂詔以所籍還之，拜榮祿大夫、江西等處行中書省右丞。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: An edict then restored what had been seized from him, and he was appointed Grand Master for Glorious Happiness and Right Councillor of the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年，陞平章政事，加銀青榮祿大夫，封鄂國公，卒於家，年八十六。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year he was promoted to Grand Councillor, advanced to Silver-Green Grand Master for Glorious Happiness, enfeoffed as Duke of E, and died at home at the age of eighty-six.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year he was promoted to Grand Councillor, advanced to Silver-Green Grand Master for Glorious Happiness, enfeoffed as Duke of E, and died at home at the age of eighty-six.

manualTranslations.zh: 至元元年，入覲，命與同僉總帥汪良臣還蜀，守青居。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Zhiyuan (1264) he came to audience; he was ordered, together with Associate Supreme Commander Wang Liangchen, to return to Shu and hold Qingju.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Zhiyuan (1264) he presented himself at court and was ordered, with Associate Supreme Commander Wang Liangchen, to return to Shu and hold Qingju.

manualTranslations.zh: 是時，國兵猶與宋兵相持于釣魚山。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time Yuan forces were still locked in a standoff with Song troops at Diaoyushan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At that time Yuan and Song armies were still locked in stalemate at Diaoyushan.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年，宋兵陷大梁平山寨。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year Song forces took Daliangpingshan Stockade.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year Song forces seized Daliangpingshan Stockade.

manualTranslations.zh: 平章賽典赤令忽蘭吉領兵千餘騎，掠其境，先以七百人覘之，聞寨中擁老幼西去，追擊之，斬首三百級，得馬二百八十，都元帥欽察等家屬百餘口先為宋兵所得，亦奪還之。
manualTranslations.literal: Grand Councillor Sayid Ajall ordered Hulanji to lead more than a thousand cavalry in a raid into their territory; he first sent seven hundred men to scout, learned that the stockade was moving its old and young westward, pursued them, took three hundred heads, seized two hundred eighty horses, and also recovered more than a hundred members of the families of Supreme Commander Qincha and others who had first been taken by Song troops.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Grand Councillor Sayid Ajall ordered Hulanji to lead more than a thousand cavalry in a raid; he first sent seven hundred scouts, learned the stockade was evacuating its old and young westward, gave chase, took three hundred heads and two hundred eighty horses, and also recovered more than a hundred kin of Supreme Commander Qincha and others whom Song troops had first captured.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年，以本職充閬蓬廣安順慶夔府等處蒙古漢軍都元帥參議。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year, while retaining his post, he served as councilor to the Mongol and Han Army Supreme Commander of Lang, Peng, Guang'an, Shunqing, Kuizhou, and other prefectures.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, while keeping his existing duties, he served as councilor to the Mongol and Han Army Supreme Commander of Lang, Peng, Guang'an, Shunqing, Kuizhou, and other prefectures.

manualTranslations.zh: 六年，賜虎符，授昭勇大將軍、夔東路招討使，以軍三千，立章廣平山寨，置屯田，出兵以絕大梁平山兩道。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth year he was granted a tiger tally and appointed General of Manifest Valor and Pacification Commissioner of the eastern Kuizhou Route; with three thousand troops he established Zhangguangping Stockade, set up garrison farms, and sent out forces to cut the two routes of Daliangpingshan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he received a tiger tally and was appointed General of Manifest Valor and Pacification Commissioner of the eastern Kuizhou Route; with three thousand troops he built Zhangguangping Stockade, organized garrison farms, and sent forces to sever the two routes to Daliangpingshan.

sourceRange.text: 成宗即位，復拜福建行省平章政事，賜玉帶。大德三年，汀州總管府同知阿里，挾怨告興不法，召入對，盡得其誣狀，阿里伏誅。改江浙行省平章政事，賜海東青鶻，命其子伯顏入宿衞。四年，遣使賜海東白鶻、蒲萄酒、良藥。八年，授樞密副使。十年，進同知樞密院事，皆兼平章。改河南行省平章政事。武宗即位，召見，拜左丞相，商議河南省事，賜以先朝御服。仁宗寵眷勳舊，賜與尤厚。皇慶二年秋九月，卒，年六十九。贈太師、開府儀同三司、上柱國，追封梁國公，諡武宣。元統三年，加封南陽王。

sourceRange.text: 初，其從孫也，璠無子，以初為後。初好讀書，尤長於春秋，為文簡而有法，比冠，有聲。中統元年，始立中書省，辟為掾史，兼掌書記。未幾，以祖母老辭歸，隱居教授。會詔左丞許衡、學士竇默及京師諸儒，各陳經史所載前代帝王嘉言善政，選進讀之士，有司以初應詔。帝雅重璠名，方之古直，詢知初為璠子，歎奬久之，即授國史院編修官，尋拜監察御史。首言：「法者，持天下之具，御史臺則守法之司也。方今法有未定，百司無所持循，宜參酌考定，頒行天下。」帝宴羣臣於上都行宮，有不能釂大巵者，免其冠服。

manualTranslations.zh: 初，其從孫也，璠無子，以初為後。
manualTranslations.literal: Chu was his collateral great-grandson; Fan had no son and took Chu as his heir.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chu was Fan's collateral great-grandson. Fan had no son and adopted Chu as his heir.

manualTranslations.zh: 初好讀書，尤長於春秋，為文簡而有法，比冠，有聲。
manualTranslations.literal: Chu loved reading and was especially skilled in the Spring and Autumn Annals; his writing was concise yet methodical, and by the time he capped his hair he had a reputation.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chu loved books and excelled in the Spring and Autumn Annals. His prose was concise and disciplined, and by the time he came of age he was already well known.

manualTranslations.zh: 中統元年，始立中書省，辟為掾史，兼掌書記。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Zhongtong, when the Secretariat was first established, he was recruited as a clerk and concurrently managed secretarial records.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Zhongtong 1, when the Secretariat was first set up, he was recruited as a clerk and also kept the secretarial records.

manualTranslations.zh: 未幾，以祖母老辭歸，隱居教授。
manualTranslations.literal: Before long, citing his grandmother's old age, he resigned and returned home to live in seclusion and teach.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he resigned and went home, pleading his grandmother's age, and lived in seclusion while teaching students.

manualTranslations.zh: 會詔左丞許衡、學士竇默及京師諸儒，各陳經史所載前代帝王嘉言善政，選進讀之士，有司以初應詔。
manualTranslations.literal: An edict then summoned Left Vice Director Xu Heng, Academician Dou Mo, and the scholars of the capital each to set forth the fine words and good policies of former emperors recorded in the classics and histories, and to select men to read them before the throne; the responsible offices nominated Chu in response to the edict.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: An edict called on Left Vice Director Xu Heng, Academician Dou Mo, and the capital scholars to present the worthy sayings and policies of former emperors recorded in the classics and histories, and to choose readers for the throne. The responsible offices put Chu forward in response.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝雅重璠名，方之古直，詢知初為璠子，歎奬久之，即授國史院編修官，尋拜監察御史。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor had long esteemed Fan's name and compared him to the ancient upright; learning that Chu was Fan's son, he sighed in praise for a long while, immediately appointed him compiler of the National History Academy, and soon afterward made him Supervising Censor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor had long valued Fan's reputation and likened him to the upright men of antiquity. When he learned that Chu was Fan's heir, he praised him at length, appointed him compiler in the National History Academy, and soon made him a supervising censor.

manualTranslations.zh: 首言：「法者，持天下之具，御史臺則守法之司也。方今法有未定，百司無所持循，宜參酌考定，頒行天下。」
manualTranslations.literal: At the outset he said: "Law is the instrument by which all under Heaven is sustained, and the Censorate is the office that upholds the law. At present the laws are not yet settled, and the hundred offices have nothing to follow; it is fitting to consult, examine, and fix them, and promulgate them throughout the realm."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In his first memorial he said: "Law is the instrument that sustains the realm, and the Censorate is the office that upholds it. Today the laws are still unsettled and the hundred offices have no standard to follow. They should be reviewed, settled, and promulgated throughout the empire."

sourceRange.text: 成宗立，由侍講為學士，纂修實錄，書成，參議中書省事。時南士有陳利便請搜括田賦者，執政欲從之。構與平章何榮祖共言其不可，辨之甚力，得不行。以疾歸東平。久之，起為濟南路總管。諸王從者怙勢行州縣，民莫敢忤視，構聞諸朝，徙之北境。學田為牧地所侵者，理而歸之。官貸民粟，歲饑而責償不已，構請輸以明年。武宗即位，以纂修國史，趣召赴闕，拜翰林學士承旨，未幾，以疾卒，年六十三。構歷事三朝，練習臺閣典故，凡祖宗諡冊冊文皆所撰定，朝廷每有大議，必咨訪焉。喜薦引寒士，前後省臺、翰苑所辟，無慮數十人，後居清要，皆有名于時。子士熙，仕至中書參政，卒官南臺御史中丞；士點，淮西廉訪司僉事，皆能以文學世其家。

sourceRange.text: 是年，改安撫司為宣撫司，授宣撫使，尋陞侍衞親軍都指揮使。成宗即位，賽因不花兩入見，贈諡二代。大德五年，宋隆濟及折節等叛，詔湖廣行省平章劉二拔都、指揮使也先忽都魯，率兵偕賽因不花討之。六年秋九月，師出播境，連與賊遇，破之。前駐蹉泥，賊騎猝至，賽因不花奮擊先進，大軍繼之，賊遂潰，乘勝逐北，殺獲不可勝計。遂降阿苴，下笮籠，望塵送款者相繼。七年正月，進屯暮窩，賊眾復合，又與戰于墨特川，大破之。折節懼，乞降，斬之，又擒斬隆濟等，西南夷悉平。八年，賽因不花復入見，進資德大夫。至大四年，加勳上護軍，詔許世襲。播南盧崩蠻內侵，詔賽因不花暨恩州宣慰使田茂忠，率兵討之，以疾卒於軍，年四十。贈推誠秉義功臣、銀青榮祿大夫、平章政事、柱國，追封播國公，諡忠宣。子嘉貞嗣。

sourceRange.text: 蔡珍，彰德安陽人。父興，幼隸軍籍，從宗王口溫不花出征，權管軍百戶。興告老，以珍代之。珍素驍勇。歲戊午，從憲宗攻宋合州釣魚山。中統元年，從世祖征阿里不哥。三年，從征李璮。後從鎮襄陽，徇安慶，攻五河，所至有功。南方平，遂入備宿衞。十四年，授忠顯校尉、管軍總把，尋命權千戶。是年冬，扈駕駐黑城。珍遣兵士儲芻藁，築土室，軍府賴其用。道遇凍者，必扶入密室溫煦之。軍糧必為撙節，不使頓絕以致饑困。十五年，充本衞都鎮撫。十七年，陞忠武校尉、中衞親軍總把，俄改屬後衞，賜銀符。時白海初建行營，命珍督役，卒事，民不知擾，雖草木無纖介損。帝臨幸，問其故，近臣以蔡珍號令嚴肅為對，帝嘉之，賞以鈔若干。二十一年，改授膠東海道都漕運司丁壯萬戶府都鎮撫。二十七年，進後衞親軍千戶，佩金符。元貞元年，進階武略。俄告老而歸，子恕襲。

manualTranslations.zh: 蔡珍，彰德安陽人。
manualTranslations.literal: Cai Zhen was a native of Anyang in Zhangde.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Cai Zhen was from Anyang in Zhangde.

manualTranslations.zh: 父興，幼隸軍籍，從宗王口溫不花出征，權管軍百戶。
manualTranslations.literal: His father Xing, while young, was entered on the military register; he followed Prince Kouwenbuhua on campaign and served as acting hundred-household army commander.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His father Xing entered the military rolls as a youth, followed Prince Kouwenbuhua on campaign, and served as acting hundred-household army commander.

manualTranslations.zh: 興告老，以珍代之。
manualTranslations.literal: When Xing retired, Zhen replaced him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Xing retired, Zhen took his place.

manualTranslations.zh: 珍素驍勇。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhen had always been fierce and brave.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhen was known for his courage in battle.

manualTranslations.zh: 歲戊午，從憲宗攻宋合州釣魚山。
manualTranslations.literal: In the wuwu year he followed Xianzong in attacking the Song position at Mount Diaoyu in Hezhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In wuwu he followed Xianzong in the attack on Mount Diaoyu at Hezhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 中統元年，從世祖征阿里不哥。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Zhongtong he followed Shizu in campaigning against Ariq Böke.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Zhongtong he followed Shizu against Ariq Böke.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年，從征李璮。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year he joined the campaign against Li Tan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year he took part in the campaign against Li Tan.

manualTranslations.zh: 後從鎮襄陽，徇安慶，攻五河，所至有功。
manualTranslations.literal: Later he followed in garrisoning Xiangyang, raided Anqing, and attacked Wuhe; wherever he went he had merit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He later helped garrison Xiangyang, raided Anqing, and attacked Wuhe, distinguishing himself wherever he served.

manualTranslations.zh: 南方平，遂入備宿衞。
manualTranslations.literal: When the south was pacified, he then entered service in the palace guard.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After the south was pacified he entered the palace guard.

manualTranslations.zh: 十四年，授忠顯校尉、管軍總把，尋命權千戶。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was appointed Loyal and Manifest Guardsman and troop commander, and soon was ordered to serve as acting thousand-household.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he was made Loyal and Manifest Guardsman and troop commander, and soon received an acting thousand-household appointment.

manualTranslations.zh: 是年冬，扈駕駐黑城。
manualTranslations.literal: That winter he escorted the imperial carriage when the court halted at Heicheng.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That winter he escorted the imperial retinue when the court halted at Heicheng.

manualTranslations.zh: 珍遣兵士儲芻藁，築土室，軍府賴其用。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhen sent soldiers to store fodder and build earthen shelters; the army headquarters relied on this provision.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhen had his men store fodder and build earthen shelters, supplies on which the army headquarters came to rely.

manualTranslations.zh: 道遇凍者，必扶入密室溫煦之。
manualTranslations.literal: If he met someone frozen on the road, he always helped him into a warm room to thaw.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Whenever he met someone frozen on the road, he brought the man into a warm room to thaw.

manualTranslations.zh: 軍糧必為撙節，不使頓絕以致饑困。
manualTranslations.literal: Army grain was always rationed so that supplies did not suddenly run out and cause hunger and hardship.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He always rationed army grain so that supplies never ran out abruptly and left the men hungry.

manualTranslations.zh: 十五年，充本衞都鎮撫。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifteenth year he served as commander of pacification of this guard.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he became commander of pacification of his guard.

manualTranslations.zh: 十七年，陞忠武校尉、中衞親軍總把，俄改屬後衞，賜銀符。
manualTranslations.literal: In the seventeenth year he was promoted to Loyal Martial Guardsman and chief commander of the Central Guard's personal troops; soon he was transferred to the Rear Guard and granted a silver tally.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he was promoted to Loyal Martial Guardsman and chief commander of the Central Guard's personal troops, then transferred to the Rear Guard and granted a silver tally.

manualTranslations.zh: 時白海初建行營，命珍督役，卒事，民不知擾，雖草木無纖介損。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time Baihai was first establishing a traveling camp; Zhen was ordered to supervise the labor. When the work was finished, the people knew no disturbance, and not even a blade of grass or tree was harmed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Baihai was first establishing a traveling camp, Zhen was ordered to supervise the work. When it was finished the people had scarcely noticed, and not a blade of grass or leaf had been harmed.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝臨幸，問其故，近臣以蔡珍號令嚴肅為對，帝嘉之，賞以鈔若干。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Emperor visited in person and asked the reason, a close attendant answered that Cai Zhen's orders were strict and severe; the Emperor commended this and rewarded him with a certain amount of paper money.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Emperor visited and asked why, a close attendant replied that Cai Zhen's orders were strict and severe. The Emperor praised him and rewarded him with paper money.

manualTranslations.zh: 二十一年，改授膠東海道都漕運司丁壯萬戶府都鎮撫。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twenty-first year he was reassigned as commander of pacification of the Jiaodong Sea Route Directorate of Grain Transport's ten-thousand-household office for able-bodied men.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year he was reassigned as commander of pacification of the Jiaodong Sea Route grain transport directorate's ten-thousand-household office for able-bodied men.

manualTranslations.zh: 二十七年，進後衞親軍千戶，佩金符。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year he was promoted to thousand-household of the Rear Guard's personal troops and wore the gold tally.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year he was promoted to thousand-household of the Rear Guard's personal troops and received the gold tally.

manualTranslations.zh: 元貞元年，進階武略。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Yuanzhen he was advanced in rank to Martial Strategy.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yuanzhen he was advanced in rank to Martial Strategy.

manualTranslations.zh: 俄告老而歸，子恕襲。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he retired on grounds of age and returned home; his son Shu inherited the post.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon he retired and returned home, and his son Shu succeeded him.

sourceRange.text: 孟德，濟南人。國初由鄒平縣令、淄州節度使累官至同知濟南路事。太宗即位之八年，諸王闊端命德為元帥，佩金符，領濟南軍攻宋徐州、光州，降其眾而有其地。歲甲辰，定宗母六皇后稱制，大王按只台以德為萬戶，攻濠、蘄、黃等州，積有戰功。憲宗即位之三年，命德守睢州。五年，移守海州。宋安撫呂文德以兵擾邊，德敗之，俘其太尉劉海。丁巳，從伯顏攻襄樊。己未，與子義從世祖攻鄂州，先登。中統三年，從征李璮。璮平，德以老告歸。義襲為萬戶，領兵守沂、郯。四年，賜虎符。至元元年，城郯。六年，從山東統軍帖赤如五河，宋軍拒南岸，義率兵渡河擊之，凡數戰有功。九年，授懷遠大將軍，遷宿州萬戶。十一年，宋制置夏貴攻正陽，義奪戰艦數艘，遂敗之。十二年，掠地至安慶等處，攻揚子橋獲功。十三年三月，改守杭州。九月，從下福建、溫、台等處。十四年四月，授昭勇大將軍、瑞州路達魯花赤。十月，徙鎮閩州。十六年，授昭勇大將軍、招討使。二十二年，復為沂郯萬戶。元貞元年，以老辭職。

manualTranslations.zh: 孟德，濟南人。
manualTranslations.literal: Meng De was a native of Jinan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Meng De was from Jinan.

manualTranslations.zh: 國初由鄒平縣令、淄州節度使累官至同知濟南路事。
manualTranslations.literal: At the founding of the dynasty, through posts as magistrate of Zouping County and military commissioner of Zizhou he rose in succession to associate administrator of Jinan Circuit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the dynasty's founding he rose through posts as magistrate of Zouping County and military commissioner of Zizhou to become associate administrator of Jinan Circuit.

manualTranslations.zh: 太宗即位之八年，諸王闊端命德為元帥，佩金符，領濟南軍攻宋徐州、光州，降其眾而有其地。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighth year after Taizong's accession, Prince Kuoduan appointed De marshal, granted him the gold tally, and had him lead the Jinan army to attack the Song prefectures of Xuzhou and Guangzhou; he reduced their forces and took their territory.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eighth year after Taizong's accession, Prince Kuoduan made De marshal, granted him the gold tally, and had him lead the Jinan army against the Song prefectures of Xuzhou and Guangzhou, reducing their forces and taking their territory.

manualTranslations.zh: 歲甲辰，定宗母六皇后稱制，大王按只台以德為萬戶，攻濠、蘄、黃等州，積有戰功。
manualTranslations.literal: In the jiachen year, when Dingzong's mother the Sixth Empress Dowager held the regency, Prince Anjitai made De a ten-thousand-household commander and attacked the prefectures of Hao, Qi, and Huang, accumulating repeated battle achievements.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In jiachen, when Dingzong's mother the Sixth Empress Dowager held the regency, Prince Anjitai made De a ten-thousand-household commander and attacked Hao, Qi, Huang, and other prefectures, winning repeated victories.

manualTranslations.zh: 憲宗即位之三年，命德守睢州。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year after Xianzong's accession, De was ordered to defend Suizhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year after Xianzong's accession he was ordered to defend Suizhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 五年，移守海州。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth year he was transferred to defend Haizhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was transferred to defend Haizhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 宋安撫呂文德以兵擾邊，德敗之，俘其太尉劉海。
manualTranslations.literal: Song pacification commissioner Lü Wende harassed the border with troops; De defeated him and captured his Grand Marshal Liu Hai.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Song pacification commissioner Lü Wende harassed the border, De defeated him and captured his Grand Marshal Liu Hai.

manualTranslations.zh: 丁巳，從伯顏攻襄樊。
manualTranslations.literal: On the dingsi day he followed Bayan in attacking Xiangyang and Fancheng.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On dingsi he followed Bayan in the attack on Xiangyang and Fancheng.

manualTranslations.zh: 己未，與子義從世祖攻鄂州，先登。
manualTranslations.literal: On the jiwei day he and his son Yi followed Shizu in attacking Ezhou and were first to ascend the walls.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On jiwei he and his son Yi followed Shizu in the assault on Ezhou and were first over the walls.

manualTranslations.zh: 中統三年，從征李璮。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year of Zhongtong he joined the campaign against Li Tan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year of Zhongtong he took part in the campaign against Li Tan.

manualTranslations.zh: 璮平，德以老告歸。
manualTranslations.literal: When Li Tan was pacified, De retired on grounds of age and returned home.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Li Tan was pacified, De retired on grounds of age and returned home.

manualTranslations.zh: 義襲為萬戶，領兵守沂、郯。
manualTranslations.literal: Yi inherited as ten-thousand-household commander and led troops to garrison Yi and Tan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yi succeeded as ten-thousand-household commander and garrisoned Yi and Tan with his troops.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年，賜虎符。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year he was granted a tiger tally.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he received a tiger tally.

manualTranslations.zh: 至元元年，城郯。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Zhiyuan he fortified Tan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Zhiyuan he fortified Tan.

manualTranslations.zh: 六年，從山東統軍帖赤如五河，宋軍拒南岸，義率兵渡河擊之，凡數戰有功。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth year he followed Shandong commander Tiechi to Wuhe; the Song army held the south bank, and Yi led troops across the river to attack them, winning merit in several battles.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he followed Shandong commander Tiechi to Wuhe. The Song army held the south bank, and Yi led his men across the river to attack them, distinguishing himself in several engagements.

manualTranslations.zh: 九年，授懷遠大將軍，遷宿州萬戶。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth year he was appointed General Who Cherishes the Distant and transferred to ten-thousand-household of Suzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was made cherishing-the-distant general and transferred to the Suzhou ten-thousand-household command.

manualTranslations.zh: 十一年，宋制置夏貴攻正陽，義奪戰艦數艘，遂敗之。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eleventh year Song commissioner-in-chief Xia Gui attacked Zhengyang; Yi captured several warships and then defeated him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year Song commissioner-in-chief Xia Gui attacked Zhengyang. Yi captured several warships and routed him.

manualTranslations.zh: 十二年，掠地至安慶等處，攻揚子橋獲功。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twelfth year he raided as far as Anqing and other places and won merit in the attack on Yangzi Bridge.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he raided as far as Anqing and other places and distinguished himself in the attack on Yangzi Bridge.

manualTranslations.zh: 十三年三月，改守杭州。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third month of the thirteenth year he was transferred to garrison Hangzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third month of the thirteenth year he was transferred to garrison Hangzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 九月，從下福建、溫、台等處。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth month he followed in reducing Fujian, Wenzhou, Taizhou, and other places.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth month he took part in reducing Fujian, Wenzhou, Taizhou, and other places.

manualTranslations.zh: 十四年四月，授昭勇大將軍、瑞州路達魯花赤。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth month of the fourteenth year he was appointed General of Manifest Courage and Ruizhou Circuit darughachi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the fourteenth year he was made manifest-courage general and darughachi of Ruizhou Circuit.

manualTranslations.zh: 十月，徙鎮閩州。
manualTranslations.literal: In the tenth month he was transferred to garrison Minzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he was transferred to garrison Minzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 十六年，授昭勇大將軍、招討使。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was appointed General of Manifest Courage and pacification commissioner.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he was made manifest-courage general and pacification commissioner.

manualTranslations.zh: 二十二年，復為沂郯萬戶。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twenty-second year he again became ten-thousand-household of Yi and Tan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year he again became ten-thousand-household of Yi and Tan.

manualTranslations.zh: 元貞元年，以老辭職。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Yuanzhen he resigned on grounds of age.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yuanzhen he resigned on grounds of age.

sourceRange.text: 」二十八年，召至京師。二十九年春，見帝於柳林行宮，遂上萬言書，極陳時政。授翰林學士、嘉議大夫。成宗即位，獻守成事鑑一十五篇，所論悉本諸經旨。元貞元年，加通議大夫、知制誥同修國史，奉旨纂修世祖實錄，因集聖訓六卷上之。大德元年，進中奉大夫。二年，賜鈔萬貫。乞致仕，不許。五年，再上章求退，遂授其子公孺為衞州推官，以便養，仍官其孫笴祕書郎。大德八年六月，卒。贈翰林學士承旨、資善大夫，追封太原郡公，諡文定。其著述有相鑑五十卷、汲郡志十五卷、承華事略、中堂事記、烏臺筆補、玉堂嘉話，并雜著詩文，合為一百卷。

sourceRange.text: 王惲字仲謀，衞州汲縣人。曾祖經。祖宇，仕金，官敦武校尉。父天鐸，金正大初，以律學中首選，仕至戶部主事。惲有材幹，操履端方，好學善屬文，與東魯王博文、渤海王旭齊名。史天澤將兵攻宋，過衞，一見接以賓禮。中統元年，左丞姚樞宣撫東平，辟為詳議官。時省部初建，令諸路各上儒吏之能理財者一人，惲以選至京師，上書論時政，與渤海周正並擢為中書省詳定官。二年春，轉翰林修撰、同知制誥，兼國史院編修官，尋兼中書省左右司都事。治錢穀，擢材能，議典禮，考制度，咸究所長，同僚服之。

sourceRange.text: 王國昌，膠州高密人。初為膠州千戶，中統元年，入覲，世祖察其能，遷左武衞親軍千戶，佩金符。召問軍旅之事，國昌奏對甚悉，帝嘉之，賜白金、錦袍。至元五年，人有上書言高麗境內黑山海道至宋境為近，帝命國昌往視之。泛海千餘里，風濤洶湧，從者恐，勸還，國昌神色自若，徐曰：「奉天子威命，未畢事而遽返，可乎？」遂至黑山乃還，帝延見慰勞。而東夷皆內屬，惟日本不受正朔，帝知隋時曾與中國通，遣使諭以威德，令國昌率兵護送，道經高麗。時高麗有叛臣據珍島城，帝因命國昌與經略使（卯）〔印〕突、史樞等攻拔之。八年，復遣使入日本，仍命國昌屯於高麗之義安郡以為援。冬十月，卒于軍。子通嗣。通，初襲爵為左衞親軍千戶，十二年從諸軍伐宋，渡江，鎮鄂州。時潭州不下，兵薄其城，通以所將千人破其柵，宋兵遁去，通縱兵追擊，殺獲甚眾，以功進武節將軍。從攻靜江，下之。十四年，改侍衞親軍千戶。明年，通上書，言今南方已定，而北陲未安，請屯田于和林，率所部自效，帝慰勞遣之。從破敵兵于金山，俘獲生口及馬羊牛駝不可勝計，進顯武將軍，賜金虎（府）〔符〕，陞僉左衞親軍都指揮使。從討叛王乃顏，遷副都指揮使。明年，屯田瓜、沙諸州，進階明威將軍。武宗即位，命總京城衞兵。樞密院復奏通攝左丞，領諸衞屯田兵。尋遷屯儲衞親軍都指揮使，鎮海口。以疾卒。

sourceRange.text: 張庭珍字國寶，臨潢全州人。父楫，金商州南倉使。歲壬辰，籍其民數千來降，太宗命監榷北京等路賦課，俄改北京都轉運使，因家北京。歲辛亥，憲宗即位，以庭珍為必闍赤。高麗不請命，擅徙居海中江華島，遣庭珍往問之。其王言：「臣事本朝未嘗不謹，而大軍歲入侵掠，避而走險，不得已也。」且賂庭珍金銀數千兩，庭珍却之而歸，以狀聞。帝為禁戍兵無擅入其地，高麗以安。帝伐宋，至閬州，授安撫使。

sourceRange.text: 天祥自被召還京，至是且一歲，未嘗得見帝言事，輸忠無地，常鬱鬱不自釋，又不欲苟糜廪祿，八年正月，移疾謝去。至通州，中書遣使追留，不還。帝聞之，賜鈔五千貫，仍命給傳，專官護送至其家。天祥望闕拜謝，辭所賜鈔而行。九年五月，拜中書右丞，議樞密院事，提調諸衞屯田，使者五致詔，以年老不能辭。十一年，仁宗在懷州，遣使賜幣帛、上尊酒。至大四年，仁宗即位，復遣使召之，辭以老疾不起。延祐三年四月，卒于家，年八十。累贈推忠正義全德佐理功臣、河南江北等處行中書省平章政事，追封趙國公，諡文忠。

manualTranslations.zh: 天祥自被召還京，至是且一歲，未嘗得見帝言事，輸忠無地，常鬱鬱不自釋，又不欲苟糜廪祿，八年正月，移疾謝去。
manualTranslations.literal: From the time Tianxiang was summoned back to the capital, nearly a year had passed by then, yet he had never been able to see the emperor and speak on affairs; he had no place to offer loyal counsel and was often depressed and unable to release himself. He also did not wish to idly consume his stipend. In the first month of the eighth year, he submitted illness and resigned.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From the time Tianxiang was summoned back to the capital, nearly a year had passed, yet he had never been able to see the emperor and speak on affairs; he had no place to offer loyal counsel and was often depressed and unable to release himself. He also did not wish to idly consume his stipend. In the first month of the eighth year, he submitted illness and resigned.

manualTranslations.zh: 至通州，中書遣使追留，不還。
manualTranslations.literal: When he reached Tongzhou, the Secretariat dispatched envoys to pursue and detain him; he did not return.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When he reached Tongzhou, the Secretariat dispatched envoys to pursue and detain him, but he did not return.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝聞之，賜鈔五千貫，仍命給傳，專官護送至其家。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor heard of it and bestowed five thousand strings of paper money, also ordering post relays provided and a dedicated official to escort him to his home.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the emperor heard of it, he bestowed five thousand strings of paper money and also ordered post relays provided and a dedicated official to escort Tianxiang to his home.

manualTranslations.zh: 天祥望闕拜謝，辭所賜鈔而行。
manualTranslations.literal: Tianxiang bowed in thanks toward the palace gate and declined the bestowed paper money before departing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tianxiang bowed in thanks toward the palace gate and declined the bestowed paper money before departing.

manualTranslations.zh: 九年五月，拜中書右丞，議樞密院事，提調諸衞屯田，使者五致詔，以年老不能辭。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth month of the ninth year, he was appointed Right Vice Director of the Secretariat, to deliberate on Privy Council affairs and supervise the garrison fields of the guards. Envoys came five times with edicts; because of his age he could not decline.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the ninth year, he was appointed Right Vice Director of the Secretariat, to deliberate on Privy Council affairs and supervise the garrison fields of the guards. Envoys came five times with edicts, but because of his age he could not decline.

manualTranslations.zh: 十一年，仁宗在懷州，遣使賜幣帛、上尊酒。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eleventh year, when Renzong was at Huaizhou, he dispatched envoys to bestow silks and superior wine.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, when Renzong was at Huaizhou, he dispatched envoys to bestow silks and superior wine.

manualTranslations.zh: 至大四年，仁宗即位，復遣使召之，辭以老疾不起。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhide, when Renzong ascended the throne, he again dispatched envoys to summon him; he declined on grounds of old age and illness and did not rise.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of the Zhide reign, when Renzong ascended the throne, he again dispatched envoys to summon him, but Tianxiang declined on grounds of old age and illness and did not rise.

manualTranslations.zh: 延祐三年四月，卒于家，年八十。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth month of the third year of Yanyou, he died at home, aged eighty.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the third year of the Yanyou reign, he died at home at the age of eighty.

manualTranslations.zh: 累贈推忠正義全德佐理功臣、河南江北等處行中書省平章政事，追封趙國公，諡文忠。

sourceRange.text: 武宗入即位，深嘉其忠，進階榮祿大夫，遙授平章政事，商議宣徽院事，行金復州新附軍萬戶府達魯花赤。至大二年，詔出金帛，大賚北邊諸軍，以禿堅不花明習事宜，能不憚勞苦，使即軍中，與其帥月赤察兒定議而給之，諸部大悅。帝深器之，拜宣徽使，出內藏兼金帶賜之，為同官賈廷瑞所嫉。廷瑞請以宣徽院為門下省，尚書省奏廷瑞擅易官制，帝大怒，欲殺之。禿堅不花力諫不可，帝曰：「賈廷瑞毀卿不直一錢，卿何力言邪？」對曰：「廷瑞所坐不當死，不敢以臣私隙，誤陛下失刑。」廷瑞遂得免。帝訪羣臣以治道，禿堅不花以為治國安民之實在於生財節用。帝嘉納焉。轉光祿大夫。

manualTranslations.zh: 武宗入即位，深嘉其忠，進階榮祿大夫，遙授平章政事，商議宣徽院事，行金復州新附軍萬戶府達魯花赤。
manualTranslations.literal: When Wuzong entered and took the throne he deeply commended Tujianbuhua's loyalty, promoted him to Grandee of Glorious Emolument, granted him in absentia the post of chief councillor, assigned him to deliberate on affairs of the Imperial Household Commission, and made him acting darughachi of the Wanhu office of the newly submitted army of Jinfu Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Wuzong entered the capital and took the throne he deeply commended Tujianbuhua's loyalty, promoted him to Grandee of Glorious Emolument, granted him in absentia the rank of chief councillor, assigned him to deliberate on Imperial Household Commission affairs, and appointed him acting darughachi of the wanhu office of the newly submitted army of Jinfu prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 至大二年，詔出金帛，大賚北邊諸軍，以禿堅不花明習事宜，能不憚勞苦，使即軍中，與其帥月赤察兒定議而給之，諸部大悅。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Zhida an edict issued gold and silks to bestow great rewards on the northern frontier armies; because Tujianbuhua clearly understood the affairs and did not shrink from toil, he was sent straight to the armies to settle distribution with their commander Yuechichaer, and all the tribes were greatly pleased.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year of the Zhida era an edict distributed gold and silks in a great reward to the northern frontier armies. Because Tujianbuhua understood the business thoroughly and did not shrink from hardship, he was sent directly to the camps to work out distribution with their commander Yuechichaer, to the great satisfaction of all the tribes.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝深器之，拜宣徽使，出內藏兼金帶賜之，為同官賈廷瑞所嫉。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor greatly valued him, appointed him commissioner of the imperial household, and granted him a gold belt from the inner treasury; his colleague Jia Tingrui envied him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor thought highly of him, appointed him commissioner of the imperial household, and granted him a gold belt from the inner treasury. His colleague Jia Tingrui grew envious.

manualTranslations.zh: 廷瑞請以宣徽院為門下省，尚書省奏廷瑞擅易官制，帝大怒，欲殺之。
manualTranslations.literal: Tingrui requested that the Imperial Household Commission be made the Gate Department; the Ministry of Personnel memorialized that Tingrui had on his own authority altered the official system, and the emperor was greatly angered and wished to execute him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tingrui proposed converting the Imperial Household Commission into the Gate Department. The Ministry of Personnel memorialized that Tingrui had altered the official system on his own authority. The emperor was furious and wanted him put to death.

manualTranslations.zh: 禿堅不花力諫不可，帝曰：「賈廷瑞毀卿不直一錢，卿何力言邪？」
manualTranslations.literal: Tujianbuhua remonstrated forcefully that this could not be done; the emperor said: "Jia Tingrui slanders you as not worth a cash—why do you speak so forcefully for him?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tujianbuhua remonstrated forcefully that this must not be done. The emperor said, "Jia Tingrui says you are not worth a cash—why do you speak so hard on his behalf?"

manualTranslations.zh: 對曰：「廷瑞所坐不當死，不敢以臣私隙，誤陛下失刑。」
manualTranslations.literal: He replied: "The offense for which Tingrui is charged does not merit death; your servant dares not let a private grudge cause Your Majesty to err in punishment."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He answered, "The offense for which Tingrui is charged does not merit death. I dare not let a private grudge cause Your Majesty to err in judgment."

manualTranslations.zh: 廷瑞遂得免。
manualTranslations.literal: Tingrui was thereby spared.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tingrui was thereby spared.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝訪羣臣以治道，禿堅不花以為治國安民之實在於生財節用。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor questioned the ministers on the way of governance; Tujianbuhua held that the substance of governing the state and settling the people lay in generating wealth and practicing economy.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor asked his ministers about the way of governance. Tujianbuhua held that the substance of governing the state and settling the people lay in generating revenue and practicing economy.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝嘉納焉。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor praised and accepted this.

sourceRange.text: 阿合馬既敗，和禮霍孫拜右丞相，中書庶務更新，省部用人，多所推薦。是年冬，立詹事院，以九思為丞，遂舉名儒上黨宋道、保定劉因、曹南夾谷之奇、東平李謙，分任東宮官屬。二十二年，皇太子薨，朝議欲罷詹事院，九思抗言曰：「皇孫，宗社人心所屬；詹事，所以輔成道德者也，奈何罷之！」眾以為允。三十年，進拜中書左丞，兼詹事丞。明年，世祖崩，成宗嗣位，改詹事院為徽政，以九思為副使；十一月，進資德大夫、中書（左）〔右〕丞。會修世祖、裕宗實錄，命九思兼領史事。大德二年，拜榮祿大夫、中書平章政事。五年，加大司徒。六年，進階光祿大夫，薨，年六十一。子金界奴，光祿大夫、河南省右丞。

sourceRange.text: 賈昔剌，燕之大興人也。本姓賈氏，其父仕金為庖人。昔剌體貌魁碩，有志於當世。歲甲申，因近臣入見莊聖太后，遂從睿宗於和林，典司御膳，以其鬚黃，賜名昔剌，俾氏族與蒙古人同，甚親幸之；又慮其漢人，不習於風土，令徙居濂州。帝復思之曰：「昔剌在吾左右，飲食殊安適。」促召入供奉，諸庖人皆隸焉。世祖在潛邸，知其重厚，使從迎皇后於弘吉剌之地，自是預謀帷幄，動中機會，內出銀三千兩，使買珍膳，乘傳上太官，恣其出入不問。又賜以牝馬及駒三十匹，并牧戶與之。是時兵餘，數以所賜分遺鄉里。世祖即位，立尚食、尚藥二局，賜金符，提點局事，兼領進納御膳生料。年老，謝事，病篤，索所賜衣衣之而卒。追封聞喜郡侯，謚敬懿。子丑妮子，方幼時，世祖愛之，嘗坐之御席傍。

sourceRange.text: 從攻西京，睦歡力戰先登，連中三矢，仆城下。太宗見而憐之，命軍校拔其矢，縛牛，刳其腸，裸而納諸牛腹中，良久乃甦。誓以死報，每遇敵，必身先之，官至太原路金銀鐵冶達魯花赤。仲溫豐頤廣顙，聲音洪亮，略涉書史。壬子歲，見世祖於野狐嶺，命備宿衞，凡所行幸，必在左右。丙辰，城上都，仲溫為工部提領，董其役。帝曰：「汝但執梃，雖百千人，寧不懼汝耶！」己未，大軍圍鄂，令督諸將。時守江軍士乏食，仲溫教之罾魚，以充其食，帝喜謂侍臣曰：「朕思不及此。飲以駝乳，他日不忘汝也。」一夕，帝聞敵軍讙譟，命警備，仲溫奉繩床，帝憑其肩以行，至旦不能寐。中統元年，擢平陽、太原兩路宣撫使；二年，改西京。至元九年，遷順德路總管。時方用兵江淮，有寡婦鬻子以償轉輸之直，仲溫出俸金贖還之。十六年，為湖南宣慰使。二十二年，改淮東。歲旱，仲溫導白水塘溉民田，公私賴焉。

manualTranslations.zh: 從攻西京，睦歡力戰先登，連中三矢，仆城下。
manualTranslations.literal: Following the attack on Western Capital, Muhuan fought fiercely and was first to scale the wall, was struck by three arrows in succession, and fell beneath the wall.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the assault on Western Capital he fought fiercely and was first to scale the wall. Three arrows struck him in succession and he fell beneath the ramparts.

manualTranslations.zh: 太宗見而憐之，命軍校拔其矢，縛牛，刳其腸，裸而納諸牛腹中，良久乃甦。
manualTranslations.literal: Taizong saw this and pitied him, ordered a military officer to pull out the arrows, bound an ox, cut open its belly, stripped him naked and placed him in the ox's belly; after a long while he revived.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Taizong saw him and took pity. He ordered the arrows drawn, an ox bound and its belly opened, and Muhuan placed naked inside the carcass. After a long while he revived.

manualTranslations.zh: 誓以死報，每遇敵，必身先之，官至太原路金銀鐵冶達魯花赤。
manualTranslations.literal: He swore to repay with his death, and whenever he met the enemy always went before the rest; he reached office as darughachi of gold, silver, and iron smelting on the Taiyuan Circuit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He swore to repay the favor with his life, and ever after led the charge against every enemy. He rose to darughachi of gold, silver, and iron smelting on the Taiyuan circuit.

manualTranslations.zh: 仲溫豐頤廣顙，聲音洪亮，略涉書史。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhongwen had a full face and broad forehead, a resonant voice, and slight acquaintance with books and history.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhongwen had a full face and broad forehead, a resonant voice, and some acquaintance with books and history.

manualTranslations.zh: 壬子歲，見世祖於野狐嶺，命備宿衞，凡所行幸，必在左右。
manualTranslations.literal: In the year renzi he was received by the Founder at Yehuling and ordered to stand ready in the palace guard; on every progress he was always at the emperor's side.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the renzi year he was received by Kublai at Yehuling and ordered into the palace guard. On every imperial progress he was always at the emperor's side.

manualTranslations.zh: 丙辰，城上都，仲溫為工部提領，董其役。
manualTranslations.literal: In the year bingchen, when Shangdu was being walled, Zhongwen served as supervisor of the Ministry of Works and oversaw the labor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the bingchen year, when Shangdu was being walled, Zhongwen served as supervisor of the Ministry of Works and directed the project.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝曰：「汝但執梃，雖百千人，寧不懼汝耶！」
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor said: "You need only hold a staff—even a thousand men, would they not fear you!"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "You need only hold a staff—even against a thousand men, would they not fear you!"

manualTranslations.zh: 己未，大軍圍鄂，令督諸將。
manualTranslations.literal: In the year jiwei the great army besieged E, and he was ordered to supervise the generals.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the jiwei year the great army besieged Ezhou, and he was ordered to supervise the generals.

manualTranslations.zh: 時守江軍士乏食，仲溫教之罾魚，以充其食，帝喜謂侍臣曰：「朕思不及此。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time the river-guard soldiers lacked food; Zhongwen taught them to seine fish to fill their rations; the emperor delightedly told his attendants: "I did not think of this.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At that time the river-guard soldiers lacked food. Zhongwen taught them to seine fish for their rations. The emperor delightedly told his attendants, "I never thought of this.

manualTranslations.zh: 飲以駝乳，他日不忘汝也。」
manualTranslations.literal: Drink camel's milk—another day I shall not forget you."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Have him drink camel's milk—I shall not forget you."

manualTranslations.zh: 一夕，帝聞敵軍讙譟，命警備，仲溫奉繩床，帝憑其肩以行，至旦不能寐。
manualTranslations.literal: One night the emperor heard the enemy army shouting and clamoring and ordered alert preparations; Zhongwen presented a rope bed and the emperor leaned on his shoulder as he walked, and until dawn could not sleep.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: One night the emperor heard shouting from the enemy camp and ordered the guard alerted. Zhongwen brought a rope bed, and the emperor leaned on his shoulder as he walked about, unable to sleep until dawn.

manualTranslations.zh: 中統元年，擢平陽、太原兩路宣撫使；
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Zhongtong he was promoted to pacification commissioner of the Pingyang and Taiyuan circuits;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Zhongtong era he was promoted to pacification commissioner of the Pingyang and Taiyuan circuits;

manualTranslations.zh: 二年，改西京。
manualTranslations.literal: in the second year he was transferred to Western Capital.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: in the second year he was transferred to Western Capital.

manualTranslations.zh: 至元九年，遷順德路總管。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth year of Zhiyuan he was moved to be prefect of Shunde Circuit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of the Zhiyuan era he was transferred to prefect of Shunde circuit.

manualTranslations.zh: 時方用兵江淮，有寡婦鬻子以償轉輸之直，仲溫出俸金贖還之。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time war was being waged on the Jiang-Huai front; a widow sold her son to pay transport charges, and Zhongwen used his salary to ransom and return him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: War was then being waged on the Jiang-Huai front. A widow sold her son to pay transport charges, and Zhongwen used his salary to ransom the boy and return him to her.

manualTranslations.zh: 十六年，為湖南宣慰使。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixteenth year he became pacification commissioner of Hunan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he became pacification commissioner of Hunan.

manualTranslations.zh: 二十二年，改淮東。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twenty-second year he was transferred to Huaidong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year he was transferred to Huaidong.

manualTranslations.zh: 歲旱，仲溫導白水塘溉民田，公私賴焉。
manualTranslations.literal: In a year of drought Zhongwen channeled the White Water Pond to irrigate the people's fields, and public and private interests alike relied on it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In a year of drought Zhongwen channeled the White Water Pond to irrigate the people's fields, to the benefit of both public and private interests.

sourceRange.text: 英宗即位，超遷翰林學士，進階太中大夫。先是，有旨集善書者，粉黃金為泥，寫浮屠藏經。帝在上都，使左丞速速，詔澄為序，澄曰：「主上寫經，為民祈福，甚盛舉也。若用以追薦，臣所未知。蓋福田利益，雖人所樂聞，而輪回之事，彼習其學者，猶或不言。不過謂為善之人，死則上通高明，其極品則與日月齊光；為惡之人，死則下淪污穢，其極下則與沙蟲同類。其徒遂為薦拔之說，以惑世人。今列聖之神，上同日月，何庸薦拔！且國初以來，凡寫經追薦，不知幾舉。若未效，是無佛法矣；若已效，是誣其祖矣。撰為文辭，不可以示後世，請俟駕還奏之。」會帝崩而止。泰定元年，初開經筵，首命澄與平章政事張珪、國子祭酒鄧文原為講官。

manualTranslations.zh: 蓋福田利益，雖人所樂聞，而輪回之事，彼習其學者，猶或不言。
manualTranslations.literal: For though the blessings of the field of merit are what all men delight to hear, as to the matter of transmigration, even those who study that learning sometimes decline to speak of it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Though the blessings of the field of merit are what everyone delights to hear, even those who study transmigration sometimes decline to speak of it.

manualTranslations.zh: 不過謂為善之人，死則上通高明，其極品則與日月齊光；
manualTranslations.literal: They merely say that good men, when they die, ascend to what is lofty and bright, and at the highest rank shine together with sun and moon;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: They merely say that the good, when they die, ascend to what is lofty and bright, and at the highest rank shine together with sun and moon;

manualTranslations.zh: 為惡之人，死則下淪污穢，其極下則與沙蟲同類。
manualTranslations.literal: evil men, when they die, sink down into filth and defilement, and at the lowest rank are of the same kind as sand worms.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: while the wicked, when they die, sink into filth and defilement, and at the lowest rank are classed with sand worms.

manualTranslations.zh: 其徒遂為薦拔之說，以惑世人。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: Their followers then devised doctrines of intercession and deliverance to delude the people.

manualTranslations.zh: 今列聖之神，上同日月，何庸薦拔！

manualTranslations.idiomatic: Now the spirits of the successive sage emperors are above, equal with sun and moon—what need is there for intercession!

manualTranslations.zh: 且國初以來，凡寫經追薦，不知幾舉。
manualTranslations.literal: Moreover, since the founding of the dynasty, copyings of sutras for posthumous intercession have been attempted beyond counting.

manualTranslations.zh: 若未效，是無佛法矣；

sourceRange.text: 寶泉提舉張簡及子乃蠻帶，告彧嘗受鄒道源、許宗師銀萬五千兩；又其子知微訟彧不法十餘事。有旨就辯中書。彧已書簡等所告，與己宜對者為牘袖之，視而後對。簡父子所告皆無驗，並繫獄，簡瘐死，仍籍其家一女入官；乃蠻帶、知微皆坐杖罪除名。三十一年，成宗即位。先是，彧得玉璽于故臣扎剌氏之家，其文曰：「受命于天、既壽永昌」，即以上之徽仁裕聖皇后。至是，皇后手以授于成宗。彧以久任憲臺，乞遷他職，不許。成宗諭之曰：「卿若辭避，其誰抗言哉！」彧言：「肅政廉訪司案牘，而令總管府檢劾，非宜。」成宗曰：「朕知難行，當時事由小人擅奏耳，其改之。」大德元年，彧又條陳臺憲諸事，皆見於施行。

sourceRange.text: 燧年三十八，始為秦王府文學。未幾，授奉議大夫，兼提舉陝西、四川、中興等路學校。十二年，以秦王命，安輯庸、蜀。明年，漢嘉新附，入諭其民。又奉命招王立於合州。又明年，撫循夔府。凡三使蜀，皆稱職。十七年，除陝西漢中道提刑按察司副使。錄囚延安，逮繫詿誤，皆縱釋之，人服其明決。調山南湖北道。按部澧州，興學賑民，孜孜如弗及。二十三年，自湖北奉旨趨朝。明年，為翰林直學士。二十七年，授大司農丞。元貞元年，以翰林學士召修世祖實錄。初置檢閱官，究覈故事，燧與侍讀高道凝總裁之，書成。大德五年，授中憲大夫、江東廉訪使，移病太平。九年，拜中奉大夫、江西行省參知政事。至大元年，仁宗居藩邸，開宮師府，燧年已七十，遣正字呂洙，如漢徵四皓故事，起燧為太子賓客。

sourceRange.text: 久之，拜陝西行臺中丞，不赴。武宗即位，召拜太子諭德。未數日，拜賓客，復拜詹事，辭不就。尚書省立，中外洶洶，中丞久闕，方議擇人，仁宗時在東宮，曰：「必欲得真中丞，惟張珪可。」即日召拜中丞。至大四年，帝崩，仁宗將即位，廷臣用（太皇）〔皇太〕后旨，行大禮於隆福宮，法駕已陳矣，珪言：「當御大明殿。」御史大夫止之曰：「議已定，雖百奏無益。」珪曰：「未始一奏，詎知無益！」入奏，帝悟，移仗大明。既即位，賜只孫衣二十襲、金帶一。帝嘗親解衣賜珪，明日復召，謂之曰：「朕欲賜卿寶玉，非卿所欲。」以帨拭面額，納諸珪懷，曰：「朕澤之所存，朕心之所存也。

sourceRange.text: 三十年，御史臺奏為侍御史，中書省奏為吏部尚書，已而復留為侍御史，遷江南行御史臺中丞。大德元年，改同僉樞密院事，尋出為雲南行中書省左丞。右丞忙兀突魯迷失請征緬，正以為不可，俄俱被徵，又極言其不可，不從，師果無功。雲南民歲輸金銀，近中慶城邑戶口，則詭稱逃亡，甸寨遠者，季秋則遣官領兵往徵，人馬芻糧，往返之費，歲以萬計；所差官必重賂省臣，乃得遣，徵收金銀之數，必十加二，而拆閱之數又如之；其送迎饋贐，亦如納官之數，所遣者又以銅雜銀中納官。正首疏其弊，給官秤，俾土官身詣官輸納，其弊始革。始至官，儲𧴩二百七十萬索、白銀百錠，比四年，得𧴩一千七十萬索、金百錠、銀三千錠。

manualTranslations.zh: 大德元年，改同僉樞密院事，尋出為雲南行中書省左丞。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Dade he was changed to Associate Privy Council Commissioner; soon after he was sent out as Left Vice Councillor of the Yunnan Branch Secretariat.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In 1297 he was appointed Associate Privy Council Commissioner and soon sent out as Left Vice Councillor of the Yunnan Branch Secretariat.

manualTranslations.zh: 右丞忙兀突魯迷失請征緬，正以為不可，俄俱被徵，又極言其不可，不從，師果無功。
manualTranslations.literal: Right Vice Councillor Mangwu Turumishi requested a Burma campaign; Zheng considered it inadvisable; soon both were summoned back; he again urgently argued it was inadvisable; the proposal was not followed, and the army indeed achieved nothing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Right Vice Councillor Mangwu Turumishi requested a Burma campaign. Zheng considered it inadvisable. Soon both men were recalled, and Zheng again urgently argued against the expedition. His advice was not followed, and the army indeed achieved nothing.

manualTranslations.zh: 雲南民歲輸金銀，近中慶城邑戶口，則詭稱逃亡，甸寨遠者，季秋則遣官領兵往徵，人馬芻糧，往返之費，歲以萬計；
manualTranslations.literal: Yunnan people paid gold and silver yearly in tribute; near Zhongqing city and town households falsely claimed flight; for distant stockade communities, in late autumn officials were sent leading troops to collect, with costs of men, horses, fodder, and grain for round trips running to tens of thousands each year;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yunnan people paid gold and silver in annual tribute. Households near Zhongqing city and towns falsely claimed flight, while for distant stockade communities officials were sent with troops each late autumn to collect. The costs of men, horses, fodder, and grain for round trips ran to tens of thousands each year;

manualTranslations.zh: 所差官必重賂省臣，乃得遣，徵收金銀之數，必十加二，而拆閱之數又如之；
manualTranslations.literal: Officials assigned for collection had to bribe provincial ministers heavily before they could be dispatched; the amount of gold and silver collected was always increased by two parts in ten, and the tally at examination was inflated again;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Assigned collectors had to bribe provincial ministers heavily before they could be dispatched. The amount of gold and silver collected was always increased by two parts in ten, and the tally at examination was inflated again;

manualTranslations.zh: 其送迎饋贐，亦如納官之數，所遣者又以銅雜銀中納官。
manualTranslations.literal: Their gifts for escort and farewell equaled the amounts paid to the state, and those sent out also mixed copper into the silver submitted to the government.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Their gifts for escort and farewell equaled the amounts paid to the state, and those sent out also mixed copper into the silver they submitted.

manualTranslations.zh: 正首疏其弊，給官秤，俾土官身詣官輸納，其弊始革。
manualTranslations.literal: Zheng was first to memorialize these abuses; official scales were provided and native officials required to come in person to submit payments at government offices, and the abuses were then reformed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zheng was first to memorialize these abuses. Official scales were provided and native officials required to come in person to submit payments, and the abuses were then reformed.

manualTranslations.zh: 始至官，儲𧴩二百七十萬索、白銀百錠，比四年，得𧴩一千七十萬索、金百錠、銀三千錠。
manualTranslations.literal: When he first took office, stored reserves were two million seven hundred thousand suo and one hundred ingots of silver; after four years there were ten million seven hundred thousand suo, one hundred ingots of gold, and three thousand ingots of silver.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When he first took office, stored reserves amounted to two million seven hundred thousand suo and one hundred ingots of silver; after four years there were ten million seven hundred thousand suo, one hundred ingots of gold, and three thousand ingots of silver.

sourceRange.text: 」起宗生長兵間，學書無從得紙，父順削柳為簡，寫以授之；成誦，削去更書。年十七，會立蒙古學，學輒成，辟武衞譯史。御史中丞塔察兒愛其才，遷中臺〔譯〕史。是時，尚書省專制更張，起宗持文嚴密無所泄。仁宗即位，罷尚書省，轉中書〔譯〕史，累遷太子家令司典簿官，上言：「東宮官屬，輔導德義，財賦非所治也。」朝廷是之。遷南臺御史。建康多水，或實災而有司抑之，或無災而訴災，起宗微行得實，人以為神明。

context.afterLocal: 文宗初立，命威順王徵八番。

manualTranslations.zh: 起宗生長兵間，學書無從得紙，父順削柳為簡，寫以授之；
manualTranslations.literal: Qizong grew up amid warfare; in studying writing he could obtain no paper; his father Shun shaved willow into slips, wrote on them, and gave them to him;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Qizong grew up amid warfare. When he studied writing he could obtain no paper, so his father Shun shaved willow into slips, wrote on them, and gave them to him;

manualTranslations.zh: 成誦，削去更書。
manualTranslations.literal: When he could recite, he shaved them clean and wrote anew.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When he could recite a passage, he shaved the slip clean and wrote anew.

manualTranslations.zh: 年十七，會立蒙古學，學輒成，辟武衞譯史。
manualTranslations.literal: At seventeen the Mongol Academy was established; he mastered his studies as soon as he began and was recruited as translator-clerk of the Imperial Guard.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At seventeen, when the Mongol Academy was established, he mastered his studies at once and was recruited as translator-clerk of the Imperial Guard.

manualTranslations.zh: 御史中丞塔察兒愛其才，遷中臺〔譯〕史。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: Vice Censor-in-Chief Tachar admired his talent and transferred him to translator-clerk of the Central Branch Censorate.

manualTranslations.zh: 是時，尚書省專制更張，起宗持文嚴密無所泄。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time the Secretariat monopolized power and changed regulations; Qizong kept documents strictly and let nothing leak.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At that time the Secretariat monopolized power and changed regulations, but Qizong kept documents strictly and let nothing leak.

manualTranslations.zh: 仁宗即位，罷尚書省，轉中書〔譯〕史，累遷太子家令司典簿官，上言：「東宮官屬，輔導德義，財賦非所治也。」
manualTranslations.literal: When Renzong ascended the throne and abolished the Secretariat, he transferred to translator-clerk of the Central Secretariat, rose through posts to Registrar of the Crown Prince's Household Steward Directorate, and submitted: "The Crown Prince's staff should guide in virtue and moral principle; fiscal levies are not what they should administer."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Renzong ascended the throne and abolished the Secretariat, Qizong transferred to translator-clerk of the Central Secretariat and rose to Registrar of the Crown Prince's Household Steward Directorate. He submitted, "The Crown Prince's staff should guide in virtue and moral principle; fiscal levies are not what they should administer."

manualTranslations.zh: 朝廷是之。
manualTranslations.literal: The court approved this.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The court approved his view.

manualTranslations.zh: 遷南臺御史。
manualTranslations.literal: He was transferred to censor of the Southern Branch Censorate.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was transferred to censor of the Southern Branch Censorate.

manualTranslations.zh: 建康多水，或實災而有司抑之，或無災而訴災，起宗微行得實，人以為神明。

sourceRange.text: 文宗天曆元年，起為江浙行中書省左丞。會陝西大饑，中書撥江浙鹽運司歲課十萬錠賑之。吏白：周歲所入，已輸京師，當回咨中書。思明曰：「陝西饑民，猶鮒在涸轍，往復踰月，是索之枯魚之肆也。其以下年未輸者，如數與之，有罪，吾當坐。」朝廷韙之。二年，復以中書左丞召，入覲慈仁殿，敷陳累朝任賢使能、治民足國之道，因以衰老辭，帝未允，明日，即移告去。重紀至元三年卒，年七十八。

context.beforeSource: 及拜住為左丞相，與帖木迭兒各樹朋黨，賊害忠良，思明懼禍及，累表辭，不獲，後竟誣以不支蒙古子女口糧，餓死四百人，遂廢于家，杜門六年。
context.afterSource: 思明平生不治產，不畜財，收書三萬七千餘卷；

manualTranslations.zh: 文宗天曆元年，起為江浙行中書省左丞。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of the Tianli reign of Emperor Wenzong, he was recalled and appointed Left Chancellor of the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first Tianli year of Emperor Wenzong, he was recalled and appointed Left Chancellor of the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat.

manualTranslations.zh: 會陝西大饑，中書撥江浙鹽運司歲課十萬錠賑之。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time Shaanxi suffered a great famine; the Central Secretariat allocated one hundred thousand ingots from the Jiang-Zhe Salt Transport Commission's annual levy for relief.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Shaanxi suffered a severe famine, the Central Secretariat allocated one hundred thousand ingots from the Jiang-Zhe Salt Transport Commission's annual revenue for famine relief.

manualTranslations.zh: 吏白：周歲所入，已輸京師，當回咨中書。
manualTranslations.literal: The clerks reported: "The revenue for the full year has already been sent to the capital; we should consult the Central Secretariat in return."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The clerks reported, "This year's revenues have already been forwarded to the capital; we must consult the Central Secretariat first."

manualTranslations.zh: 思明曰：「陝西饑民，猶鮒在涸轍，往復踰月，是索之枯魚之肆也。
manualTranslations.literal: Siming said: "The famine victims in Shaanxi are like fish stranded in a dried rut; a round trip would take more than a month—that would be like seeking them in a dried-fish shop.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Siming said, "Shaanxi's famine victims are like fish dying in a dried rut; a round trip would take over a month—that would be like looking for them in a shop that sells dried fish.

manualTranslations.zh: 其以下年未輸者，如數與之，有罪，吾當坐。」
manualTranslations.literal: Give them the full amount from next year's unpaid levy; if there is guilt, I shall bear the punishment."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: "Use next year's unpaid revenues and give the full amount; if anyone is to blame, let me bear the punishment."

manualTranslations.zh: 朝廷韙之。
manualTranslations.literal: The court approved of it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The court commended his action.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年，復以中書左丞召，入覲慈仁殿，敷陳累朝任賢使能、治民足國之道，因以衰老辭，帝未允，明日，即移告去。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year he was again summoned as Left Chancellor of the Central Secretariat, entered audience at Ciren Hall, and expounded the ways by which successive dynasties had employed worthy and capable men and governed the people to enrich the state; citing his old age, he declined. The Emperor did not agree; the next day he submitted his resignation and departed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The following year he was again summoned as Left Chancellor of the Central Secretariat. At audience in Ciren Hall he expounded how successive courts had employed the worthy and capable to govern the people and enrich the state, then declined on grounds of old age. The Emperor refused; the next day he submitted his resignation and left office.

manualTranslations.zh: 重紀至元三年卒，年七十八。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year of Chongji Zhiyuan he died, at the age of seventy-eight.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died in the third year of Chongji Zhiyuan, at the age of seventy-eight.

manualTranslations.zh: 仁宗即位，遷集賢直學士。
manualTranslations.literal: When Renzong took the throne, Jie was transferred to Direct Academician of the Hall of Gathered Worthies.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Renzong took the throne, Jie was made direct academician of the Hall of Gathered Worthies.

manualTranslations.zh: 出為順德路總管，教民務農興學、孝親弟長、戢奸禁暴，悉登于書，俾朝夕閱習之。
manualTranslations.literal: Sent out as Prefect of Shunde Circuit, he taught the people to devote themselves to farming and promote schools, to honor parents and respect elder brothers, to restrain the wicked and forbid violence—all were written in books for daily reading and study.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: As prefect of Shunde Circuit he taught the people to farm, promote schools, honor parents, respect elders, restrain the wicked, and forbid violence, recording all this in books for daily study.

manualTranslations.zh: 屬邑鉅鹿沙河有唐魏徵、宋璟墓，乃祠二公于學，表其言論風旨，以厲多士。
manualTranslations.literal: In the subordinate county Julu, on the Sha River, were the tombs of Tang's Wei Zheng and Song Jing; he erected shrines to the two lords at the school, displaying their words and principles to encourage many scholars.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Julu County on the Sha River stood the tombs of Tang's Wei Zheng and Song Jing; he enshrined the two men at the school and displayed their words and principles to encourage scholars.

manualTranslations.zh: 遷揚州，又遷寧國，以從弟紳僉江東廉訪司事，辭不赴。
manualTranslations.literal: Transferred to Yangzhou, then to Ningguo; when his cousin Shen was appointed to the Jiangdong Office for Scrutinizing Governance and Integrity, Jie declined and did not take up the post.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Yangzhou and then Ningguo. When his cousin Shen was appointed to the Jiangdong integrity commission, Jie declined and did not take office.

manualTranslations.zh: 改東昌路，境有黃河故道，而會通堤遏其下流，夏月潦水，壞民麥禾。
manualTranslations.literal: Reassigned to Dongchang Circuit; within its territory was an old course of the Yellow River, and the Huitong embankment blocked its lower flow; in summer months floodwater ruined the people's wheat and millet.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Reassigned to Dongchang Circuit, he found an old Yellow River channel whose lower flow was blocked by the Huitong embankment; summer floods ruined the people's wheat and millet.

manualTranslations.zh: 結疏為斗門以泄之，民獲耕治之利。
manualTranslations.literal: Jie memorialized to build sluice gates for drainage, and the people gained the benefit of tillage and cultivation.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jie memorialized for sluice gates to drain the water, and the people gained the benefit of farming again.

manualTranslations.zh: 元統元年，復除浙西廉訪使，未行，召拜翰林學士、資善大夫、知制誥同修國史，與張起巖、歐陽玄修泰定、天曆兩朝實錄。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Yuantong he was again appointed Commissioner of the Zhe-West Office for Scrutinizing Governance and Integrity; before he could set out, he was summoned and appointed Hanlin Academician, Grand Master of Virtuous Goodness, Drafter of Edicts and Compiler of National History, joining Zhang Qiyan and Ouyang Xuan in compiling the Veritable Records of the Taiding and Tianli reigns.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Yuantong 1 (1333) he was again appointed commissioner of the Zhe-West integrity office but, before departing, was summoned as Hanlin academician, grand master of virtuous goodness, drafter of edicts, and compiler of national history, joining Zhang Qiyan and Ouyang Xuan to compile the veritable records of the Taiding and Tianli reigns.

manualTranslations.zh: 拜中書左丞。
manualTranslations.literal: He was appointed Left Vice Councillor of the Central Secretariat.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was appointed left vice councillor of the Central Secretariat.

manualTranslations.zh: 中宮命僧尼於慈福殿作佛事，已而殿災，結言僧尼褻瀆，當坐罪。
manualTranslations.literal: The Central Palace ordered monks and nuns to perform Buddhist rites in Cifu Hall; soon the hall burned, and Jie said the monks and nuns had committed sacrilege and should be punished.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The empress ordered monks and nuns to perform Buddhist rites in Cifu Hall; when the hall burned, Jie said the monks and nuns had committed sacrilege and should be punished.

manualTranslations.zh: 左丞相疾革，家人請釋重囚禳之，結極陳其不可。
manualTranslations.literal: The Left Chancellor was gravely ill; his family asked to release serious criminals to avert calamity; Jie urgently argued this was impermissible.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the left chancellor was gravely ill, his family asked to release serious criminals to avert calamity; Jie urgently argued that this was impermissible.

manualTranslations.zh: 先時，有罪者，北人則徙廣海，南人則徙遼東，去家萬里，往往道死。
manualTranslations.literal: Previously, offenders were exiled—northerners to Guanghai, southerners to Liaodong, ten thousand li from home, and many died on the road.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Previously offenders were exiled—northerners to Guanghai and southerners to Liaodong, ten thousand li from home, and many died on the road.

manualTranslations.zh: 結請更其法，移鄉者止千里外，改過聽還其鄉，因著為令。
manualTranslations.literal: Jie requested reform of the law: those exiled were sent only beyond a thousand li; if they reformed they were allowed to return to their native place—and this was written as a statute.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jie requested reform: exiles were sent only beyond a thousand li, and those who reformed were allowed to return home; this was written into statute.

manualTranslations.zh: 職官坐罪者，多從重科，結曰：「古者，刑不上大夫，今貪墨雖多，然士之廉耻，不可以不養也。」
manualTranslations.literal: For officials convicted of crimes, heavy penalties were often applied; Jie said: "In antiquity punishment did not reach grandees; though corruption is abundant today, the integrity of scholars must not go unnurtured."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Officials convicted of crimes were often punished severely; Jie said, "In antiquity punishment did not reach grandees; though corruption is rife today, the integrity of scholars must still be nurtured."

manualTranslations.zh: 聞者謂其得體。
manualTranslations.literal: Hearers said he had hit the proper tone.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Hearers said he had spoken appropriately.

manualTranslations.zh: 至元元年，詔復入翰林，養疾不能應詔。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Zhiyuan an edict recalled him to the Hanlin Academy, but illness prevented him from answering the summons.
