manualTranslations.zh: 大德元年，除杭州路總管，戶口復者五萬二千四百戶，請禁莫夜鞫囚、游街、酷刑，朝廷是之，著為令。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Dade he was appointed Prefect of Hangzhou Circuit; households restored numbered fifty-two thousand four hundred; he requested prohibition of nighttime interrogation, parading prisoners in the streets, and cruel punishments—the court approved and wrote it into statute.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Dade 1 (1297) he was appointed prefect of Hangzhou Circuit; fifty-two thousand four hundred households were restored; he petitioned to ban nighttime interrogation, parading prisoners, and cruel punishments, and the court approved and made it statute.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年，丁內艱。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year he mourned his mother.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he mourned his mother.

manualTranslations.zh: 先是，丁憂之制未行，曾上言請如禮。
manualTranslations.literal: Earlier, the mourning-leave system had not been in force; Ceng had memorialized requesting it follow ritual propriety.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Earlier the mourning-leave system had not been enforced; Ceng had memorialized that it should follow ritual propriety.

manualTranslations.zh: 七年，除潭州路總管，以未終制，不赴。
manualTranslations.literal: In the seventh year he was appointed Prefect of Tanzhou Circuit but, as mourning was not yet complete, did not go.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was appointed prefect of Tanzhou Circuit but, as mourning was not yet complete, did not take office.

manualTranslations.zh: 明年，遷兩浙都轉運鹽使。
manualTranslations.literal: The next year he was transferred to Director of Salt Transport for the Two Zhe regions.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The next year he was transferred to director of salt transport for the Two Zhe regions.

manualTranslations.zh: 又明年，拜雲南行省參知政事，賜三珠金虎符。
manualTranslations.literal: The year after that he was appointed Vice Administrator of the Yunnan Branch Secretariat and granted a three-pearl gold tiger tally.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The year after that he was made vice administrator of the Yunnan regional secretariat and granted a three-pearl gold tiger tally.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋召還京，辭以母喪未葬，扶柩北歸，至長蘆，有旨賜鈔一百錠，使營葬。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon summoned back to the capital, he declined on grounds that his mother's funeral was not yet completed; bearing the coffin north, at Changlu an edict granted one hundred ingots of paper money for burial arrangements.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon summoned back to the capital, he declined because his mother's funeral was not yet complete; bearing the coffin north, at Changlu an edict granted one hundred ingots of paper money for the burial.

manualTranslations.zh: 十年，召為中書參議，嘗預燕，賜只孫一襲。
manualTranslations.literal: In the tenth year he was summoned as Participating Secretary of the Central Secretariat; he once attended a banquet and was granted one jisun robe.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was summoned as participating secretary of the Central Secretariat; he once attended a banquet and was granted one jisun robe.

manualTranslations.zh: 十一年，轉正奉大夫，出為河南行省參知政事，尋遷湖廣行省參知政事。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eleventh year he was promoted to Grand Master of Positive Tribute, sent out as Vice Administrator of the Henan Branch Secretariat, and soon transferred to Vice Administrator of the Huguang Branch Secretariat.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was promoted to grand master of positive tribute, sent out as vice administrator of the Henan regional secretariat, and soon transferred to vice administrator of the Huguang regional secretariat.

manualTranslations.zh: 至大四年，以疾辭歸，敕賜藥物，存問備至。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhida he resigned and returned home due to illness; an edict granted medicines with the utmost solicitude.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Zhida 4 (1311) he resigned and returned home due to illness; an edict granted medicines with the utmost solicitude.

sourceRange.text: 拜住，乃哈剌帖木兒之子也。嘗從成宗北征，特授檀州知州，入為禮部郎中，擢同知大都路總管府事，出知中山府，以憂去官。屬仁宗過中山，有同官者，譖於近侍曰：「知（州）〔府〕去官，實憚迎候煩勞耳。」帝頷之，適行田野間，見老嫗，問之曰：「府中官孰賢？」嫗對曰：「有蕭知府，餘不知也。」復過神祠，有數老人焚香羅拜，遣問之曰：「汝輩何所禱？」合辭對曰：「蕭知府奔喪還，欲速其來，是以禱也。」帝意遂釋。武宗即位，起復為中書左司郎中，出為河間路總管，召為右衞率使，遷戶部尚書，遂拜御史中丞。皇慶元年，遷陝西行中書省右丞。延祐三年，進中書平章政事，除典瑞院使，超授銀青榮祿大夫、崇祥院使。

context.beforeSource: 追封順國公，諡康惠。
context.afterSource: 英宗即位之十有九日，右丞相鐵木迭兒怨拜住在省中牽制其所為，又發其姦贓、專制等事，遂請依皇太后旨，并前御史中丞楊朵兒只皆殺之。

manualTranslations.zh: 拜住，乃哈剌帖木兒之子也。
manualTranslations.literal: Baizhu was the son of Qarach Temür.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Baizhu was the son of Qarach Temür.

manualTranslations.zh: 嘗從成宗北征，特授檀州知州，入為禮部郎中，擢同知大都路總管府事，出知中山府，以憂去官。
manualTranslations.literal: He once followed Emperor Chengzong on the northern campaign and was specially appointed Prefect of Tanzhou; he entered service as a Director in the Ministry of Rites, was promoted to Associate Administrator of the Dadu Circuit General Administration, and went out as prefect of Zhongshan; he left office on account of mourning.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He once followed Emperor Chengzong on the northern campaign and was specially appointed prefect of Tanzhou. He entered service as a director in the Ministry of Rites, was promoted to associate administrator of the Dadu Circuit General Administration, and went out as prefect of Zhongshan before leaving office to mourn.

manualTranslations.zh: 屬仁宗過中山，有同官者，譖於近侍曰：「知府去官，實憚迎候煩勞耳。」
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Renzong passed through Zhongshan, a colleague slandered him to a palace attendant, saying: "The prefect left office because he truly feared the trouble of welcome and attendance."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Renzong passed through Zhongshan, a colleague slandered him to a palace attendant, saying, "The prefect left office because he truly feared the trouble of welcome and attendance."

manualTranslations.zh: 帝頷之，適行田野間，見老嫗，問之曰：「府中官孰賢？」
manualTranslations.literal: The Emperor nodded assent. As he happened to be traveling through the fields, he saw an old woman and asked her: "Which official in the prefecture is worthy?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor nodded assent. As he happened to be traveling through the fields, he saw an old woman and asked her, "Which official in the prefecture is worthy?"

manualTranslations.zh: 嫗對曰：「有蕭知府，餘不知也。」
manualTranslations.literal: The woman replied: "There is Prefect Xiao; of the rest I do not know."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The woman replied, "There is Prefect Xiao; of the rest I do not know."

manualTranslations.zh: 復過神祠，有數老人焚香羅拜，遣問之曰：「汝輩何所禱？」
manualTranslations.literal: Passing a spirit shrine again, he saw several old men burning incense and bowing in a circle; he sent someone to ask them: "What are you praying for?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Passing a spirit shrine again, he saw several old men burning incense and bowing in a circle. He sent someone to ask them, "What are you praying for?"

manualTranslations.zh: 合辭對曰：「蕭知府奔喪還，欲速其來，是以禱也。」
manualTranslations.literal: They answered together: "Prefect Xiao has returned from mourning and we wish to hasten his coming; that is why we pray."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: They answered together, "Prefect Xiao has returned from mourning and we wish to hasten his coming; that is why we pray."

manualTranslations.zh: 帝意遂釋。
manualTranslations.literal: The Emperor's mind was then eased.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor's mind was then eased.

manualTranslations.zh: 武宗即位，起復為中書左司郎中，出為河間路總管，召為右衞率使，遷戶部尚書，遂拜御史中丞。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Wuzong acceded, Baizhu was recalled from mourning and appointed Director in the Left Department of the Central Secretariat; he went out as General Administrator of Hejian Circuit; he was summoned as Commissioner of the Right Guard; he was transferred to Minister of Revenue; and he was then appointed Censor-in-Chief.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Wuzong acceded, Baizhu was recalled from mourning and appointed director in the Central Secretariat's left department. He went out as general administrator of Hejian Circuit, was summoned as commissioner of the Right Guard, was transferred to minister of revenue, and was then appointed censor-in-chief.

manualTranslations.zh: 皇慶元年，遷陝西行中書省右丞。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Huangqing (1312) he was transferred to Right Director of the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In 1312 he was transferred to right director of the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat.

manualTranslations.zh: 延祐三年，進中書平章政事，除典瑞院使，超授銀青榮祿大夫、崇祥院使。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year of Yanyou (1316) he was promoted to Assistant Administrator of the Central Secretariat, appointed Commissioner of the Court of Imperial Regalia, and extraordinarily granted Grand Master of Silver-Green Glory and Blessing and Commissioner of the Chongxiang Court.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In 1316 he was promoted to assistant administrator of the Central Secretariat, appointed commissioner of the Court of Imperial Regalia, and extraordinarily granted the titles of grand master of silver-green glory and blessing and commissioner of the Chongxiang Court.

manualTranslations.zh: 二人者，素忌集，繆言制封營國公，集具藳，俄丞相自榻前來索制詞甚急，集以藳進，丞相愕然問故，集知為所紿，即請易藳以進，終不自言，二人者愧之。
manualTranslations.literal: The two had long resented Ji and falsely said the edict enfeoffed him as Duke of Ying State. sourceRange.text: 年十四，益從宋故老習為詞章，下筆輒成章，每試庠序，輒占高等。弱冠，下帷數年，人莫見其面，經史百家，靡不研究，伊、洛諸儒源委，尤為淹貫。延祐元年，詔設科取士，玄以尚書與貢。明年，賜進士出身，授岳州路平江州同知。調太平路蕪湖縣尹。縣多疑獄，久不決，玄察其情，皆為平翻。豪右不法，虐其驅奴，玄斷之從良。貢賦徵發及時，民樂趨事，教化大行，飛蝗獨不入境。改武岡縣尹。縣控制溪洞，蠻獠雜居，撫字稍乖，輒弄兵犯順。玄至踰月，赤水、太清兩洞聚眾相攻殺，官曹相顧失色，計無從出。玄即日單騎從二人，徑抵其地諭之。至則死傷滿道，戰鬪未已。獠人熟玄名，棄兵仗，羅拜馬首曰：「我曹非不畏法，緣訴某事於縣，縣官不為直，反以徭役橫斂掊克之，情有弗堪，乃發憤就死耳。不意煩我清廉官自來。」玄喻以禍福，歸為理其訟，獠人遂安。召為國子博士，陞國子監丞。

manualTranslations.literal: The county controlled stream gorges where Miao and Liao peoples lived mixed together; when governance fell slightly short, they at once took up arms in rebellion.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The county controlled stream gorges where Miao and Liao peoples lived together; when governance fell slightly short, they would take up arms in rebellion.

manualTranslations.zh: 玄至踰月，赤水、太清兩洞聚眾相攻殺，官曹相顧失色，計無從出。
manualTranslations.literal: Within a month of Xuan's arrival, the people of the Chishui and Taiqing cave communities gathered and attacked one another in killing; the officials looked at one another in alarm and had no plan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Within a month of Xuan's arrival, the people of the Chishui and Taiqing cave communities gathered and attacked one another; the officials looked at one another in alarm and had no plan.

manualTranslations.zh: 玄即日單騎從二人，徑抵其地諭之。
manualTranslations.literal: That same day Xuan rode alone with only two attendants and went straight to the place to admonish them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That same day Xuan rode out alone with only two attendants and went straight to the place to reason with them.

manualTranslations.zh: 至則死傷滿道，戰鬪未已。
manualTranslations.literal: When he arrived, the dead and wounded filled the road and fighting had not yet ceased.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When he arrived, the dead and wounded filled the road and fighting had not yet ceased.

manualTranslations.zh: 獠人熟玄名，棄兵仗，羅拜馬首曰：「我曹非不畏法，緣訴某事於縣，縣官不為直，反以徭役橫斂掊克之，情有弗堪，乃發憤就死耳。
manualTranslations.literal: The Liao people knew Xuan's name; they cast aside weapons, bowed in rows before his horse, and said: "We are not unafraid of the law. It is because we appealed a certain matter at the county, and the county officials would not judge it fairly but instead imposed corvée labor and extorted and squeezed us. Our feelings could not bear it, so we gave way to anger and faced death.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Liao people knew Xuan's name. They cast aside their weapons, bowed in rows before his horse, and said: "We are not unafraid of the law. We appealed a certain matter at the county, but the county officials would not judge it fairly and instead imposed corvée labor and extorted us. We could not bear it, so we gave way to anger and faced death.

manualTranslations.zh: 不意煩我清廉官自來。」
manualTranslations.literal: We did not expect to trouble our incorrupt official to come in person."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: We did not expect to trouble our incorrupt official to come in person."

manualTranslations.zh: 玄喻以禍福，歸為理其訟，獠人遂安。
manualTranslations.literal: Xuan instructed them with warnings of fortune and disaster; on returning he settled their lawsuits, and the Liao people were then pacified.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xuan instructed them on the consequences of fortune and disaster; on returning he settled their lawsuits, and the Liao people were pacified.

sourceRange.text: 擴廓帖木兒將輔皇太子入討孛羅帖木兒，遣使傳皇太子旨，賜以上尊，且訪時事，楨復書曰：「今燕趙齊魯之境，大河內外，長淮南北，悉為丘墟，關陝之區，所存無幾，江左日思荐食上國，湘漢荊楚川蜀，淫名僭號，幸我有變，利我多虞。閤下國之右族，三世二王，得不思廉、藺之於趙，寇、賈之於漢乎？京師一殘，假有不逞之徒，崛起草澤，借名義，尊君父，倡其說於天下，閤下將何以處之乎！守京師者，能聚不能散，禦外侮者，能進不能退，紛紛籍籍，神分志奪，國家之事，能不為閤下憂乎！

manualTranslations.literal: Zhang Zhen, courtesy name Yuezhong, was a man of Bian.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhen, style name Yuezhong, was a native of Bian (Kaifeng).

manualTranslations.zh: 幼刻苦讀書，登元統元年進士第，授彰德路錄事，辟河南行省掾。
manualTranslations.literal: From youth he read books with bitter effort; he passed the jinshi examination in the first year of Yuantong, was appointed recorder of Zhangde Circuit, and was recruited as a clerk of the Henan Branch Secretariat.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He studied diligently from childhood, passed the jinshi in Yuantong 1, was made recorder of Zhangde Circuit, and joined the Henan Branch Secretariat as a clerk.

manualTranslations.zh: 楨初娶祁氏，祁生貴富家，頗驕縱，見楨貧，不為禮，合卺踰月，即出之。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhen first married the Qi clan; Qi was born to a wealthy noble family, quite proud and unrestrained; seeing Zhen poor, she showed no courtesy; after the wedding cup passed a month, he divorced her.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His first wife was of the Qi clan, from a rich and pampered family who treated the poor Zhen with disdain; within a month of their wedding he sent her away.

manualTranslations.zh: 祁之兄訟于官，且污楨以黯昧事，左右司官聽之，楨因移疾不出，滯案俱積。
manualTranslations.literal: Qi's elder brother sued at court and moreover slandered Zhen with a shady affair; the Left and Right Department officials heard the case; Zhen therefore pleaded illness and did not go out; stalled cases all piled up.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Her brother sued in court and accused Zhen of misconduct. While the Left and Right Department officials heard the case, Zhen pleaded illness and stayed home, and all pending matters stagnated.

manualTranslations.zh: 平章政事月魯帖木兒怒曰：「張楨，剛介士也，豈汝曹所當議耶！」
manualTranslations.literal: Grand Councillor Yuelu Temur said angrily: "Zhang Zhen is a stern and upright gentleman—are you lot fit to discuss him!"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Grand Councillor Yuelu Temur raged: "Zhang Zhen is a man of firm integrity—who are you to judge him!"

manualTranslations.zh: 郎中虎者禿謁而謝之，乃起。

sourceRange.text: 嘗曰：「養生有不備，事猶可復，追遠有不誠，是誣神也，可逭罪乎！」與人交，雖外無適莫，而中有繩尺。里人借騾而死，償其直，不受，曰：「物之數也，何以償爲！」家無儋石之儲，而聚書數萬巻，扁所居曰榘菴。時蕭𣂏居南山下，亦以道髙當世，入城府，必主恕家，士論稱之曰蕭同。恕自京還，家居十三年，縉紳望之若景星麟鳳，鄕里稱爲先生而不姓。

localRange.text: 尝曰：「养生有不备，事犹可复，追远有不诚，是诬神也，可逭罪乎！与人交，虽外无适莫，而中有绳尺。里人借骡而死，偿其直，不受，曰：「物之数也，何以偿为！家无儋石之储，而聚书数万卷，扁所居曰榘庵。时萧渼居南山下，亦以道高当世，入城府，必主恕家，士论称之曰「萧同」。恕自京还，家居十三年，缙绅望之若景星麟凤，乡里称为先生而不姓。

sourceRange.text: 同恕字寬甫，其先太原人。五世祖遷秦中，遂爲奉元人。祖昇。父繼先，博學能文，廉希憲宣撫陝右，辟掌庫鑰。家世業儒，同居二百口，無間言。恕安靜端凝，羈丱如成人，從鄕先生學，日記數千言。年十三，以書經魁鄕校。至元間，朝廷始分六部，選名士爲吏屬，關陝以恕貢禮曹，辭不行。仁宗踐阼，即其家拜國子司業，階儒林郎，使三召，不起。陝西行臺侍御史趙世延，請即奉元置魯齋書院，中書奏恕領教事，制可之。先後來學者殆千數。延祐設科，再主鄕試，人服其公。六年，以奉議大夫、太子左贊善召，入見東宮，賜酒慰問。繼而獻書，歴陳古誼，盡開悟涵養之道。明年春，英宗繼統，以疾歸。致和元年，拜集賢侍讀學士，以老疾辭。恕之學，由程、朱上遡孔、孟，務貫浹事理，以利於行。

sourceRange.text: 嘗出，遇一婦人，失金釵道旁，疑𣂏拾之，謂曰：「殊無他人，獨翁居後耳。」𣂏令隨至門，取家釵以償，其婦後得所遺釵，愧謝還之。鄕人有自城中暮歸者，遇寇，欲加害，詭言「我蕭先生也」，寇驚愕釋去。世祖分藩在秦，辟𣂏與楊恭懿、韓擇侍秦邸，𣂏以疾辭，授陝西儒學提舉，不赴。省憲大臣即其家具宴爲賀，使一從史先詣𣂏舍，𣂏方汲水灌園，從史至，不知其爲𣂏也，使飲其馬，即應之不拒，及冠帶迎賓，從史見𣂏，有懼色，𣂏殊不爲意。後累授集賢直學士、國子司業，改集賢侍讀學士，皆不赴。大德十一年，拜太子右諭德，扶病至京師，入覲東宮，書酒誥爲獻，以朝廷時尚酒故也。

sourceRange.text: 讀四書章句集註，有叢説二十巻，謂學者曰：「學以聖人爲準的，然必得聖人之心，而後可學聖人之事。聖賢之心，具在四書，而四書之義，備於朱子，顧其辭約意廣，讀者安可以易心求之乎！」讀詩集傳，有名物鈔八巻，正其音釋，考其名物度數，以補先儒之未備，仍存其逸義，旁采遠援，而以己意終之。讀書集傳，有叢説六巻。其觀史，有治忽幾微，倣史家年經國緯之法，起太皞氏，迄宋元祐元年秋九月尚書左僕射司馬光卒，備其世數，總其年歳，原其興亡，著其善惡，蓋以爲光卒，則中國之治不可復興，誠理亂之幾也。故附於續經而書孔子卒之義，以致其意焉。又有自省編，晝之所爲，夜必書之，其不可書者，則不爲也。其他若天文、地理、典章、制度、食貨、刑法、字學、音韻、醫經、術數之説，亦靡不該貫，旁而釋、老之言，亦洞究其蘊。嘗謂：「學者孰不曰闢異端，苟不深探其隱，而識其所以然，能辨其同異，別其是非也幾希。」又嘗句讀九經、儀禮及春秋三傳，於其宏綱要領，錯簡衍文，悉別以鉛黃朱墨，意有所明，則表而見之。其後呉師道購得呂祖謙點校儀禮，視謙所定，不同者十有三條而已。謙不喜矜露，所爲詩文，非扶翼經義，張維世教，則未嘗輕筆之書也。

localRange.text: 又有《自省编》，昼之所为，夜必书之，其不可书者，则不为也。其他若天文、地理、典章、制度、食货、刑法、字学、音韵、医经、术数之说，亦靡不该贯，旁而释、老之言，亦洞究其蕴。尝谓：「学者孰不曰辟异端，苟不深探其隐，而识其所以然，能辨其同异，别其是非也几希。又尝句读《九经》、《仪礼》及《春秋三传》，于其宏纲要领，错简衍文，悉别以铅黄硃墨，意有所明，则表而见之。其后吴师道购得吕祖谦点校《仪礼》，视谦所定，不同者十有三条而已。谦不喜矜露，所为诗文，非扶翼经义，张维世教，则未尝轻笔之书也。

manualTranslations.zh: 成宗以皇孫撫軍北邊，帝遣使授皇太子寶，德進預在行，凡攻戰取勝，皆豫剋期日，無不驗者。
manualTranslations.literal: When Chengzong as imperial grandson garrisoned the northern frontier, the emperor sent envoys to invest the heir apparent with the imperial seal; Dejin accompanied the expedition, and in every battle won he predicted the day of victory in advance — none failed to come true.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Chengzong led the imperial grandson to garrison the northern frontier, the court sent envoys to invest the heir with the imperial seal. Dejin accompanied the expedition, and in every battle won he predicted the day of victory in advance — and none failed to come true.

manualTranslations.zh: 亦間言事得失，多所裨益。
manualTranslations.literal: He also occasionally spoke on the rights and wrongs of affairs, greatly benefiting the state.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He also occasionally offered counsel on affairs of state, to considerable benefit.

manualTranslations.zh: 成宗即位，歷陳世祖進賢納諫、咨詢治亂之原，帝嘉納之。
manualTranslations.literal: When Chengzong took the throne, he repeatedly set forth how the Shizu emperor advanced worthies, accepted remonstrance, and inquired into the roots of order and disorder; the emperor praised and adopted his counsel.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Chengzong succeeded, Dejin repeatedly urged the emperor to follow Kublai's example of advancing worthies, accepting remonstrance, and inquiring into the roots of order and disorder — counsel the emperor praised and adopted.

manualTranslations.zh: 授昭文館大學士，知太史院，領司天臺事，賜金帶宴服。
manualTranslations.literal: He was appointed Grand Academician of the Hall for the Diffusion of Literature, given charge of the Directorate of Astronomy, and placed in charge of the Directorate of Astronomy affairs; he was granted a gold belt and banquet robes.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was appointed Grand Academician of the Hall for the Diffusion of Literature, given charge of the Directorate of Astronomy and placed in charge of its observatory affairs, and granted a gold belt and banquet robes.

manualTranslations.zh: 都城以荻苫廩，或請以瓦易之，帝以問德進，對曰：「若是役驟興，物必踴貴，民力重困，臣愚未見其可。」
manualTranslations.literal: The capital's granaries were thatched with reeds, and some proposed replacing them with tile; the emperor asked Dejin, who replied, "If such a project were suddenly launched, materials would surely soar in price and the people's strength would be heavily burdened. Your subject's dull wit sees no merit in it."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The capital's granaries were thatched with reeds, and some proposed replacing the thatch with tile. When the emperor asked Dejin, he replied, "If such a project were launched suddenly, materials would surely soar in price and the people would be heavily burdened. I see no merit in it."

manualTranslations.zh: 議遂寢。
manualTranslations.literal: The proposal was then dropped.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The proposal was then dropped.

manualTranslations.zh: 敕中書自今凡集議政事，必使德進預焉。
manualTranslations.literal: An edict ordered the Central Secretariat that from then on, whenever state affairs were deliberated in assembly, Dejin must participate.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that from then on, whenever the Central Secretariat assembled to deliberate state affairs, Dejin must participate.

manualTranslations.zh: 所建明多見於施行。
manualTranslations.literal: Most of what he proposed was seen in implementation.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Most of his proposals were put into practice.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋以病丐閑。
manualTranslations.literal: Before long, on grounds of illness he requested a less demanding post.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he asked to be relieved on grounds of illness.

manualTranslations.zh: 仁宗時在東宮，特令中書加官以留之。
manualTranslations.literal: When Renzong was still in the Eastern Palace, he specially ordered the Central Secretariat to add to his rank in order to keep him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: While the future Emperor Renzong was still heir apparent, he specially ordered the Central Secretariat to promote Dejin in order to keep him at court.

manualTranslations.zh: 會車駕自上京還，召見白海行宮，授資德大夫、中書右丞，議通政院事。
manualTranslations.literal: When the imperial carriage returned from Shangdu, he was summoned to audience at the traveling palace at Bai Hai and appointed Grand Master for Virtuous Conduct, Right Vice Director of the Central Secretariat, and assigned to deliberate affairs of the Bureau of Transmission.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the emperor returned from Shangdu, Dejin was summoned to audience at the traveling palace at Bai Hai and appointed grand master for virtuous conduct and right vice director of the Central Secretariat, with responsibility for deliberating affairs of the Bureau of Transmission.

manualTranslations.zh: 仁宗即位，命領太史院事，力辭不允。
manualTranslations.literal: When Renzong took the throne, he was ordered to head the Directorate of Astronomy; he strenuously declined but was not permitted.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Renzong succeeded, he was ordered to head the Directorate of Astronomy; he strenuously declined but was not permitted to refuse.

manualTranslations.zh: 以疾卒于位。
manualTranslations.literal: He died of illness in office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died of illness in office.

manualTranslations.zh: 贈推誠贊治功臣、榮祿大夫、大司徒、柱國、魏國公，諡文穆。
manualTranslations.literal: Posthumously he was granted the title Meritorious Minister Who Promoted Loyalty and Supported Governance, Grandee of Glorious Emolument, Grand Preceptor, Pillar of State, and Duke of the State of Wei, with the posthumous name Wenmu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Posthumously he was honored as meritorious minister who promoted loyalty and supported governance, grandee of glorious emolument, grand preceptor, pillar of state, and Duke of Wei, with the posthumous name Wenmu (Cultured and Solemn).

manualTranslations.zh: 子泰，工部侍郎。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Tai served as Vice Minister of the Ministry of Works.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Tai served as vice minister of the Ministry of Works.

sourceRange.text: 李邦寧字叔固，錢唐人，初名保寧，宋故小黃門也。宋亡，從瀛國公入見世祖，命給事內庭，警敏稱上意。令學國書及諸蕃語，即通解，遂見親任。授御帶庫提點，陞章佩少監，遷禮部尚書，提點太醫院（使）〔事〕。成宗即位，進昭文館大學士、太醫院使。帝嘗寢疾，邦寧不離左右者十餘月。武宗立，命為江浙行省平章政事，邦寧辭曰：「臣以閹腐餘命，無望更生，先朝幸赦而用之，使得承乏中涓，高爵厚祿，榮寵過甚。陛下復欲置臣宰輔，臣何敢當？宰輔者，佐天子共治天下者也，奈何辱以寺人？陛下縱不臣惜，如天下後世何！誠不敢奉詔。」帝大悅，使大臣白其言于太后及皇太子，以彰其善。

Bangning declined, saying: "Your servant, by the remnant life of a castrated and corrupted man, has no hope of renewal. The previous court fortunately pardoned and employed me, allowing me to fill a vacancy among the palace attendants — high rank, thick salary, glory and favor beyond measure.

Bangning declined, saying, "I am only a castrated man spared from death; I have no hope of a new life. The previous emperor mercifully pardoned and employed me, letting me fill a post among the palace attendants — rank, salary, and honors already far beyond my deserts.

manualTranslations.zh: 陛下復欲置臣宰輔，臣何敢當？
manualTranslations.literal: Your Majesty now wishes again to place your servant among the chief ministers — how would your servant dare accept?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Your Majesty now wishes to make me a chief minister — how could I dare accept?

manualTranslations.zh: 宰輔者，佐天子共治天下者也，奈何辱以寺人？
manualTranslations.literal: Chief ministers are those who assist the Son of Heaven in jointly governing all under Heaven — how can one insult that office with a temple eunuch?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chief ministers assist the Son of Heaven in governing the realm — how can that office be disgraced by appointing a temple eunuch?

manualTranslations.zh: 陛下縱不臣惜，如天下後世何！
manualTranslations.literal: Even if Your Majesty does not pity your servant, what of all under Heaven and later ages!
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Even if Your Majesty does not care for me, what will the realm and posterity think!

manualTranslations.literal: I truly dare not obey the edict."

manualTranslations.zh: 帝大悅，使大臣白其言于太后及皇太子，以彰其善。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor was greatly pleased and had a senior minister repeat his words to the empress dowager and the crown prince, to display his merit.

sourceRange.text: 至正元年，改山東肅政廉訪使，尋召拜中政使。明年正月，除陝西行臺御史中丞。三月，復為中政使。八月，調太府卿。四年，拜中書參知政事，尋陞右丞。六年，遷御史中丞，遂除翰林學士承旨，俄復為中丞。又由資政使遷宣徽使。九年，除大宗正府也可扎魯火赤，宗正國人咸稱其明果。尋復入中書為右丞。十年正月，陞平章政事，階光祿大夫。十一年十一月，拜御史大夫，進銀青榮祿大夫。十二年四月，復為中書平章，從丞相脫脫平徐州有功。十三年，復拜御史大夫，尋又為中書平章。

sourceRange.text: 秋八月癸亥，英宗自上都南還，駐蹕南坡。是夕，鐵失與知樞密院事也先鐵木兒、大司農失禿兒、前中書平章政事赤斤鐵木兒、前雲南行省平章政事完者、前治書侍御史鎖南、鐵失之弟宣徽使鎖南、典瑞院使脫火赤、樞密副使阿散、僉書樞密院事章台、衞士禿滿，及諸王按梯不花、孛羅、月魯鐵木兒、曲律不花、兀魯思不花等，以鐵失所領阿速衞兵為外應，殺右丞相拜住，而鐵失直犯禁幄，手弒英宗于臥所。九月四日，晉王即位，鐵失及其黨皆伏誅。孛羅帖木兒，答失八都魯之子也。

manualTranslations.literal: That evening Tie Shi, together with Privy Council administrator Yesen Timur, Minister of Revenue Shitu'er, former Pingzhang of the Central Secretariat Chijin Timur, former Pingzhang of the Yunnan Branch Secretariat Wanzhe, former Associate Censor Suonan, Tie Shi's younger brother Huizheng Court commissioner Suonan, Ceremonial Regalia Court commissioner Tuohuochi, Vice Director of the Privy Council Asan, Privy Council Secretary Zhangtai, guard Tumian, and the princes Atibuhua, Boluo, Yuelu Timur, Qulvuhua, Ulusibuhua, and others, using the Asud guard troops Tie Shi commanded as external support, killed Right Chancellor Bayiju; Tie Shi then directly breached the forbidden tent and personally assassinated Emperor Yingzong in his sleeping quarters.

sourceRange.text: 等道由，以帝命遣其副使、等導詔使等往日本，不至而還。四年六月，帝謂以辭爲解，令去使徒還，復遣等至諭禃，委以事，以必得其要領爲期。以爲海道險阻，不可辱天使，九月，遣其等持書往，留六月，亦不得其要領而歸。五年九月，命、復持書往，至，人拒而不納，執其、二人而還。六年六月，命送還執者，俾牒其國，亦不報。留其守護所者久之。十二月，又命往使。

localRange.text: 黑的等道由高麗，高麗國王王禃以帝命遣其樞密院副使宋君斐、借禮部侍郎金贊等導詔使黑的等往日本，不至而還。四年六月，帝謂王禃以辭為解，令去使徒還，復遣黑的等至高麗諭禃，委以日本事，以必得其要領為期。禃以為海道險阻，不可辱天使，九月，遣其起居舍人潘阜等持書往日本，留六月，亦不得其要領而歸。五年九月，命黑的、弘復持書往，至對馬島，日本人拒而不納，執其塔二郎、彌二郎二人而還。六年六月，命高麗金有成送還執者，俾中書省牒其國，亦不報。有成留其太宰府守護所者久之。十二月，又命祕書監趙良弼往使。

sourceRange.text: 久之，與者亦逃還，十萬之衆得還者三人耳。二十年，命爲省丞相，與右丞、左丞，募兵造舟，欲復征。宣慰使上言民勞，乞寢兵。二十一年，又以其俗尚佛，遣與僧往使。舟中有不願行者，共謀殺，不果至。二十三年，帝曰：「未嘗相侵，今犯邊，宜置，專事。」二年，省乞用兵。

localRange.text: 久之，莫青與吳萬五者亦逃還，十萬之衆得還者三人耳。二十年，命阿塔海為日本省丞相，與徹里帖木兒右丞、劉二拔都兒左丞，募兵造舟，欲復征日本。淮西宣慰使昂吉兒上言民勞，乞寢兵。二十一年，又以其俗尚佛，遣王積翁與補陀僧如智往使。舟中有不願行者，共謀殺積翁，不果至。二十三年，帝曰：「日本未嘗相侵，今交趾犯邊，宜置日本，專事交趾。成宗大德二年，江浙省平章政事也速荅兒乞用兵日本。

sourceRange.text: 十一年正月己卯朔，宮闕告成，帝始御正殿，受皇太子諸王百官朝賀。禃遣其少卿李義孫等入賀。三月，遣木速塔八、撒木合持詔使高麗簽軍五千六百人助征日本。五月，皇女忽都魯揭里迷失下嫁于世子愖。七月，其樞密院副使奇蘊奉表告王禃薨，命世子愖襲爵，詔諭高麗國王宗族及大小官員百姓人等，其略曰：「國王王禃存日，屢言世子愖可為繼嗣。今令愖襲爵為王。凡在所屬，並聽節制。」八月，世子愖還至其國襲位。九月，遣其齊安侯王淑上表謝恩。十一月，皇女入京城。愖復遣其判閤門事李信孫等奉表入謝。十二月，以黑的為高麗達魯花赤，李益受代還。

localRange.text: 假若彼國人至，與卿輩有所議，當同心協謀，如出一口荅之。五月，日本行省參議裴國佐等言：「本省右丞相阿剌罕、范右丞、李左丞先與忻都、茶丘入朝。時同院官議定，領舟師至高麗金州，與忻都、茶丘軍會，然後入征日本。又為風水不便，再議定會於一岐島。今年三月，有日本船為風水漂至者，令其水工畫地圖，因見近太宰府西有平戶島者，周圍皆水，可屯軍船。此島非其所防，若徑往據此島，使人乘船往一岐，呼忻都、茶丘來會進討為利。帝曰：「此間不悉彼中事宜，阿剌罕輩必知，令其自處之。六月，阿剌罕以病不能行，命阿塔海代緫軍事。八月，諸將未見敵，喪全師以還，乃言：「至日本，欲攻太宰府，暴風破舟，猶欲議戰，萬戶厲德彪、招討王國佐、水手緫管陸文政等不聽節制，輒逃去。本省載餘軍至合浦，散遣還鄉里。未幾，敗卒于閶脫歸，言：「官軍六月入海，七月至平壺島，移五龍山。
